AI.method: 方法分三阶段:(1)通过随机限制技巧证明Boolean cube上的类依赖边等周引理(Lemma 2.1),定义权重w_{v,p}满足w_{v,p}+w_{v^{\oplus p},p}=1且∑_{p∈D}w_{v,p} ≤ ρ_F(v) + R_D(F),从而对诱导子图的边数给出依赖顶点到trace距离的局部控制;(2)结合Hall定理构造full cube的定向,证明leave-one-out界 L̂^LOO_S ≤ L̂*_S + 120√(dL̂*_S/n) + 7202d/n,系数严格为1(优于Long的15倍系数);(3)通过Aden-Ali等提出的suffix averaging将leave-one-out界转化为高概率PAC界,使用reverse martingale(逆向鞅,基于Freedman不等式)控制经验误差,forward martingale(正向鞅,基于Bernstein MGF)控制期望与经验偏差,最后对独立验证集做阈值化(ERM over threshold class)去随机化,获得确定性{-1,+1}值预测器。整个证明链中VC维通过投影Rademacher宽度R_D(F) ≤ 60√(d|D|)唯一一次进入。
AI.result: 主要结果(Theorem 1):存在确定性、通常非适当的(improper)学习器,使用n个i.i.d.样本,任意0<δ<1,以至少1-δ概率满足 L(ĥ) ≤ L* + 2·10⁸(√(L*(d+log(48/δ))/n) + (d+log(48/δ))/n)。与Devroye-Györfi-Lugosi的下界(1)在任何固定L*处匹配至通用常数。这完全确定了二元分类的分布无关高概率minimax超额风险界。此外,得到的leave-one-out界(Theorem 2)给出out(v;σ) ≤ ρ_F(v) + 120√(dρ_F(v)) + 7202d的定向,改进了Long的15∑(d+ρ_F(v))上界。
AI.conclusion: 本文彻底解决了agnostic PAC学习的样本复杂度问题,在任意固定L*处证明上界与下界匹配至通用常数。技术核心——类依赖边等周引理(Lemma 2.1)——独立于PAC转换部分,可能对one-inclusion graph方法和经验过程理论中的其他应用具有独立价值。证明过程中使用GPT-5.5/5.6 Pro辅助探索VC类例子(thresholds、intervals、矩形),最终推广得到一般随机限制论证。作者指出该方法在appendix中详细说明了AI辅助过程,体现了现代理论与AI工具结合的范例。

title: Investigating Artificial Intelligence Digital Sovereignty in Mobile Shopping Apps: A Case Study of Nigeria
comment: Paper presented at Thirty-second Americas Conference on Information Systems, Reno, USA
summary: The use of e-commerce mobile applications is expanding in Nigeria, creating both opportunities and risks, including fraud and reduced user control over digital technologies, raising concerns about digital sovereignty. This research examines how Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Nigerian mobile applications affects digital sovereignty, examined through platform transparency as a key indicator of user awareness and control. Using an interpretive approach, the research combines the forensic analysis of selected Android applications with contextual document analysis to identify AI features and evaluate disclosure practices. The findings show that AI is widely implemented in the applications, yet transparency about its use remains limited. A socio-economic analysis of Nigeria further shows an increasing dependence on consumer digital platforms, moderate AI awareness, and uneven patterns of interaction. By providing empirical evidence on AI transparency and platform practices, this study advances understanding of individual digital sovereignty and highlights challenges for protecting user control in AI-driven digital environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过取证分析和文档分析，调查了尼日利亚电商移动应用中人工智能（AI）的使用情况及其对个人数字主权的影响，发现尽管AI在应用中广泛部署，但关于其使用的透明度仍然有限。
AI.motivation: 随着尼日利亚电商移动应用的迅速扩张，AI的广泛嵌入带来了欺诈风险上升与用户对数字技术控制力下降的问题，引发了对数字主权的担忧。然而，关于AI如何在移动平台中部署以及平台透明度如何影响用户对AI的认知与控制的实证证据仍然匮乏。
AI.method: 采用解释性研究方法，结合两部分分析：（1）对选定的尼日利亚Android电商应用进行取证分析（forensic analysis），以识别其中的AI功能并评估披露实践；（2）尼日利亚社会经济背景的语境化文档分析。以平台透明度作为衡量用户对AI认知与控制的关键指标。
AI.result: 研究发现AI在尼日利亚移动电商应用中已被广泛实施，但应用对其AI使用的透明度披露仍然有限；社会经济分析进一步显示用户对消费类数字平台的依赖日益加深，对AI的认知水平为中等，且用户与AI驱动的应用之间的交互模式呈现不均衡分布。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过提供关于AI透明度与平台实践的实证证据，推动了对个体数字主权的理解，并揭示了在AI驱动的数字环境中保护用户控制权所面临的挑战，强调在尼日利亚等新兴数字经济中需要加强平台对AI使用的透明披露。

title: Learning When to Trust via Selective Context Preference Optimization
comment: Project Page at this https URL GitHub Repo at this https URL HF Dataset at this https URL
summary: Language models increasingly condition their answers on external signals, and a single misleading one can turn a correct answer wrong. The obvious remedy, training models to resist such signals, hides a failure mode: a model that ignores all context looks robust yet is useless when the context is worth trusting. We recast the problem as selective trust and introduce MIST, a human-annotated benchmark that renders each reasoning item under four matched conditions (clean, misleading, correct-context, and irrelevant-context), together with SC2W, a paired metric counting how often a misleading signal flips a clean-correct answer to wrong. Across a comprehensive benchmark study, we observe that such a susceptibility is universal. We then propose SCOPE, which mines clean-correct/misleading-wrong failures and optimizes a standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) objective over matched preference pairs balanced equally across all four conditions, rather than over misleading items alone. Our approach substantially reduces SC2W on popular open-sourced models while preserving accuracy when the added context is clean, correct, or irrelevant. With this work, we argue that models should be judged on selective trust, not on resistance alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"选择性信任"(selective trust)框架，将大语言模型对外部上下文的鲁棒性问题从单纯的"抵抗误导"重新定义为"判断信号是否值得信任"。为此，作者构建了人工标注基准 MIST（1000题×4种匹配条件），提出配对指标 SC2W 衡量误导信号将正确答案翻转为错误的比率，并设计 SCOPE 方法——通过平衡四种条件下的偏好对进行标准 DPO 训练，在 Qwen3-4B 和 Llama-3.2-3B 上将 SC2W 近乎减半，同时保持干净、正确上下文和无关上下文条件下的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有基准在单一上下文条件下评估模型，掩盖了一个关键失败模式：一个简单地忽略所有外部上下文的模型看起来很鲁棒，但在上下文值得信任时却毫无用处。误导信号会导致模型放弃原本正确的答案，且这种"信号易感性"在包括 GPT-5.5、Claude、Gemini 等前沿模型中普遍存在，单条件评估无法区分"真正判断信号"与"盲目拒绝上下文"这两种行为。
AI.method: 1) MIST 基准：每个题目在四种匹配条件下呈现（clean/misleading/correct-context/irrelevant），仅上下文变化，问题、答案空间、金标准答案固定，使准确率变化完全归因于信号；2) SC2W 指标：条件于干净题答对的项目，统计误导信号将其翻转为错误的比率；3) SCOPE 训练方法：挖掘"干净答对/误导答错"的失败案例，构造同一响应对的四种上下文条件偏好数据（(λ_m, λ_c, λ_p, ρ)=(0.25, 0.25, 0.50, 0.50)），使用标准全序列 DPO 损失同时优化，平衡误导抵抗与上下文利用。
AI.result: 在 23 个模型（前沿 API + 开源权重）上证实 SC2W 易感性普遍存在，前沿模型 GPT-5.5 仍有 10.5 的 SC2W。在 Qwen3-4B 上，SCOPE 将 SC2W 从 35.0 降至 16.3，同时提升 Overall Acc（86.9→92.0），是唯一同时改善鲁棒性和控制条件的防御方法；在 Llama-3.2-3B 上，SC2W 从 31.5 降至 20.6，且 Standard-DPO 出现 correct-context 准确率崩溃。SCOPE 零样本迁移到 GSM-IC、GSM-Plus 和 Sharma 三个外部基准，在两个模型家族上均取得最佳或并列最佳。切片分析显示改进在题源、答案格式、信号来源等多维度上一致有效；人类审计证实自动评分与语义正确性判断高度一致（Spearman ρ≥0.82）。
AI.conclusion: 推理模型的正确评估目标应是"选择性信任"而非"抵抗性"。通过改变进入标准 DPO 目标的内容（平衡的信号反事实偏好对），SCOPE 在不损失其他条件准确率的前提下显著降低误导信号易感性，并具备良好的零样本迁移能力。这项工作呼吁业界以多条件评估取代单条件评估，以衡量模型判断信号可信度的真实能力。

title: Application Failures and Machine Computational Efficiency
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the 2026 SIAM Conference on Parallel Processing for Scientific Computing (PP)
summary: We present a framework for evaluating uptime efficiency of Exascale-class scientific computers when application failure rates are appreciable. This is the situation that confronts current leadership-class scientific computing platforms and large AI training installations. What distinguishes scientific computing platforms is the heterogeneity of their applications. We argue that this diversity requires that failure rates and mean intervals between failures should be specified in terms of \emph{usage} (e.g. node-hours) rather than time, as is currently customary. We consider the usage loss terms due to failures, to checkpointing, and to restart costs, and update the framework of Daly (2006) allowing users to specify optimal checkpointing usage intervals that minimize such losses. We derive the machine computational efficiency, which specifies the expected fractional resource allocation that is available for scientific computation. We illustrate the methodology using one year of production runtime data from the \emph{Frontier} supercomputer at Oak Ridge National Laboratory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套用于评估E级（Exascale）科学计算机在应用故障率显著时的计算效率的框架。核心创新是将故障率和检查点间隔从传统的时间域重新表述为"使用量"域（节点小时数），引入了每单位使用量故障率R₀的概念，并更新了Daly(2006)的最优检查点策略框架。基于橡树岭国家实验室Frontier超级计算机一年的实际运行数据，测得其计算效率为95.7%。
AI.motivation: 1. E级超算面临频繁故障：当前领导级科学计算平台的MTBF已从原来的"天/周"级别下降到"小时"级别，故障弹性成为核心挑战。2. 科学HPC应用具有异构性：与AI训练集群不同，科学HPC承载CFD、地球系统模型、分子动力学、宇宙学等多类型应用，作业规模和持续时间差异巨大。3. 故障风险随作业规模（N个节点）线性增长：传统以"时间"为单位的MTBF/MTTR框架无法正确刻画不同规模作业的故障风险——例如1000节点作业运行1小时的故障风险等同于500节点作业运行2小时，但时间域指标无法体现这种等效性。4. 设施需要量化弹性开销：需要精确量化用于故障恢复（检查点、检查点写入、重启）的资源占比，以合理分配节点小时数预算。
AI.method: 1. **概念重构**：引入每单位使用量故障率R₀（单位：故障/节点小时），其倒数为MUBF（Mean Usage Between Failures），替代传统MTBF。2. **成本建模**：将故障相关成本分解为三类——检查点写入成本u_chk（节点本地存储为O(N)，全局共享存储为O(N²)）、作业故障成本ū̄F（截断指数分布期望）、重启成本ū̄R（含重启失败的几何分布）。3. **最优检查点节奏推导**：以总期望损失L对u_c求导，得到超越方程1−R₀u_c=exp(−R₀(u_c+u_chk))，数值求解得z_c和z_chk的无量纲关系。低故障率极限下退化为经典Young-Daly结果u_c≈√(2u_chk/R₀)。4. **逐作业损失分析**：将作业按类型(N, T)分类，考虑检查点数的离散取整N_chk=⌈NT/(u_c+u_chk)⌉，推导单作业的期望检查点损失（公式4.3）、故障损失、重启损失和期望使用量。5. **机器效率定义**：基于调度表{（N_l, T_l）}，定义总使用量Ū_Tot、总损失L̄，计算效率e=1−L̄/Ū_Tot，并分解为检查点损失率l_chk、故障损失率l_F、重启损失率l_R。6. **实现**：以Python函数库实现，配套Jupyter Notebook，代码公开于GitHub仓库。
AI.result: 1. **Frontier基准参数**：R₀=2.0×10⁻⁵（节点小时）⁻¹，B_w=B_r=6 TB/s，检查点数据量M=200 GB，τ_c≈9.26×10⁻⁶小时，τ₀=2秒，α=1；作业调度来自2024年331,640个INCITE/ALCC项目作业。2. **计算效率e=0.957**：分解为l_chk=0.012，l_F=0.028，l_R=0.003；OLCF仅需超额分配4.5%的节点小时。3. **次优检查点的敏感性**：完全不进行检查点时e降至0.914（下降4.3%）；检查点间隔偏离最优值5倍（任一方向）导致效率下降5%，偏离10倍（检查点过频）可致下降10%。4. **作业维度分析**：效率随请求时长增大而下降，最终因检查点成本饱和而趋于稳定；故障损失和重启损失率与作业时长无关。5. **故障率影响**：R₀从2×10⁻⁵升至10⁻⁴时e降至90.9%，升至2×10⁻⁴时e降至88.6%。6. **存储带宽影响**：带宽对效率影响显著，尤其在高故障率下O(N²)扩展使大作业检查点代价剧增。
AI.conclusion: 1. **框架贡献**：成功将传统时间域的最优检查点理论拓展至使用量域，使之能够一致处理异构规模和时长的科学HPC负载，是Daly(2006)框架的重要更新。2. **设计启示**：未来E级及更高量级机器应避免共享存储导致的O(N²)检查点成本扩展，节点本地存储或专用检查点硬件是关键方向；检查点开销对系统效率和未来机器可行性具有"日益严重的毒性"。3. **运营与生态建议**：不同应用类型应建立差异化故障率R₀估计；HPC设施应建立标准化的故障日志采集与监控机制；建议采用"超额预配"（U_Alloc=U/e）简化设施与项目组的资源协商；调度系统应支持故障作业的优雅重启（替换故障节点、重建MPI通信子）。4. **未来工作**：纳入集体故障（网络拥塞、挂起）、应用特定检查点数据量M等扩展，以更精细刻画负载异构性。

title: Serverless platform driven CPU loadbalancing
summary: Serverless platforms maintain a global view of function invocations and resource utilization, yet existing systems largely restrict CPU scheduling decisions to the operating system scheduler. This paper presents a serverless platform-driven CPU load balancing framework that enables the control plane to directly influence CPU scheduling through a custom Linux scheduler built on SchedExt(SCX). The proposed scheduler introduces configurable scheduling domains and a shared interface that allows the control plane to assign functions to domains based on their historical inter-arrival times. Within each domain, a single-queue load-balancing strategy combined with a virtual-time prioritization policy improves task placement while reducing interference from busy-polling tasks. Results show that an eight-domain configuration achieves the best trade-off, reducing system energy consumption by approximately 15% while increasing invocation cost by only 5%. Under heavily loaded workloads, the proposed scheduler also reduces request latency by up to 50% compared to the default Linux Completely Fair Scheduler (CFS). These results demonstrate that exposing CPU scheduling decisions to the serverless control plane can improve both energy efficiency and workload performance while preserving scheduling flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于SchedExt（SCX）框架的自定义Linux CPU调度器，使无服务器（Serverless）控制面能够通过eBPF机制直接干预CPU负载均衡。核心思想是将CPU划分为可配置的调度域，控制面根据函数的到达间隔时间（IAT）将函数分配到不同域中，域内采用单队列负载均衡与虚拟时间（vtime）优先级策略，降低忙等待（busy-polling）任务的干扰。在48核Intel Xeon服务器上使用Azure Functions真实轨迹进行评估，8域配置最佳，能耗降低约15%，调用开销仅增加约5%，高负载下延迟最多降低50%。
AI.motivation: 现有无服务器（FaaS）平台虽然拥有函数调用的全局视图和丰富的历史统计信息（调用频率、到达间隔、执行时长等），但在CPU调度层面几乎完全依赖操作系统默认调度器（如Linux CFS），控制面无法影响CPU资源在内核中的分配方式。这种控制面与操作系统调度器之间的隔阂，使得缓存局部性优化、避免无关函数干扰、延迟敏感型工作负载优先级处理等优化机会被浪费。此外，CFS不提供能够让控制面主动影响CPU负载均衡的接口，而Linux 6.12引入的SchedExt框架和eBPF技术使不修改内核即可实现自定义调度策略成为可能。
AI.method: 1. **自定义调度器设计**：基于SchedExt（SCX）框架开发eBPF调度器，将CPU划分为多个互斥的可配置"调度域"（scheduling domain），并通过共享eBPF map提供控制面接口；控制面写入"cgroup→域ID"的映射后，调度器在任务fork、唤醒或时间片到期时将其入队至对应域的优先队列。2. **单队列负载均衡**：每个调度域内维护一个FIFO/优先队列，空闲CPU从队头取任务（工作保留），域间通过邻居工作窃取（work-stealing）实现1ms量级开销下的最优负载均衡。3. **虚拟时间优先级策略（Algorithm 1）**：每n次入队将vtime重置为当前时间，其余入队则按 `vtime += last_cpu_time / sleep_frequency` 累积，从而优先调度睡眠频繁、CPU占用少的短任务，降低忙等待任务（占整个时间片但无有效工作）的优先级。4. **基于IAT的一致性哈希域分配策略（Algorithm 3）**：控制面将函数历史到达间隔时间按桶大小哈希到bucket_id，从缓存的候选域中选择可用域；高频函数复用相同域，提升暖核复用概率以节能。
AI.result: 基于Ilúvatar无服务器平台实现，使用打了SchedExt补丁的Linux 6.11.0-rc1内核，在48核Intel Xeon Platinum 8160服务器上运行Azure Functions轨迹（trace0–trace3，覆盖欠利用到过利用场景）。关键结果：（1）8域配置为最优折中，相比CFS降低系统能耗约15%，调用开销仅增加5%；（2）高负载系统（loadaverage=722）下请求延迟最多降低50%；（3）busy-polling任务占比约10%（通过指令指针方差识别），去优先级化这些任务提升能效；（4）多线程函数在1域和8域配置下优于CFS，但在16域配置下因单域仅3核而性能下降；16域配置退化为类似CFS的效果（每核独立队列，单队列优势消失）；（5）长运行单线程CPU密集型函数（如video-processing，0.74s）因调度器开销累积延迟增加约26.3%，但这类工作负载在无服务器场景中不常见。
AI.conclusion: 将CPU调度纳入无服务器控制面的职责范围是一条有前景的优化路径。通过控制面与基于eBPF的SchedExt调度器之间的轻量级接口，结合调度域、单队列负载均衡与虚拟时间优先级，可以在保持调度灵活性的同时显著提升能效与负载下的性能。8域配置在能效、开销与性能间达到了最佳平衡。未来方向包括自适应域大小调整策略、纳入更多工作负载特征到调度决策，以及将框架扩展到CPU、内存与异构加速器的联合优化。

title: RepoOMP: Repository-Aware Hotspot OpenMP Parallelization via Dependency-Aware Context Reduction
summary: OpenMP parallelization of hotspots in mature repositories remains difficult because loop safety and optimization payoff often depend on non-local evidence. Rule-based tools under-parallelize when legality is not locally provable, while agent-based approaches become unstable when retrieval misses decisive dependencies or includes irrelevant code. We present RepoOMP, a hybrid framework that recovers parallelization-relevant evidence before generation. RepoOMP builds a Multi-granularity Attributes Performance graph (MAP), routes hotspots between deterministic rules and an LLM agent, and constructs a Structured Transformation Context (STC) that exposes dependency facts without flooding the model with unrelated repository text. We evaluate RepoOMP on 951 profiled hotspots from NPB, BOTS, FFmpeg, NCNN, and GROMACS. Under compilation, workload-specific checks, and positive speedup, 372 hotspots are accepted, including 330 real-world repository hotspots. RepoOMP achieves average speedups of $8.23\times$ on NPB and $8.96\times$ on BOTS. For the nine detailed real-world kernels used in matched-backbone and robustness analyses, RepoOMP reaches a cross-backbone mean of $5.25\times$, improves speedup by 18--28\%, and reduces agent-side token cost by 47--68\% relative to the unstructured Claude Code baseline. Across 330 accepted real-world hotspots, median speedup is $2.25\times$. Overall, RepoOMP provides an evidence-guided workflow for hotspot parallelization in repository settings. The open-source repository is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: RepoOMP是一个用于在成熟代码仓库中进行OpenMP热点并行化的混合框架，通过构建多粒度属性性能图(MAP)、规则-智能体路由器(Classifier)和结构化转换上下文(STC)在生成前恢复仓库级依赖证据，在951个热点中接受372个(330个真实仓库热点)，NPB加速8.23×、BOTS加速8.96×、9个真实世界核平均5.25×，并降低47-68%的token成本。
AI.motivation: 成熟仓库中的OpenMP热点并行化面临非局部证据依赖难题：基于规则的工具因本地可证明性假设而漏并行化机会；基于LLM智能体的方法因检索缺失关键依赖或包含无关代码而不稳定。核心瓶颈在于恢复跨文件、跨函数、跨共享状态的依赖结构证据，决定循环并行化的安全性与收益。
AI.method: RepoOMP采用三阶段混合工作流：(1) 构建多粒度属性性能图(MAP)，以仓库/文件/函数三级节点与控制流/数据依赖边捕获热点位置、调用关系、共享状态访问摘要与运行时属性；(2) 规则-智能体路由器沿调用链自底向上传播依赖风险，将候选分为高置信度(规则引擎)、中置信度(LLM智能体+STC)、低置信度(保守处理)三路；(3) 中置信度路径构造结构化转换上下文(STC)，由目标代码切片、MAP查询的共享状态定义、LLM生成的相关调用链节点摘要组成，固定5字段序列化接口与固定模板提示。验证循环包括编译、工作负载执行检查、性能测量，失败时回滚。
AI.result: 在951个热点(NPB/BOTS/FFmpeg/NCNN/GROMACS)中，372个通过编译+工作负载检查+正加速度三关被接受，其中330个来自真实仓库。在16线程Intel上：NPB平均8.23×、BOTS平均8.96×。9个详细真实世界核的跨骨干模型平均5.25×，较Claude Code基线提升18-28%加速度、降低47-68% token成本。330个接受真实热点的中位数加速度2.25×，IQR 1.45-4.80×，145例≥2.0×。9核报告零BF/WA，变异系数<1%；ThreadSanitizer审计在9核上均降低警告数。消融研究证实移除STC或扁平化MAP会显著降低接受率并增加token成本，规则单独覆盖率仅约6-7%。
AI.conclusion: RepoOMP验证了"在生成前恢复仓库级依赖证据"是仓库级OpenMP并行化的有效路径：通过MAP显式恢复跨层依赖结构、路由器将失败模式转化为显式决策、STC为LLM提供有界转换接口，使智能体可基于结构化证据而非盲目检索进行转换。局限在于仍依赖静态可总结的依赖，对重指针别名、I/O主导路径、需深度重构的共享状态更新处理有限。未来工作将改进依赖精度、扩展至MPI/CUDA等优化目标。

title: Operating Multi-Node Full Fine-Tuning on NVIDIA B300: A Field Report on Telemetry-Based Triage, Negative Results, and Operational Hardening
summary: We report operational experience full-fine-tuning a 32.76B-parameter dense model (Qwen3-32B) on 16 x NVIDIA B300 (two nodes, FSDP / ZeRO-3) -- among the first published field accounts on this accelerator. We claim no new algorithm. The individual mechanisms we use are established practice; our contribution is the integrated field experience and a set of calibrated measurements on new hardware. Concretely we offer four practitioner artifacts. (1) A B300-calibrated power-draw triage table that distinguishes compute / communication / data-starvation / checkpoint-or-deadlock / idle by board wattage (utilization% reads 100% during an NCCL hang). (2) A set of honest negative results that dispel common optimization folklore at this scale: a controlled A/B in which per-step NFS reading matches a pretokenized local cache (~53k tok/s) because the corpus fits in page cache and the job is compute-bound; and a reconstruction of an earlier "throughput collapse" as NFS/CPU contention rather than a storage-medium limit. (3) Calibrated 4/8/16-GPU strong-scaling and GPU-hour numbers on B300 (near-linear, as expected in this regime; we report absolute values as reference data). (4) A worked failure case -- an epoch-end NCCL deadlock from per-rank token-packing imbalance -- together with a 2.7-second pre-run invariant gate and an external watcher that turn multi-hour silent failures into instant rejections. This deadlock and its remedy correspond to PyTorch's documented Join / equalize-to-minimum practice; we position our instantiation against that prior art and report the GPU-hours the failure cost and the gate saves. The transferable takeaway is operational, not algorithmic: for data-dependent data-parallel jobs, watch power rather than utilization, and verify invariants before launch -- a passing smoke test is not evidence of a safe full run.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于在 16 张 NVIDIA B300 GPU（双节点 FSDP/ZeRO-3）上对 Qwen3-32B（32.76B 参数）进行全参数微调的运维经验报告（field report）。论文不提出新算法，而是贡献四类实践工件：(1) 基于板卡功耗（而非 GPU 利用率）的 B300 校准故障分诊表；(2) 关于本地缓存与 NFS 性能负结果的诚实对照实验；(3) 4/8/16 GPU 的强扩展校准参考数据；(4) 由 per-rank token-packing 不平衡引发的 epoch 末端 NCCL 死锁案例，及一个 2.7 秒的预运行不变式门禁和外部看门狗。核心可迁移的经验是：在数据依赖的数据并行任务中，应观察功耗而非利用率，并在启动前验证不变式——烟雾测试通过不等于整次运行安全。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型训练多关注算法与并行策略创新，但对全新硬件（如 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra B300，2025–26 投产）的运维经验极度稀缺。GPU 利用率（utilization%）在 NCCL 死锁、数据饥饿、检查点等状态下都可能读为 100%，无法反映真实进度；常见优化"民间传说"（如将数据集预分词到本地缓存一定能提速）在该规模下未经实测验证；同时 per-rank 输入不均会在数据并行中引发不易被烟雾测试发现的死锁，造成大量 GPU·小时浪费。作者以双节点 B300 集群实测为依托，弥补上述运维知识缺口。
AI.method: （1）基于 nvidia-smi 的板卡功耗（power.draw）查询，建立 B300 校准功耗分诊带：~940–1040 W（计算）/ ~640 W（通信）/ ~575 W（数据饥饿）/ ~190–195 W（死锁或检查点）/ ~135 W（空闲），并结合 per-rank 利用率形状（rank-0-only-0% vs. one-rank-0%-rest-100%）和 NCCL flight recorder 进行区分。（2）控制变量 A/B 测试：在 16 GPU 上对比"每步从 NFS 读取 + 实时分词"与"预分词 packing 到节点本地 NVMe 缓存"两种数据路径，每种 300 步，分别测试冷/热页缓存。（3）跨 4/8/16 GPU 完成整 epoch 强扩展测量，分别 15,420/7,710/3,854 步。（4）实战复现一个 epoch 末端 NCCL 死锁：通过功耗 + flight recorder 定位 rank 3 在 dist.barrier() 中而其余 15 个 rank 仍在 reduce_scatter；根因为 per-rank 打包块数不均（min=30,835，max=30,888，spread=53，0.17%）。修复采用 "evenfix"：在循环前 all_reduce(MIN) 块数，每 rank 用 if blk_idx>=min_blocks: break 截断至统一最小步数；并加入 6 项预运行门禁（含块数平衡、token 总数、GPU 占用、master_port 空闲、检查点磁盘空间）和外部 session-independent watcher。
AI.result: （1）B300 功耗分诊表可在秒级区分计算/通信/数据饥饿/死锁/检查点/空闲；利用率为 100% 在多种停滞态下同时出现，需配合功耗与 per-rank 形状判别。（2）数据路径 A/B：三组 tok/s 分别为 52.8k（冷 NFS）、53.0k（热 NFS）、53.0k（本地缓存），差异 ≤0.5%；原因为语料仅 ~4 GB 完全驻留于 4 TB 节点 RAM 页缓存，且即使真冷读 4 GB 也仅 ~3 s，不敌 ~5 s 的 FSDP 步长。早期"52k→21k 吞吐坍塌"被重新定位为单线程分词 + NFS 争用，而非存储介质瓶颈。（3）4/8/16 GPU 强扩展效率 100%/100%/99%，per-GPU tok/s 在 3,313–3,350 间（差异 ~1%），每 epoch GPU·小时守恒于 ~84，2 节点 IB 仅带来 ~1% 税；loss 在 4/8/16 GPU 下分别为 0.674/0.673/0.67，扩展不影响收敛。（4）死锁事故成本：~48 GPU·h（卡死 3 h 等待看门狗）+ ~85 GPU·h（不可恢复进度）≈ ~130 GPU·h（约 1.5 epoch）。evenfix 丢弃每 rank 至多 53 块（~0.085% token）。预运行门禁 6 项检查耗时 2.71 s，启动后 16 GPU epoch 一次过（rc=0，loss 0.67，53.0k tok/s），epoch 末端检查点干净完成；负结果：~1.6× 吞吐损失证实梯度检查点在 82 GB/275 GB 内存充裕时纯属浪费。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明在数据依赖的数据并行训练中，基于 GPU 板卡功耗（而非 utilization%）的分诊方法在 B300 上能可靠秒级识别多种运行态；通过诚实负结果纠正了"NFS 必为瓶颈"和"梯度检查点必开"两类常见误解；4/8/16 GPU 强扩展接近线性（~99%）且 GPU·小时守恒，提示在该规模下 SHARP 等网络内聚合收益 <1%。epoch 末端 NCCL 死锁（per-rank packing 不平衡）与 PyTorch 文档化的 Join/drop_last 失败同源，在 FSDP 下需手工用 all_reduce(MIN) 等价于最小步数（evenfix）才能根除。一个 2.71 秒的不变式门禁加外部 watcher 可将一次 ~130 GPU·h 的静默故障挡在提交之后。可迁移的核心经验是运营性的而非算法性的：观察功耗而非利用率、启动前验证不变式——烟雾测试通过不等于整次运行安全。论文明确声明不主张算法新颖性，定位为新硬件上的聚焦式 field note，与超大规模（数千 GPU）训练可靠性报告互补。

title: TensorCast: The Missing Tensor Management Layer in Large Language Model Infrastructure
summary: Modern LLM infrastructure increasingly manages tensors not only as computation data, but also as persistent states shared across distributed components. Existing systems optimize individual tensor management tasks, such as model weight loading, KV cache management, and checkpoint synchronization, by deeply integrating task-specific mechanisms with execution engines, networks, or storage backends. However, this specialization creates isolated silos that hinder the reuse and composition of tensor management strategies across evolving LLM workloads. In this paper, we identify tensor lifecycle management as a missing abstraction layer in LLM infrastructure and propose Tensor-as-a-Service (TaaS), which decouples tensor state management from computation logic. We design and build TensorCast, a distributed tensor management layer that provides first-class tensor abstractions, programmable lifecycle primitives, and a runtime that separates tensor management policies from execution mechanisms. This enables developers to write tensor management programs using TensorCast APIs while transparently leveraging distributed execution and data movement. We integrate TensorCast with vLLM and SGLang and evaluate it across diverse tensor lifecycle workloads, including model weight materialization, weight synchronization, KV cache management, and programmable request routing. Our results show that TensorCast achieves competitive performance with specialized tensor management systems while enabling new cross-component optimization policies. A programmable policy implemented with TensorCast improves median TTFT by up to 93.2% under highly concurrent multi-turn agent workloads.

AI.tldr: TensorCast提出了一种新的"Tensor-as-a-Service (TaaS)"抽象层，将张量生命周期管理与LLM计算逻辑解耦。它是一个分布式张量管理层，提供一级张量抽象、可编程生命周期原语，并通过策略-机制分离的运行时执行。集成vLLM和SGLang后，在模型权重加载、KV缓存管理、检查点同步等场景中达到与专用系统相当的性能，并支持跨组件优化策略（如多轮智能体场景下TTFT最高降低93.2%）。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM基础设施中，张量不仅是计算数据，还成为跨分布式组件共享的持久状态（如模型权重、KV缓存、检查点）。现有的专用化优化方案（Mooncake、LMCache、HiCache等）将张量生命周期管理与执行引擎、网络、存储深度耦合，形成"垂直孤岛"，导致机制重复实现、跨工作负载策略难以组合、新兴工作负载（如多轮Agent、推理树）缺乏可编程的张量管理能力。
AI.method:
1. **抽象设计**：提出TaaS范式，包含四个核心编程抽象——Artifact（张量标识与所有权）、Operation（生命周期操作）、Plan（分布式工作流组合DAG）、Signal（运行时反馈信号）。
2. **系统架构**：基于caller-worker编程模型，包含Worker（basic/gateway/shard home三种角色）、Instance（执行引擎接口适配）、Global Store（轻量级控制平面元数据服务）。
3. **统一张量池**：区分低基数张量（模型权重，集中式GS管理）和高基数张量（KV缓存，分片+HRW哈希+租约机制管理），避免GS成为瓶颈。
4. **生命周期原语**：识别identify、place、move、materialize、transform、compose/coordinate等共享原语。
5. **策略-机制分离**：执行引擎仅通过Instance Adaptor暴露最小接口，张量管理策略由caller通过可编程API组合实现。
6. **实现**：约160K行C++运行时 + 95K行Python SDK，使用gRPC、RDMA、CUDA IPC、用户态mTCP等技术。
AI.result:
- **权重加载（Qwen3-30B-A3B）**：TensorCast-cold相比Default和InstantTensor分别加速60.7×和10.2×；TensorCast-warm通过CUDA IPC实现预物化，端到端加速达228.6×。
- **权重同步**：相比默认更新器，加速1.14×–2.63×。
- **KV缓存管理**：在TP=2、TP=8配置下，与Mooncake性能相当（RDMA场景TTFT降低60%–87.5%）；无RDMA场景显著优于Mooncake（得益于用户态mTCP多路径传输）。
- **可编程路由**：基于TensorCast API实现的负载均衡+KV局部性感知路由器，在128/256并发多轮智能体会话下，相比Moonake后端的负载感知路由器，中位TTFT分别降低71.4%、93.2%、70.4%（fast/medium/slow三档工作负载）。
AI.conclusion: TensorCast通过引入张量生命周期管理的独立抽象层，证明了通用张量管理抽象可以同时实现专用系统的效率和新兴工作负载所需的可编程性。其策略-机制分离设计使开发者能够在不修改执行引擎的前提下组合新的跨组件优化策略，是LLM基础设施从"优化张量计算"向"可编程控制张量生命周期"演进的重要一步。论文开源了系统实现。

title: Routing LLM Inference to the Cleanest Grid in Real Time
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Live multi-region GPU validation plus a one-year historical marginal-emissions replay
summary: Large-language-model inference is a fast-growing electricity load whose marginal carbon intensity varies by more than an order of magnitude across grid regions and across the day, making request placement an attractive lever: no retraining, no hardware change. We report a live validation of carbon-aware inference routing on multi-region GPU testbeds driven by marginal operating emissions rate (MOER) signals, with three properties uncommon in prior work: a blind baseline that is an actual production pressure-based router rather than uniform placement; per-request energy attributed from GPU telemetry (NVIDIA DCGM) via measured concurrency curves rather than nameplate TDP; and carbon settlement of every request against historical MOER, not only the forecast that drove the decision. The central live result is feasibility: a MOER signal steered inference across regions with no observed dispatch failures, as a strict and reversible overlay on the production router. To size the effect, we replay a year of hourly MOER across a grid-diverse CONUS fleet. In the primary modeled configuration, carbon-aware placement reduces modeled GPU-attributable operational emissions by 50.9% versus round-robin (95% block-bootstrap CI 48.5-53.3%). Because the replay dispatches against historical MOER rather than a forecast, this is an upper bound under that configuration; forecast error would reduce operationally realized savings. Before session pinning, hourly lowest-MOER routing contributes about 22.4 percentage points, roughly 40% of the 54.0% placement reduction, beyond a static annual-mean-MOER policy. These are modeled results for one fleet and historical year, not a universal estimate. We also record a practical observation: when comparing regions, rank by absolute MOER rather than the percentile signal-index, which is normalized within each region and answers a temporal, not a spatial, question.

AI.tldr: 该论文在真实多区域 GPU 测试床上验证了基于 WattTime MOER（边际运行排放率）信号的 LLM 推理碳感知路由可行性，并以一年的历史 MOER 回放估算潜在减排幅度（50.9% vs 轮询），同时提出跨区域路由应使用绝对 MOER 而非百分位信号指数的重要实践发现。
AI.motivation: LLM 推理负载快速增长且具有地理灵活性，而不同电网区域和不同时段的边际碳强度差异超过一个数量级，因此推理请求的路由放置（即"在哪、何时"运行）成为一个低门槛的减碳杠杆——无需重训模型、无需更换硬件，只需调度决策即可。先前碳感知计算工作多针对批处理/可延迟负载或使用统一分配基线，缺乏在生产路由器之上的真实多区域部署验证，也未解决跨区域碳信号选择的关键问题。
AI.method: 1) 设计一个默认关闭、可逆的乘法式碳感知叠加层，在 Solyx AI 生产压力路由器权重上按 (1 - w×intensity) 缩放每个单元的调度权重；2) 通过 NVIDIA DCGM 在不同并发度下实测 GPU 功耗曲线，拟合每输出 token 焦耳数（Phase-0 能源刻画），而非使用铭牌 TDP；3) 在 A100 和 H100 双区域测试床上（A100: AZPS vs PJM-DC，H100: ERCOT-NC vs SOCO）进行多日活负载 A/B 实验，五个路由组并发运行；4) 调度用 MOER 预测，事后结算用 WattTime 历史 MOER；5) 在 19 个 CONUS 区域、365 天历史小时 MOER 上进行回放，使用 5 天块自助法计算置信区间，分解为静态（年均 MOER）与动态（实时）贡献。
AI.result: 1) 活体可行性：MOER 信号在多日无监督运行中驱动跨区域真实推理负载迁移，约 196 万请求回合，零调度失败，碳叠加层完全可逆；A100 测试中 eco-high 组结算排放比盲压路由组低 1.45%；2) 历史回放主要配置下，碳感知路由在 50%/区域容量上限内使 GPU 归属运营排放降低 50.9%（vs 轮询）和 51.0%（vs 模拟碳盲负载均衡），95% 块自助 CI 48.5–53.3%；3) 实时信号贡献：在可自由放置分解中，动态每小时最低 MOER 路由贡献约 22.4 个百分点（约占 54% 总减少量的 40%），超出静态年均 MOER 策略；4) 端到端定容上限的 23%（软乘数策略）到 34–51%（激进清洁优先 + 不同零 MOER 信用处理）范围；5) 关键实践发现：跨区域比较应使用绝对 MOER 而非百分位信号指数——百分位相对各区域自身分布归一化，会反转绝对排放排序（如 ERCOT-NC 宽摆幅分布中较高百分位可能对应绝对更低碳）。
AI.conclusion: 信号驱动的工作负载迁移今天在生产推理架构上已具备可行性：WattTime MOER 信号能以可逆叠加层形式在真实多区域 GPU 测试床上引导推理路由，活体运行无调度失败。历史回放在指定条件下量化潜在幅度（约 23–51% 范围）。静态电网选址占大多数碳减排，而实时信号约占 40% 的"动态增量"——价值集中在跟随小时级弃电时段。实践结论是任何跨区域路由应按绝对 MOER 排序，把百分位信号指数留给区域内时序调度。剩余工作包括添加物理头部空间约束、把能源并发曲线和前缀缓存局部性耦合进路由决策，以及联合 WattTime 发布跨区域语义指导。

title: DG-FedReuse: Proxy-Gradient-Gated Cached-Update Reuse with Matched Sparse Uplink Accounting
summary: Federated learning repeatedly incurs local optimization and model-update transmission. We study DG-FedReuse, a simulator-level mechanism that allows selected clients to contribute age-decayed cached updates when a stochastic head-gradient discrepancy proxy remains below a round-dependent threshold. A hard cache-age limit and minimum fresh-client quota constrain reuse, while fresh updates use an adaptive per-tensor Top-K numerical-field representation. Experiments cover six image-classification datasets, 50 virtual clients, Dirichlet label heterogeneity ({\alpha}=0.5), and three seeds. At a common 90-round budget, DG-FedReuse yields 83.36-85.42% modeled update-data-field uplink saving, compared with 76.88% for matched Top-K FedAvg; the seed-aligned accuracy differences range from -5.29 to -0.14 percentage points. Best-observed test accuracies obtained under test-controlled checkpointing are retained only as exploratory archival evidence and range from -2.38 to +0.45 percentage points relative to matched FedAvg. A symmetric dense-model-downlink sensitivity reduces the headline saving to 41.68-F42.71% and the incremental gain over Top-K FedAvg to 3.24-4.27 percentage points, demonstrating the dependence of communication conclusions on the accounting boundary. The study characterizes the proposed reuse rule in the implemented simulator; it does not establish unbiased generalization, end-to-end bandwidth reduction, runtime or energy savings, faster convergence, or superiority over existing stale-update and lazy-aggregation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DG-FedReuse，一种联邦学习模拟器级机制，通过随机头部梯度差异代理门控决定客户端使用新鲜本地训练还是年龄衰减的缓存更新。在90轮固定预算下，相比匹配Top-K FedAvg，模型化更新数据场上行节省从76.88%提升至83.36-85.42%，但伴随0.14-5.29个百分点的精度下降；加入密集下行后节省比例降至41.68-42.71%。研究为机制实现与证据研究，未建立无偏泛化、端到端带宽或收敛优越性结论。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在异构数据与部分参与场景下通信开销显著。现有的通信高效方法（量化、稀疏化、误差反馈等）主要压缩新鲜更新，但已有方法（MIFA、FedStale、3PC、FedLUAR等）已证明历史/陈旧更新可被算法化利用。本文研究一种特殊的门控机制组合——随机代理梯度差异门、缓存年龄上限、新鲜客户端配额、年龄衰减以及匹配的稀疏数值域统计——是否在固定通信轮预算下提供额外的模型化上行节省并伴随何种精度变化。
AI.method: 机制设计：(1)随机代理梯度差异D_{i,t}=1−cos(p_{i,t}, h_i)，使用分类头参数的mini-batch梯度与缓存签名计算；(2)轮次相关阈值τ_t=max(τ_min, τ_0·e^{−γt})，新鲜触发条件为D_{i,t}≥τ_t或缓存年龄超限或无缓存；(3)最小新鲜客户端配额⌈qm⌉，不足时按D_{i,t}降序提升；(4)新鲜客户端执行近端SGD，自适应Top-K(r=0.2)稀疏化后存储为密集形状张量；(5)复用客户端贡献ρ^{a_{i,t}}·Δ̂_i，按样本加权聚合；(6)采用样本加权聚合规则，带τ_0=0.9117、τ_min=0.8135、γ=0.01、S=4、ρ=0.728、q=0.30、μ=3.42e−4的冻结超参数。评估采用单进程模拟器，6个图像分类数据集（MNIST/FashionMNIST/EMNIST/PathMNIST/CIFAR-10/100），50虚拟客户端，Dirichlet α=0.5，3种子，固定90轮预算，匹配Top-K FedAvg/FedProx作为机制对照。
AI.result: 固定90轮预算主要结果：DG-FedReuse模型化更新上行节省83.36-85.42%，匹配Top-K FedAvg为76.88%，增量6.48-8.54个百分点；但seed对齐精度差为-5.29（CIFAR-10）至-0.14（EMNIST）个百分点，所有数据集精度均下降。密集下行对称敏感性分析：节省比例降至41.68-42.71%，增量仅3.24-4.27个百分点。探索性测试控制存档结果（不视为无偏最终测试估计）：精度差-2.38至+0.45个百分点。FedAdam辅助分析在测试控制停止下记录更高精度但同样存在选择偏差。复用单独运行贡献32.43-37.28%节省但不构成2×2析因设计。
AI.conclusion: 在评估的模拟器下，DG-FedReuse在90轮固定通信预算下将匹配Top-K FedAvg的模型化更新上行节省从76.88%提升至83.36-85.42%，但代价是六任务中0.14-5.29个百分点的seed对齐精度下降。加入一个密集模型下行后通信比例降至41.68-42.71%，表明仅基于上行的头条数字在双向密集参考下会被高估。该研究表明实现机制改变了模型化通信-精度权衡。研究明确不建立无偏泛化估计、端到端带宽降低、运行时/能量节省、收敛优越性或对现有陈旧更新/惰性聚合/压缩方法的优越性——这些需要验证控制、就近基线、析因与分布式系统实验。

title: Learning to Rank Tensor Network Contraction Plans for GPU-Accelerated Quantum Circuit Simulation
summary: Classical simulation remains essential for developing and validating quantum algorithms, but its cost grows rapidly with circuit size. Tensor-network contraction can reduce this cost by exploiting circuit structure, although its efficiency depends strongly on the chosen contraction plan. On GPUs, plans with similar theoretical complexity may perform very differently because execution also depends on parallelism, reduction structure, memory traffic, and contraction geometry. We present a learning-to-rank framework for selecting efficient contraction plans before executing them. Each plan is represented by structural features derived directly from its sequence of pairwise contractions, and gradient-boosted rankers are trained from GPU measurements using listwise and pairwise objectives. We evaluate the resulting models on diverse circuit families, using separate in-distribution and circuit-family-shift test sets, and compare them with random and MinFill-based baselines. The learned rankers generally identify better plans, with the listwise model providing the strongest overall decision quality. We also study backend shift by comparing empirical plan orderings on two GPU architectures and evaluating the source-trained models on the second device without retraining. The rankings remain substantially, though not perfectly, stable across GPUs, and the models retain useful decision quality. These results support Learning to Rank as a practical way to reduce contraction-plan search, while showing that performance remains partly backend dependent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Learning to Rank（LTR）的框架，用于在GPU上执行量子线路模拟前预选高效的张量网络收缩计划。通过直接从收缩路径的结构派生特征，训练基于XGBoost的listwise与pairwise排序模型，在NVIDIA RTX A6000与V100两种GPU上验证了模型的有效性与跨后端迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 量子线路的经典模拟对算法开发与验证至关重要，但状态向量法随量子比特数指数增长。张量网络收缩可利用线路结构降低模拟成本，但效率高度依赖于所选收缩计划。在GPU上，即使理论复杂度相近的计划也可能因并行性、归约结构、内存流量与收缩几何等因素而性能差异巨大。然而逐一执行候选计划以测量时间成本过高，因此需要一种能在执行前筛选高效计划的方法。
AI.method: 将GPU收缩计划选择建模为分组Learning to Rank问题：每个线路的候选收缩计划构成一个排序组，目标是选出Top-1或Top-3高效计划。特征工程直接从收缩路径序列派生结构描述子（无需执行），包括五个特征组：(1)复杂度/关键负载（瓶颈、总工作量、近关键尾部、异质性）；(2)序列/粒度（碎片化、微小步骤比例）；(3)并行性动态（输出端并行度，含峰值、平均、加权与瓶颈处）；(4)归约/计算强度（最大归约维度与加权归约）；(5)几何/内存访问（收缩不对称性、shape平衡性）。每个步骤以GEMM形式（M×K·K×N→M×N）建模，提取四个原始量：工作指数c_i、输出指数p_i、归约指数k_i、几何不对称度d_i。训练标签采用相对MinFill计划的加速比对数log(1+Sp)。使用XGBoost的rank:ndcg与rank:pairwise目标，225个线路组（每组7个候选计划），开发集138组、ID测试集25组、QFT族OOD测试集62组，并在RTX A6000与Tesla V100两套GPU上测量。
AI.result: ID测试集上，opt_ndcg取得Top-1=60.0%、Top-3=96.0%、Regret1=0.0141、Regret3=0.0004、胜率92.0%，opt_pair略低；两者均显著优于随机基线与MinFill基线。OOD（QFT族）测试中性能下降，opt_ndcg的Top-3降至62.9%，Top-1=38.71%，但仍优于随机基线与MinFill基线。零样本跨GPU迁移（Ampere→Volta）中，opt_ndcg的Top-3仅下降4个百分点至92.0%，表明固定训练模型在不同后端仍保留有用的决策能力。两GPU在84.0%的线路中选择相同最优计划，Top-3集合平均重叠89.63%，Kendall τ_b均值为0.845，但QFT族最低（τ_b=0.710）。
AI.conclusion: 结构特征驱动的Learning to Rank框架能在执行前有效识别高效收缩计划，NDCG目标的listwise模型整体决策质量最佳。该方法支持跨电路族的部分迁移，并在Ampere与Volta两套GPU之间保留有用的排序能力，但性能仍部分依赖于后端，并非硬件无关。未来工作包括扩大候选集规模、进行更严格的按启发式族域偏移实验，以及引入显式硬件/软件栈描述符以支持条件化排序与少量校准数据下的后端适配。

title: Towards a Risk Assessment of Malicious Skill Files in Coding Agents
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Preprint; under review
summary: Autonomous coding agents are increasingly embedded in enterprise software workflows with delegated authority over connected systems. Central to this architecture is the agent skills interface: folders of instructions and scripts that agents load dynamically to specialize their behavior. This interface also widens the attack surface, letting malicious shell commands hide within natural-language skill files. We make three contributions. First, an adversarial skill-synthesis method using six LLMs across four families to transform 471 real-world shell commands into benign-appearing skills, released as a benchmark of 2,826 skills mapped to 11 MITRE ATT&CK tactics. Second, a reproducible evaluation pipeline coupling run stratification, evidence anchoring, a refusal veto, and a deterministic declared-intent override with a three-judge LLM-as-a-judge panel, validated against a blind human gold standard (Cohen's kappa = 0.85). Third, a large-scale characterization of two enterprise-grade agents across 5,629 completed runs. Gemini CLI is exploited in 95.5-96.1% of runs and Qwen Code in 71.6-74.0% (raw majority vote to declared-intent-corrected estimate, both within the human gold standard), nearly invariant to the generating model. Explicit safety recognition occurs in only 1.99% of runs. Enterprises must assess and mitigate skill-interface risk before adopting coding agents. Our code and dataset are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文首次对企业级编码代理（Gemini CLI 与 Qwen Code）在"技能文件接口"下的恶意技能攻击风险进行了大规模实证评估，揭示了当前代理在面对伪装成良性自然语言描述的恶意 shell 命令时存在极高的可利用性。
AI.motivation: 随着 Claude Code、Copilot、Gemini CLI、Cursor 等自主编码代理在企业软件开发流程中获得委托权限（包括终端访问和系统级权限），其"技能文件接口"——一种通过自然语言指令文件动态扩展代理行为的机制——成为新型攻击面。OWASP 已将此类威胁列为 AST01 关键级别。然而，现有研究主要关注编码代理的功能正确性（如 SWE-bench、HumanEval），对其在对抗性技能文件下的安全脆弱性缺乏量化评估，企业级部署风险未知。
AI.method: 研究采用三阶段方法：(1) 攻击技能合成——基于 Atomic Red Team 库的 471 条真实 Linux shell 命令（覆盖 11 种 MITRE ATT&CK 战术），使用 6 个跨 4 个模型家族的 LLM（GPT-5-mini、GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、GPT-4.1-mini、Llama-3-8B、DeepSeek-R1）将其包装为"强制性预检命令"（mandatory preflight）的良性语义描述，最终生成 2,826 个对抗性技能文件；(2) 沙箱执行——在隔离环境中以"构建简单 Web 应用"为固定任务，将恶意技能文件注入仓库，由两个企业级代理（Gemini CLI gemini-3-flash、Qwen Code qwen3-coder-plus）在 120 秒时限、自动批准委托权限下完成 5,629 次有效运行；(3) 可利用性评估——设计含运行分层、证据锚定（evidence anchoring）、拒绝否决（refusal veto）、确定性声明意图覆盖（declared-intent override）的三评审 LLM-as-a-judge 面板（Llama-3-8B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B 本地部署），并通过盲法人类黄金标准验证（Qwen Cohen's κ=0.85，Gemini κ=0.83）。
AI.result: RQ1 结果：Gemini CLI 在 95.5%–96.1% 的运行中被利用，Qwen Code 在 71.6%–74.0% 的运行中被利用（区间跨越原始多数票与声明意图修正估计），差距约 22–24 个百分点且置信区间不重叠。可利用性几乎不受技能生成模型影响（Gemini 在 95.5%–96.8% 区间，Qwen 在 67.7%–76.9% 区间）。三评审面板在 Gemini 上达成中等一致性（Fleiss κ=0.51），但在 Qwen 上仅达成偶然一致性（κ=−0.06），表明单评审方法可能对 Qwen 误判超过 20 个百分点。RQ2 结果：明确安全拒绝仅占所有运行的 1.99%（Gemini 失败中 15.3%，Qwen 失败中 13.0%）；大多数未利用运行源于代理忽略预检步骤（39.6%–51.5%）、引用但不执行（25.4%–45.0%），或 Qwen 特有的"脱离任务"范围门控（10.1%，Gemini 为 0%）。RQ3 结果：跨代理合并后，初始访问（Initial Access，91.2%）和防御绕过（Defense Evasion，90.4%）最易被利用，而数据外泄（Exfiltration，67.2%）和影响（Impact，72.3%）最不易被利用；Gemini 在所有战术上均高度脆弱（按战术均值 95.6%，范围 87.9%–97.9%），而 Qwen 表现显著差异（按战术均值 66.3%），对外泄战术仅 38.5%，表明其对网络密集型命令有更强范围识别能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示编码代理技能接口是企业软件开发生命周期中一个关键但防御不足的攻击面，"信任即默认"架构导致 Gemini CLI 类代理几乎可被任何语义伪装的技能文件劫持，而 Qwen Code 的"范围门控"机制提供了部分但有限的韧性。企业应：(1) 对工具构建者——采用分层权限模型，高风险操作（如 shell 执行）需人工批准；(2) 对企业采用者——将第三方技能视为未经核实的二进制文件，实施严格技能治理；(3) 对安全组织——优先审计防御绕过与初始访问类技能，结合启发式模式匹配与 LLM-as-a-judge 筛查描述与实际载荷的语义差距。研究建议实施"摄入前技能扫描器"作为低成本缓解措施，并指出该实证表征应推动跨代理、跨任务、对自然发生技能的更广泛评估。

title: Improving Debugging in Verification-Aware Languages Through Automated Fault Localization: A Case Study in Dafny
summary: Verification-aware languages, like Dafny, integrate formal specifications directly into source code to enable static correctness checks. However, when verification fails, the feedback provided is often limited to the specific condition of the error, such as a violated postcondition, rather than the root cause of the fault. While Dafny's counterexample features provide concrete execution traces, these typically expose a single failing path per assertion failure, leaving the developer to manually look through the entire trace to locate the error. This paper investigates automated fault localization for verification-aware languages by comparing two paradigms: state-based and counterexample-based localization. Our state-based localization strategy replicates the ``snapshot'' methodology of AutoFix by inferring invariants and predicates to identify suspicious program states. The counterexample-based strategy consists of a family of techniques that progressively enrich the use of verifier output: from raw counterexample extraction, to structured single-trace ranking, and to multi-trace aggregation. To validate these methods, we present an evaluation framework using MutDafny to generate a diverse mutant dataset from DafnyBench and measure localization effectiveness using the EXAM score. Our results show that counterexample-based approaches substantially outperform state-based localization in this setting. Structured ranking over a single trace yields the largest improvement over raw counterexample output, while multi-trace aggregation provides additional gains in robustness and debugging utility by increasing coverage and reducing path bias introduced by the solver. These findings demonstrate that effective fault localization in verification-aware languages depends both on using counterexample information, and how that information is structured and diversified.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Dafny验证感知语言中的自动故障定位问题，比较了基于状态（SNAP）和基于反例（CNTB/CNTS/CNTM）两大范式，并加入LLM基线。实验基于MutDafny生成的500个DafnyBench变异体，使用EXAM分数评估。结果表明：基于反例的方法显著优于基于状态的方法，其中多路径聚合（CNTM）效果最佳（Top-1达43%）；LLM在Top-1上更强但整体排名质量与可靠性不及CNTM。
AI.motivation: 验证感知语言（如Dafny）将形式规约嵌入代码中，可在编译时验证正确性。但当验证失败时，验证器通常仅反馈违反的后置条件及一条失败路径，缺乏对根因故障的定位能力。开发者需在大量代码行中手动排查根因，调试效率低下。现有AutoFix工具虽为Eiffel提供基于状态的定位方法，但其在静态验证环境下的适用性存疑，且未充分利用求解器原生反例。亟需一种系统化、能直接利用验证器信息的故障定位方法。
AI.method:
1) 基于状态的定位方法SNAP：复现AutoFix的"snapshot"范式，通过Daikon动态推断不变式与程序中枚举的布尔谓词来识别可疑程序状态，结合控制依赖、表达式依赖和基于频谱的动态得分计算可疑度。
2) 基于反例的定位方法家族：CNTB直接从Dafny CLI提取单条失败路径中涉及的行；CNTS在此基础上引入结构感知（频次、嵌套深度、控制语句类型）进行排序；CNTM（主要贡献）通过迭代路径阻断机制（注入assume false阻断已发现路径）强制SMT求解器多样化，收集多条独立失败路径后聚合排序。
3) 评估框架：使用MutDafny对DafnyBench的785个程序生成变异体，从中筛选500个有效样本，采用EXAM分数、Top-k命中率、Found/Empty率在文件域与方法域进行双域评估。
4) LLM基线：使用qwen3-coder-next模型，配合纯代码输入、含错误消息及与CNTM混合三种变体。
AI.result: 在500个Dafny变异体的实验上：1) 基于反例的方法大幅优于基于状态的方法——CNTM文件域EXAM仅0.109，而SNAP为0.324，且SNAP有39.2%的空输出率（主要受限于测试生成工具），Found率仅47%，远低于CNTM的84%。2) CNTM显著优于CNTB和CNTS，Top-1从12%→27%→43%，EXAM从0.243→0.127→0.109，验证了多路径聚合与结构感知排序的价值。3) 消融研究表明，深度启发式贡献最大（去除后Top-1从43%降至22%），频次与控制流启发式次之。4) LLM基线Top-1准确率达58%，显著高于CNTM（43%），但EXAM（0.159）和Found率（72.6%）均不及CNTM，且表现长尾分布。LLM_ER变体反而降低性能，说明错误消息信息量有限。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了在验证感知语言中，基于反例的故障定位方法相较基于状态的方法具有显著优势，其关键在于充分利用验证器的原生反例信息并进行结构化排序与多路径多样化聚合。CNTM作为确定性、验证器原生的方法，能提供稳定且覆盖面广的故障定位；LLM则在Top-1优先级上具备优势但可靠性不足。两者具有互补性，未来研究方向包括开发结合反例信息与LLM推理能力的混合方法。此外，研究也表明排名的结构感知（尤其是嵌套深度）是将故障定位到根因的关键因素。

title: Reasoning from Traces: Divergence-Guided Agentic Repair of WebAssembly Discrepancies
summary: WebAssembly (Wasm) promises seamless reuse of C/C++ codebases as portable, fast, sandboxed binaries. In practice, however, this promise often falls short: recent studies show that cross-compiling the same C/C++ source to Wasm and native binaries frequently leads to runtime discrepancies, owing to library implementation differences or compiler bugs. Since the root causes lie in the platform-level runtime and are hidden beneath the source code, even state-of-the-art LLM-based repair agents often fail to fix these discrepancies. In this paper, we present WasmMend, the first system to automatically repair Native-Wasm functional discrepancies. WasmMend converts the undirected exploration to a focused reasoning task in two stages: First, a novel differential trace analysis approach localizes the function where Wasm and native executions initially diverge; guided by this localization, LLM agents then reason about the root causes and generate patches that eliminate the divergent behavior. Experiments on real-world C/C++ projects show that WasmMend achieves a fix rate of 70.0%, compared to 50.2% for the agentic baseline and 54.5\% for the approach augmented with repair-time LLM-based instrumentation, demonstrating the value of divergence-guided reasoning for cross-platform repair.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WasmMend,首个自动修复Native-Wasm功能差异的系统,通过差分执行轨迹分析定位执行分歧函数,再引导LLM智能体推理根因并生成补丁,实验显示修复率达70.0%,显著优于基线方法(50.2%)和基于LLM插桩增强方法(54.5%)。
AI.motivation: WebAssembly (Wasm) 承诺实现 C/C++ 代码库作为可移植、快速、沙箱化二进制文件的无缝复用,但实际中由于库实现差异或编译器缺陷,跨编译同一 C/C++ 源码到 Wasm 和原生二进制时常产生运行时功能差异。由于根本原因位于平台级运行时并隐藏在源代码之下,即使是最先进的基于 LLM 的修复智能体也常常无法修复这些差异,因此需要专门针对跨平台差异的自动修复方法。
AI.method: WasmMend 采用两阶段方法将无方向的探索转化为聚焦的推理任务:第一阶段,提出新颖的差分执行轨迹分析 (differential trace analysis) 方法,定位 Wasm 与原生执行最初发生分歧的函数;第二阶段,在该定位的引导下,LLM 智能体推理差异产生的根本原因,并生成消除分歧行为的补丁。
AI.result: 在真实世界 C/C++ 项目上的实验表明,WasmMend 实现了 70.0% 的修复率,而智能体基线方法为 50.2%,使用基于 LLM 的修复时插桩增强方法为 54.5%,证明了分歧引导推理 (divergence-guided reasoning) 对跨平台修复的重要价值。
AI.conclusion: WasmMend 通过将差分执行轨迹分析与 LLM 智能体的推理能力相结合,显著提升了 Native-Wasm 跨平台功能差异的自动修复效果。其核心贡献在于将无方向的代码探索转化为由分歧定位驱动的聚焦推理任务,为跨平台二进制兼容性问题的自动修复提供了有效的新范式。

title: Exploring Dependence, Overreliance, and Addiction Related Behaviors Associated with Large Language Model Use Among Software Engineers
summary: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) has changed how software engineers perform everyday development activities. While these systems provide substantial support for tasks such as code generation, debugging, and documentation, their increasing integration into professional workflows has also raised questions regarding developers' reliance on these tools and the emergence of dependence, overreliance, and addiction-related behaviors. This study investigates how software engineers experience the use of LLMs during professional software development, with attention to behavioral patterns associated with dependence, overreliance, and addiction-related behaviors. An exploratory survey was conducted with 119 software practitioners. The data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and qualitative thematic analysis of participants' open-ended responses. Participants primarily described functional dependence, with LLMs becoming integrated into routine software engineering activities because of the productivity and efficiency they provide. Responses also suggested patterns consistent with overreliance, particularly through prioritizing LLMs over documentation or peer consultation while continuing to verify generated outputs. Reports associated with addiction-related behaviors were less common and primarily reflected difficulty moderating use or emotional attachment to the technology rather than impaired control. The findings suggest that LLMs are becoming a habitual component of professional software engineering practice. While most reported use appears functional, the results indicate the importance of promoting appropriate reliance by supporting trust calibration, professional judgment, and verification throughout software development.

AI.tldr: 本文通过调查119名软件从业人员，探讨了软件开发者在专业工作中使用大型语言模型（LLMs）时表现出的依赖、过度依赖及成瘾相关行为模式。研究发现LLMs已成为专业软件工程实践中的习惯性组成部分，多数使用属于功能性依赖，但也需关注信任校准与验证。
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs在代码生成、调试、文档编写等专业软件开发活动中的广泛应用，开发者对这些工具的依赖程度不断加深，可能出现过度依赖甚至成瘾相关行为。本研究旨在深入理解软件工程师在专业开发中使用LLMs的体验，并识别与依赖、过度依赖及成瘾相关的行为模式，以期为促进合理使用提供依据。
AI.method: 采用探索性调查研究方法，对119名软件从业人员进行问卷调查。数据分析采用描述性统计方法，并结合对参与者开放式回答的定性主题分析（thematic analysis），以全面理解LLMs使用中的行为模式及其潜在问题。
AI.result: 研究结果显示：（1）参与者主要描述了功能性依赖——LLMs因提升生产力和效率而被整合到日常软件工程活动中；（2）部分反应呈现出过度依赖模式，具体表现为优先使用LLMs而非查阅文档或咨询同事，但仍会对生成结果进行验证；（3）成瘾相关行为的报告较少，主要反映在使用节制困难或对技术产生情感依赖，而非失控表现。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现LLMs正逐渐成为专业软件工程实践中的习惯性组成部分。尽管大多数使用属于功能性范畴，但研究强调了在软件开发全过程中促进合理依赖的重要性，包括支持信任校准（trust calibration）、维护专业判断力以及持续验证生成内容。这对LLM工具的设计规范和开发者培训具有重要指导意义。

title: JTA: Joint Testability Architecture for Scenario-Based Validation of Safety-Critical Software
summary: Validation adequacy in safety-critical software depends on more than the system under test. Critical scenarios must be constructed under controlled conditions, execution evidence must be aligned into verdict-ready form, and abnormal outcomes must be attributable to actionable causes. Existing testability research remains largely artifact-centric and offers little architectural support for reasoning about the combined capability of the scenario, the test system, and the system under test. Joint Testability Architecture (JTA) addresses this gap by treating those three elements as a single object of analysis and design. It characterizes validation capability along three dimensions--controllability, observability, and isolability--and organizes them through three domains, three bridges, and an analysis-design-evaluation-refinement loop. JTA also introduces scenario contracts, joint capability assessment, validation blind-spot identification, and bridge-oriented design actions that map capability gaps to concrete improvements in control points, evidence organization, and attribution boundaries. An illustrative analysis of ArduPilot failsafe validation shows that link-loss scenarios are comparatively mature, whereas state-estimation anomaly scenarios remain harder to validate because evidence alignment and attribution semantics are weaker. JTA is not a replacement for existing testing or safety-analysis techniques; it provides an architectural basis for modeling, designing, and assessing scenario-based validation in safety-critical software.

AI.tldr: 本文提出联合可测试性架构（JTA），将安全关键软件的场景、测试系统与被测系统视为统一分析对象，沿可控性、可观测性、可隔离性三维能力刻画验证充分性，并通过"三域三桥一闭环"的结构将能力缺口映射至具体架构设计动作。以 ArduPilot 失效保护验证为示例，验证了方法的可行性与诊断价值。
AI.motivation: 现有可测试性研究以软件制品为中心，缺乏对场景、测试系统与被测系统（SUT）联合能力的架构化推理支持。在安全关键领域，验证难点不仅在于测试用例数量，更在于关键场景的可重复构建、证据的判决就绪组织以及异常结果到工程责任边界的可归因性。传统 STPA/FMEA/FTA 等安全分析方法虽能识别关键场景与故障模式，但无法直接回答现有测试系统与 SUT 能否联合支撑充分的场景验证。
AI.method: （1）定义联合可测试系统模型 JTS_σ=⟨σ, T_σ, S_σ⟩，将验证对象扩展为场景实例化的三方联合体；（2）提出八元场景契约 SC(σ)=⟨g, p, u, e, o, r, κ, Θ⟩，显式纳入待区分故障源集 r 与能力阈值向量 Θ；（3）以需求/暴露点的交集覆盖率形式分别量化 SUT 侧能力 C_S/O_S/I_S，通过九个加权指标量化测试系统侧能力 C_T/O_T/I_T，并以 min 算子定义受瓶颈约束的联合能力；（4）给出场景充分性 Adeq(σ)、能力缺口 Gap(σ) 与系统级度量 JT(JTS)；（5）设计"三域（场景域/测试系统域/SUT 域）、三桥（控制桥 B_C、证据桥 B_O、归因桥 B_I）、一闭环（分析-设计-评估-迭代）"架构，依据缺口维度激活对应桥的设计动作；（6）提供五步分析工作流与两种采纳模式（改造模式/共建模式），以及用于示例分析的 H/M/L 三级序量评估规范。
AI.result: 以 ArduPilot 为示例，抽取三类失效保护场景契约：RC 链路丢失（S1）、GCS 心跳超时（S2）、EKF 状态估计异常（S3）。序量评估结果：S1 在 JC/JO/JI 上分别达到 H/M/M，Adeq=1，通过最小充分性门槛；S2 为 H/M/L，Adeq=0，主要瓶颈在于归因桥弱，无法有效区分真实超时与测试工具控制错误；S3 为 L/M/L，Adeq=0，控制端的扰动参数耦合与回放注入能力不足、归因端多触发源（EKF 方差/健康位/GPS 质量）边界不清同时构成瓶颈。项目级 JT(JTS)=28.6%。每个缺口被具体映射至 B_C/B_O/B_I 的设计动作，如构建"超时事件-原因码-链路状态"三元归因视图、参数化扰动模板与时序控制器、多触发映射结构化原因元组等。
AI.conclusion: JTA 将安全关键软件的可测试性重构为场景条件下的系统级联合能力，提供了可追溯、可审计的充分性判断与缺口驱动设计路径。示例表明，测试困难并非单纯代码层问题，而源于场景需求、测试基础设施与 SUT 暴露钩子三者间的联合错配；不同场景呈现不同的瓶颈结构（证据/归因主导 vs. 控制/归因双瓶颈），验证能力应在设计阶段前置塑造，而非事后检验。JTA 不替代形式化验证或认证流程，而是为模型驱动测试、保障论据工程与 UT P 等提供统一的架构级组织视角。未来工作包括在工业案例中精化能力指标、验证桥级设计动作的实施收益，并探索与 UTP、保障论据及 MDE 的深度集成。

title: Towards Competence-Based Management for Open Source Software Projects
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure. To appear in the Proceedings of the ACM/IEEE International Symposium on Empirical Software Engineering and Measurement (ESEM 2026). Replication package: this https URL
summary: Contributors to Open Source Software (OSS) projects are vital to maintaining the health of both communities and projects. However, the number of projects experiencing core contributors' disengagement has increased to the point that it risks the projects' survival. Finding new contributors to replace the workforce is challenging and time-intensive due to several factors, including a lack of precise knowledge about potential candidates' competences, which may need to be confirmed through interviews and exams. Previous studies provided indications of the contributor's competences, although they lack depth in understanding competence levels, which can result in poor knowledge about the contributor's capabilities. To address this gap, we assess contributors' competence by collecting code metrics related to source code from contributions. We also propose a competence model able to predict the competence level required to solve tasks. By properly assessing contributors' competences, we can identify and train candidates to replace core contributors. Our replication package, including code, data, and documentation, is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文针对开源软件(OSS)项目中核心贡献者流失问题，提出了一种基于代码度量的能力画像构建与能力等级预测方法，通过JabRef项目实证验证了其在识别和预测贡献者能力方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 开源软件项目日益依赖少数核心贡献者(约70%热门GitHub仓库仅依赖1-2名核心贡献者)，而贡献者流失会危及项目生存。现有能力评估研究缺乏对能力等级的深入理解，且忽略了编程语言差异、安全漏洞等因素，导致难以准确识别和培养替代贡献者。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法：(1)从JabRef项目中挖掘85个PR和5,793个唯一函数；(2)基于抽象语法树(AST)提取API和函数，结合SkillScope的两层能力分类法(31个能力+186个子能力)进行分类，并使用LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instant通过Grok API进行零样本分类；(3)使用Lizard静态分析工具提取13个代码复杂度度量，构建加权复合评分将代码映射为5个能力等级；(4)采用one-vs-all策略训练随机森林模型，包括能力分类模型和基于6个结构特征的代理能力等级预测模型；通过McNemar检验验证模型显著性。
AI.result: 能力分类模型准确率达92.91%，F1分数为75.80%；代理能力等级预测模型在数据库等专用领域准确率高达90.00%，总体测试准确率69.23%、加权F1为67.18%，显著优于多数类基线(38.46%)；特征重要性分析显示总token数(0.2725)和NLOC(0.2324)是最强预测因子；从16名贡献者中构建了能力画像，发现56.25%的贡献者具备Level 3或Level 4能力，其中贡献者"d"在43个子能力领域展现Level 5水平。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明了基于代码度量和结构特征可以有效预测开源贡献者的能力等级和构建详细的能力画像，为开源项目的任务分配、人才培养和核心贡献者替代提供了可扩展的自动化方案，有助于缓解贡献者流失风险并提升项目可持续性。

title: Keeping Models and Code in Sync: Roundtrip Engineering for Tactical Domain-Driven Design
summary: Domain-Driven Design gives teams a shared vocabulary for complex business logic, but that vocabulary only stays useful as long as the model and the code agree with each other. In practice, they drift apart: code changes outpace the model, or model revisions never make it into the codebase. This paper presents JDomInO, a bidirectional synchronization toolchain for tactical DDD that keeps a Java codebase and its domain model connected through a shared metamodel, with the goal of keeping the two in sync as the system evolves. JDomInO generates Java code structure deterministically from a domain model (forward path) and reconstructs a domain model from existing Java code (reverse path). The forward path has been fully validated on a Hotel Management scenario covering all 12 building block types in the metamodel; the reverse path's mapping logic has passed unit testing, with end-to-end validation underway. We also outline how the structured domain model produced by JDomInO could serve as a precision context layer for AI code assistants, helping them respect aggregate boundaries and DDD semantics that raw source code alone does not convey.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 JDomInO，一种面向战术领域驱动设计（Tactical DDD）的双向同步工具链，通过 DDD 原生元模型（metamodel）实现 Java 代码与领域模型之间的往返工程。正向路径（模型→代码）已在酒店管理场景中完全验证（60 个 Java 文件，覆盖全部 12 种构建块）；反向路径（代码→模型）的映射逻辑已通过单元测试，端到端验证正在进行。此外，论文探讨了将结构化领域模型（domain.json）作为 LLM 上下文层以提升 AI 代码助手对 DDD 语义理解的潜在方向。
AI.motivation: 战术 DDD 通过构建块（聚合、实体、值对象、领域事件等）将业务概念映射到代码结构，但在实践中面临"模型漂移"（model drift）问题：代码修改后未同步更新模型，或模型修订未反映到代码中，导致模型与代码逐渐偏离。现有工具存在局限：单向代码生成工具无法回写代码修改（如 Czarnecki 等的特征模型工作）；通用逆向工程工具（如 MoDisco）不理解 DDD 语义边界；LLM 代码助手（如 GitHub Copilot）在缺乏结构化架构上下文时常常违反 DDD 原则。该研究的核心动机是填补"DDD 语义感知的双向同步工具"这一空白。
AI.method: JDomInO 的核心设计思想是采用 Java 实现的 DDD 原生元模型作为模型层与代码层之间的共享契约。架构包含两个自研组件和一个外部依赖：(1) Domain Code Generator 处理正向路径，从 domain.json 读取领域模型，确定性地生成 Java 代码（确定性是核心设计原则）；(2) MirrorMapper 处理反向路径的第二步，将中间表示转换为 JDomInO 元模型结构；(3) Domain Mirror（esentri DLC 框架的开源组件）处理反向路径的第一步，通过 Java 反射镜像代码库中的 DDD 构建块。持久化层将语义信息（domain.json）与表示信息（notation.json，如布局位置）分离存储。元模型涵盖 12 种战术 DDD 构建块：AggregateRoot、Entity、ValueObject、DomainEvent、Repository、DomainService、ApplicationService、DomainCommand、Enum、QueryHandler、OutboundService、ReadModel；并显式编码构建块间的结构关系（聚合内组合关系、仓储与聚合的一对一关系、服务方法与领域事件的发布关系）。
AI.result: 正向路径已通过酒店前台管理系统的完整验证：领域模型包含 5 个聚合（Hotel、Zimmer、Buchung、Rechnung、ServiceLeistung）、2 个实体、7 个值对象以及 CQRS/六边形架构相关类型，覆盖元模型定义的全部 12 种构建块类型；Domain Code Generator 生成约 60 个 Java 文件，全部通过与预定义 golden file 的逐字符比对。反向路径的 MirrorMapper 映射逻辑已通过独立单元测试验证（类型名、字段、方法、构建块间关系均可正确重建），端到端与酒店管理场景的集成测试正在进行中。论文以 Adresse 值对象为例展示了正向生成的具体输出（采用 Java record 语法实现不可变性，集成 Lombok Builder 和 Jakarta Bean Validation 约束）。此外，论文识别了三类有待探索的研究方向：以 domain.json 替代原始源码作为 LLM 主上下文是否能降低架构语义错误并节省 token；通过反向路径将 AI 生成代码回映至模型层进行高层一致性审计；确定性代码生成与 AI 生成的混合工作流是否优于纯 AI 生成。
AI.conclusion: 模型漂移本质上是工具问题而非纪律问题。JDomInO 通过 DDD 原生共享元模型，使代码与模型的双向同步成为代码库的持续属性，而非仅在项目启动时的一次性动作。正向路径已完全验证，反向路径紧随其后。更长远地看，确定性验证器有望使 AI 生成的代码与人工编写的代码遵守同一架构标准；结构化领域模型则能以业务语言精准引导代码生成而非仅仅描述代码。论文指出当前局限包括：反向路径采用尽力匹配策略而非嵌入持久身份标识（类重命名/迁移仍需手动协调）、domain.json 缺乏完整的模型完整性验证步骤、反向路径端到端验证尚未完成。未来工作包括引入确定性验证器组件、以 domain.json 作为 LLM 上下文层开展实证研究，以及结合开源仓库 DDD 实践的大规模实证研究为验证器的约束规则提供依据。

title: Agent-Based Test Assertion Generation via Diverse Perspective Aggregation
summary: Test assertions are critical elements of unit tests, serving as checkpoints to validate expected behavior and ensure software correctness. Numerous techniques have been proposed to automate assertion generation, with recent progress notably driven by large language models (LLMs). Despite the promise, existing approaches such as ChatAssert suffer from modest accuracy, heavy reliance on oversampling, and vulnerability to model randomness due to one-shot prompting. To address these limitations, we propose AssertMate, a novel agent-based assertion generation framework that enhances the quality and reliability of LLM-generated assertions through three key components: (1) actual value construction that identifies assertion targets via static analysis and type-aware heuristics; (2) multi-perspective expected value prediction using code generation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning agents; and (3) an LLM-as-a-Judge collaboration mechanism to select the most appropriate assertion. Evaluation on the Defects4J benchmark demonstrates that AssertMate significantly outperforms state-of-the-art techniques in compilation success and pass rates, along with substantially higher bug detection capabilities. Integration with EvoSuite further validates AssertMate's practicality, yielding superior mutation coverage and kill counts. Ablation studies reveal that each of the three components makes a significant and complementary contribution to the overall performance. This work affirms the great potential of aggregating diverse perspectives to enhance the effectiveness of LLM-based assertion generation.

AI.tldr: AssertMate是一个基于多智能体的单元测试断言生成框架，通过静态分析构建实际值、利用三种互补视角（代码生成、RAG、CoT）预测期望值，并采用LLM-as-a-Judge协作机制选择最优断言，显著提升了断言生成的正确性和缺陷检测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的断言生成方法（如ChatAssert）存在准确率较低、过度依赖过采样、易受模型随机性影响等问题。原因在于一次性提示策略固有的过度自信和输出不稳定，难以应对断言生成中"测什么"和"期望什么"的双重不确定性。
AI.method: AssertMate包含三个核心组件：(1) 实际值构造器(ActVCon)：结合静态程序分析与LLM辅助，通过类型感知启发式规则（原始类型、项目内类型、外部类型）识别断言目标并构建实际值；(2) 多视角期望值生成器(EVGen)：采用三种互补智能体——代码生成代理(CGA)、检索增强生成代理(RAGA)、链式思考代理(CoTA)分别生成候选期望值，并通过概率重排序机制筛选；(3) LLM-as-a-Judge协作机制：基于CoT推理的Judge智能体对候选断言进行深度对比分析，选出最终断言。
AI.result: 在Defects4J基准上，AssertMate的五次独立运行均值CSR为76.78%、PR为60.09%、BDR为46.25%，相对最优基线ChatAssert*分别提升52.92%、50.94%和相对提升（37.32%→46.25%），Wilcoxon检验具有统计显著性。与EvoSuite集成时，AssertMate杀死12,276个变异体，较ChatAssert*、TOGLL、EditAS分别提升40.49%、128.43%、492.76%。消融实验验证三个组件均贡献显著且互补：移除ActVCon使CSR骤降64.32个百分点；Judge机制在CSR、PR、BDR上对最强单体代理CoTA的"正确覆盖"显著多于"错误覆盖"（McNemar检验p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: AssertMate通过多视角聚合策略显著优于现有断言生成技术，验证了将断言生成任务解耦为实际值构造与期望值预测、并融合多智能体协作的有效性。该框架不仅缓解了LLM幻觉问题，还为提升基于LLM的测试断言生成提供了可迁移的推理支架，并开辟了自适应提示策略、多语言扩展、多断言场景等未来研究方向。

title: Mapping the Emerging Curriculum for AI-Assisted Software Engineering via Syllabus Analysis
summary: As Generative AI coding tools reshape professional software development, universities have begun designing courses to prepare students for AI-assisted development workflows. By analyzing the syllabi of these courses, we can gather empirical evidence about these courses, reveal how this emerging curricular area is being defined, and gain guidance for future curriculum design. We analyzed 23 publicly available syllabi and course materials of upper-division, credit-bearing courses that meet specific criteria, including explicitly addressing Generative AI in software engineering. Through iterative qualitative coding, we characterized courses' learning objectives, assessments, topics, and documented AI tools. Our analysis reveals commonalities and differences among these courses that allow researchers and educators to study and develop future courses.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析美国23门公开的高年级"AI辅助软件工程"课程的教学大纲，对该新兴课程领域进行了实证梳理。研究围绕三个研究问题展开：学习目标与评估方式、涵盖的主题、以及公开记录的AI工具，揭示了当前课程设计的共性与差异，为未来课程设计提供基线参考。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI工具正深刻改变专业软件开发实践，但现有的软件工程教育指南（如ACM/IEEE-CS的SE2014）早于GenAI广泛应用的时代，未能涵盖AI辅助开发应如何纳入课程。此外，先前研究多关注教师对GenAI的态度或AI政策问题，缺乏对将AI辅助定位为软件工程实践核心组成部分的课程进行实证考察。因此，作者希望通过分析公开课程材料，回答：这些课程声明的学习目标是什么？如何评估学生工作？涵盖哪些主题？公开记录了哪些AI工具？
AI.method: （1）数据集构建：通过对.edu和.github.com进行结构化Google搜索（2026年3月10-30日），结合两阶段筛选——首先筛选符合美国、计学分、高年级大学课程的机构资格；再筛选满足三项内容标准（明确GenAI框架、覆盖≥2个SDLC领域、有要求GenAI用于评分任务的作业），最终得到23门课程。（2）数据分析：对86条学习目标采用开放式编码并协商一致；对211条主题条目通过三轮迭代开发代码本，达到Fleiss' κ=0.80后由3位编码员分工标注；对评估方法和AI工具采用直接提取与保守归一化方法。
AI.result: RQ1（学习目标与评估）：12门公布目标的课程中，最常见的主题为"人机协作实践"（应用AI最佳实践：6门）、"软件与AI工具开发"（5门）和"软件与AI评估"（5门）。14门采用百分制评分的课程中，评估以参与度（14/14）、项目/顶点作业（12/14）、编程作业（9/14）为主；AI要求作业（70%）和编程作业（70%）占成绩权重高，而监考评估仅3门采用。RQ2（主题）：18门公布主题的课程中，AI/ML基础最常见（12门），其次为智能体开发（10门）、提示工程（9门）、测试（10门）、AI评估（7门）；SDLC各主题覆盖不均。RQ3（AI工具）：仅9/23门课程公开列出了AI工具，共识别16种不同工具，Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot使用最频繁，其余多为长尾分布。
AI.conclusion: 新兴的AI辅助软件工程课程通常以项目或顶点作业为中心，要求使用AI、大量编程和协作，并将AI使用置于真实软件开发工作流中，而非孤立的工具练习。然而，该领域尚未形成统一的课程模式——课程在工具选择、主题覆盖和评估结构上差异显著，AI辅助软件工程仍是一个"设计空间"而非标准化的课程。本研究通过记录当前公开课程中的设计模式，为未来课程设计的比较与AI辅助软件工程教育的发展追踪提供了基线。

title: Escaping the Self-Repair Trap: Improving Test Oracle Generation via Dual-Context Awareness
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for regression-oracle completion, where a test prefix is given and the current program version is treated as expected behavior. Recent approaches increasingly rely on iterative self-repair and execution feedback, but optimizing execution success does not necessarily yield strong fault-revealing oracles. This objective, widely adopted in repair-based methods, serves only as a proxy and may be misaligned with the true goal of oracle generation. Such misalignment biases the repair process, giving rise to a feedback-driven degeneration that we term the Self-Repair Trap, where iterative repair progressively drives models toward assertions that are easier to satisfy but less effective at detecting faults. To address this issue, we propose DCAware, a computationally efficient, non-iterative framework that prioritizes high signal-to-noise contextual grounding over multi-round repair. DCAware integrates structured static context with selectively retrieved dynamic states, enabling precise and robust oracle generation without iterative feedback loops. Extensive experiments based on execution and mutation testing show that DCAware consistently improves fault-revealing effectiveness while maintaining high execution success, outperforming prior methods with substantially lower computational cost. Our results suggest that improving contextual quality is more effective than adding iterative repair complexity in the studied regression-oracle setting.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于大语言模型（LLM）的回归测试预言补全任务，指出现有迭代自修复方法以"执行成功"为代理目标会导致"自修复陷阱"（Self-Repair Trap），即断言趋向于易于满足但难以暴露缺陷。为此提出非迭代框架 DCAware，通过结构化静态上下文与选择性检索的动态状态相结合，在一次生成中产出高质量预言，在执行成功率和变异测试的故障揭示能力上均优于现有迭代式方法，且计算成本显著降低。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的回归预言生成方法普遍依赖迭代自修复与执行反馈，将"执行通过"作为优化目标。然而该目标仅是真实目标（生成能有效揭示故障的断言）的代理指标，两者存在错位，导致反馈驱动的退化现象：随着修复轮数增加，模型倾向于生成更易满足但故障揭示能力更弱的断言。论文将此称为"自修复陷阱"，并主张应从根本上提升上下文质量而非堆叠修复迭代。
AI.method: 1. 提出"自修复陷阱"概念，理论分析执行成功率与故障揭示能力（故障揭示 oracle 有效性）的目标错位及其导致的退化机制。2. 设计非迭代框架 DCAware，包含两个核心组件：(a) 结构化静态上下文（覆盖被测代码的语法/语义信息，如签名、控制流、依赖关系等）；(b) 选择性动态状态检索（按需引入执行相关的状态信息，避免无差别噪声干扰）。3. 通过上下文质量的"信噪比"提升，使单次生成即可得到精确且鲁棒的预言，规避迭代反馈回路。
AI.result: 实验基于执行测试与变异测试两个维度评估。结果显示 DCAware：(1) 在执行通过率上保持高水平；(2) 在变异分数（mutation score，衡量故障揭示能力）上一致优于此前基于迭代自修复的方法；(3) 计算成本（推理轮数与时间）显著降低。论文结论强调：在回归预言生成场景中，提升上下文质量比增加迭代修复复杂度更为有效。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了 LLM 回归预言生成中"代理目标错位"导致的反馈退化问题，挑战了"迭代修复越多越好"的隐含假设。DCAware 通过静态结构化上下文与选择性动态状态融合的非迭代设计，在执行成功率与故障揭示能力之间取得更优平衡，为后续研究指出"以上下文质量取代迭代复杂度"的新方向。

title: Expertise-Based Developer Assignment for Long-Term Software Components in Open-Source Projects
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Advanced Artificial Intelligence and Education (CAAIE 2026). 11 pages, 5 figures
summary: Open-source software development through GitHub has enabled countless software projects to be developed by developers from across the world. Assigning the right task to the right developer enables teams to work efficiently. Assigning a task which is not representative of a developer's expertise results in slower completion time and less maintainable code. Whilst much work has been done to automate this assignment for specific jobs, there is little work addressing the assignment of developers to expertise-specific long-term components of a new project. This paper produces a web application that models developers' expertise based on their previous Git commits and automatically assigns them to an optimal task within a new project. Testing showed that the system's speed varies depending on the back-end model used but server-side data caching improved worst-case speeds by a factor of 9.86. 72.4% of tasks had their target developer listed in the top 10, out of a possible 47.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于GitHub开发者历史提交记录建模其专业技能的Web应用，并将其自动分配到新项目中与其专长相匹配的任务。
AI.motivation: 开源软件开发中，将任务分配给合适的开发者对团队效率至关重要；不匹配的任务分配会导致开发周期延长和代码可维护性下降。然而，现有研究大多聚焦于特定工单（issue）的自动化分配，针对开发者在新项目中按专长进行长期任务模块分配的研究较少。
AI.method: 构建一个Web应用程序，通过分析开发者在GitHub上的历史提交（commit）记录，对其专业领域进行建模；在此基础上，将新项目中的任务与开发者模型进行匹配，自动推荐最优的任务分配方案。系统还引入了服务端数据缓存机制以提升性能。
AI.result: 系统性能因后端模型不同而有所差异，但通过服务端数据缓存，最坏情况下的速度提升了9.86倍。在任务分配准确度方面，所有候选开发者共47人，72.4%的任务对应的目标开发者出现在推荐列表的前10名中。
AI.conclusion: 基于历史Git提交数据进行开发者专长建模，并据此进行新项目的任务自动分配是可行的；缓存优化可显著改善系统响应速度，且大多数任务的合适开发者能被有效推荐到前列，但仍有进一步提升准确率的空间。

title: Sensor-Level Fault Diagnosis for Automotive Software Validation Using Large Language Models
summary: The pre-series validation of automotive software on hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) platforms produces large volumes of multivariate sensor recordings whose assessment against functional safety requirements exceeds what manual review can sustain at campaign scale. Threshold-based tooling reports that a deviation has occurred but neither identifies its nature nor locates its source, while data-driven classifiers, although accurate, rely on large labelled datasets and return opaque decisions that sit uneasily with the traceability demanded by ISO 26262. This study examines whether open-source instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs), given a textual description of sensor behaviour, can serve as data-efficient and interpretable engines for fault detection and diagnosis inside the validation loop. A two-phase framework is proposed: automated requirement checking on a dSPACE real-time platform first isolates the recordings that violate a safety requirement, and only these are inspected, with sliding windows of the signals reduced to statistical, relational, and contextual descriptors, embedded in a fixed prompt, and mapped by a 4-bit low-rank-adapted LLM to a fault location accompanied by a written justification. Four model families ranging from two to eight billion parameters were adapted and tested on a gasoline-engine case study spanning six injected fault classes. The smallest model matched the largest at 81.6\% accuracy, whereas a comparably sized model failed to converge, indicating that diagnostic competence under task-specific adaptation follows convergence rather than parameter count, with the entire adapt-and-evaluate cycle fitting on a single commodity accelerator.

AI.tldr: 提出基于开源LLM的两阶段故障诊断框架：将HIL传感器信号转化为结构化文本描述符，由LoRA适配的指令微调LLM完成ISO 26262合规的故障定位与解释，在汽油发动机6类故障案例上验证了数据高效性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 预量产汽车软件在HIL平台验证产生海量多变量传感器录制数据，超出人工审查能力。阈值工具只能报警不能定位故障；深度学习分类器虽准确但需要大量标注数据且决策不透明，与ISO 26262对可追溯性的要求相矛盾。需要一种数据高效、可解释、符合功能安全标准的故障诊断方法。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 在dSPACE SCALEXIO实时仿真器上依据ISO 26262 Part 4执行功能安全需求检查，仅筛选违规记录；(2) 对违规记录的滑动窗口(20步，步幅3)计算四类描述符——统计(均值/极值/最大跳变)、关系(Pearson相关系数)、行为(稳定性/比例性)、上下文(车速/工况)，嵌入固定的三段式prompt(instruction/input/output schema)，由4-bit量化+LoRA(r=1-8)适配的开源LLM(Gemma 2 2B-it、Qwen2.5 3B、Llama 3.1 8B、Mistral 7B)输出Location_ID与文字解释。关键防泄漏措施：在记录级划分数据、移除健康-故障边界过渡窗口、Z-score归一化仅基于训练集。
AI.result: 在38条违规记录(6类故障)的测试集上：Gemma 2 2B-it与Llama 3.1 8B均达到31/38=81.58%准确率(Macro-F1≈0.82)，Qwen2.5 3B为76.32%(29/38)，Mistral 7B崩溃至10.53%(4/38)。类别层面，Throttle_Noise被所有可行模型完美分类，加速踏板相关故障(ACCPed_SW_Noise与AP_Offset)混淆最严重——这反映了信号到文本描述符的固有信息损失而非模型能力。推理延迟：Gemma约3.2秒/样本，Llama约8.9秒/样本；训练峰值显存5.3-9.9GB，均在T4 16GB预算内。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明诊断质量与模型规模解耦——2B模型匹敌8B模型，关键在于任务特定适配下的收敛稳定性。Gemma 2 2B-it被推荐为最佳部署选择(速度、显存、准确率最佳平衡)。Mistral的失败凸显了逐模型调参与稳定性检查的必要性。油门-踏板轴的混淆表明未来工作应丰富描述符(如频域特征)、扩展故障目录、评估严重程度并迁移至其他动力总成架构。单平台、有限样本使结果仅作指示性参考。

title: AgentExecutor: Partial Code Execution via Agentic Context Generation
summary: Executing code snippets is essential for dynamic program analysis, but it remains challenging to execute an arbitrary code snippet due to issues like missing context and incomplete dependencies. Existing approaches to partial code execution, such as LExecutor and Treefix, leverage the power of language models to infer missing information and enable execution. However, they suffer from (i) limited action spaces and feedback, and (ii) rigid optimization strategies, which restrict their effectiveness and efficiency. In this paper, we propose AgentExecutor, a novel multi-agent framework for partial code execution. Our approach introduces a three-phase design: execution environment preparation, dynamic exploration with iterative refinement, and prefix evolution via program synthesis. Supported by the power of LLM agents who can think, act, and get feedback iteratively, AgentExecutor is able to autonomously explore a richer action space, enabling diverse operations such as creating resource files and resolving environment configuration. Furthermore, it adopts adaptive optimization strategies, including coverage-guided context pruning and prefix evolution via program synthesis, to systematically improve the execution quality of partial code. We evaluate AgentExecutor on two widely used datasets comprising Stack Overflow snippets and open-source project code. The results show that AgentExecutor achieves up to 94% and 90% code coverage, outperforming the state-of-the-art approach Treefix by 19.9% and 13.8%, respectively. In addition, AgentExecutor significantly reduces execution time (by up to 80.3%) and cost (by up to 56.6%). These findings demonstrate that AgentExecutor provides an effective and efficient solution for partial code execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentExecutor，一种用于部分代码执行的多智能体框架，通过三个阶段（环境准备、动态探索与迭代优化、通过程序合成实现前缀进化）自动为不完整代码生成可执行前缀，在两个数据集上显著优于现有最优方法 Treefix。
AI.motivation: 部分代码执行（任意代码片段的自动执行）面临缺失上下文和不完整依赖的挑战。现有方法 LExecutor 和 Treefix 存在两大局限：(1) 动作空间和反馈受限（如 Treefix 仅允许两种前缀类型，且无法访问运行环境），(2) 优化策略僵化（如固定调用 LLM 次数、仅依赖 LLM 直接生成前缀）。这些限制阻碍了执行效果和效率的进一步提升。
AI.method: AgentExecutor 采用三阶段多智能体架构：(1) Environment Preparation：EnvAgent 通过 bash 工具迭代尝试执行并解决环境问题（依赖安装、文件创建等），使用 uv 为每个代码片段创建隔离虚拟环境；(2) Dynamic Exploration with Iterative Refinement：RefAgent 通过 ReAct 框架迭代生成和优化前缀，并采用覆盖感知（coverage-aware）的动态剪枝策略，利用早期停止思想减少上下文冗余和注意力分散；(3) Prefix Evolution via Program Synthesis：EvoAgent 基于覆盖感知的种子选择，挑出代表性前缀作为种子，再合成一个生成器程序来系统化迭代所有有价值的变量组合，从而生成更多潜在前缀。整体基于 mini-SWE-agent 框架，使用 GPT-5 nano（EnvAgent）和 GPT-5 mini（其他智能体）。
AI.result: 在 Stack Overflow 片段和开源项目代码两个数据集上：AgentExecutor 达到 Single-Best Coverage 94% 和 90%，Cumulative Coverage 95% 和 93%，Full Execution Rate 91% 和 80%，相比 Treefix 在 S-C/C-C/FER 上分别提升 19.9%/20.2%/36.1%（Stack Overflow）和 13.8%/8.2%/18.1%（开源项目）。效率方面，执行时间减少 80.3% 和 77.9%，成本降低 56.6% 和 52.1%，LLM 调用次数减少 52.1% 和 53.9%。消融实验表明动态剪枝在约 98.5% 的情况下保持或提升覆盖率，前缀进化阶段在进入该阶段的困难样本上对 FER 带来最高约 22% 的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: AgentExecutor 是首个将基于 LLM 智能体的方法应用于部分代码执行任务的工作，通过丰富的动作空间、自适应的优化策略（覆盖感知动态剪枝和基于程序合成的前缀进化），在覆盖率和效率两方面均显著超越现有最优方法，为部分代码执行提供了有效且高效的解决方案。未来工作方向包括检测和恢复智能体的过早终止、扩展数据集的粒度和多样性。

title: LangChoiceBench: Measuring and Explaining Programming-Language Choice in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to exhibit strong Python preferences when generating project-level code, but there is currently no systematic way to measure this behaviour across new models. To bridge this gap, we introduce LangChoiceBench, a project-level code-generation benchmark for measuring Python preference, recommendation-implementation consistency, and language diversity. LangChoiceBench covers 28 projects across seven software areas where Python is often a poor default. We evaluate 25 diverse LLMs and find that Python remains heavily over-selected, recommendation-implementation consistency is low, and smaller open-weight models generally show stronger Python preference and lower language diversity. We further analyse 9,826 reasoning traces and find that most Python choices are automatic or driven primarily by ease, rather than explicit consideration of project requirements. In a smaller but important set of cases, models fabricate contextual support for choosing Python - a failure mode we call phantom evidence - or produce code that contradicts the language selected in their own reasoning.

AI.tldr: LangChoiceBench是一个用于衡量大语言模型在项目级代码生成中Python偏好的基准测试，涵盖28个项目和7个软件领域。研究评估了25个LLM，发现Python被过度选用、推荐-实现一致性低、小型开源模型Python偏好更强且语言多样性更低，并识别出"幻觉证据"等失败模式。
AI.motivation: LLM在项目级代码生成中表现出强烈的Python偏好，但缺乏系统化方法来量化这种跨模型的偏见行为，尤其是在Python并非理想默认选择的领域（如移动开发、游戏开发、嵌入式系统等）。
AI.method: 构建LangChoiceBench基准（28个项目、7个软件领域），评估25个不同LLM，分析其语言选择行为；通过分析9,826条推理轨迹，识别选择Python的驱动因素（自动化、易用性、显式考虑项目需求等），并检测"幻觉证据"（phantom evidence）和推理-代码不一致等失败模式。
AI.result: 1) Python被严重过度选用；2) 模型的推荐语言与实际实现语言之间一致性低；3) 较小规模的开源权重模型Python偏好更强、语言多样性更低；4) 大多数Python选择是自动化或基于易用性驱动，而非显式考虑项目需求；5) 存在模型编造上下文支持（幻觉证据）或推理与生成代码语言矛盾的现象。
AI.conclusion: LLM在代码生成中存在显著的Python默认偏好问题，这种偏见在小模型中尤为突出，且常常缺乏对项目实际需求的合理评估。模型需要更好地平衡语言多样性和项目需求匹配，避免幻觉证据等可靠性问题。

title: In Terms of Explainability: Refining Requirements for Self-Explainable Systems
summary: Autonomous and software-intensive systems have been growing in occurrence, complexity, and assumed responsibility. Due to the high complexity of these systems, properties like transparency and explainability must be a focus of investigation. To date, no universally applicable definition and guide for the development of (self-)explainable systems exists. A need for explainability standards has already been recognized in the EU AI Act and the IEEE Transparency Standard 7001-2021. To address this need, we propose unified definitions in explainability based on an analysis and combination of existing definitions. Additionally, we present structured explainability requirements that are necessary to build (self-)explainable systems. By analysing the resulting taxonomy, we propose the incorporation of explanation goodness and thus correctness of explanations into the unified definitions. With our approach, we support the development of formal standards for (self-)explainable systems. Establishing such a uniform taxonomy also is a beneficial step towards certifying or auditing explainable systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自主及软件密集型系统中可解释性(self-explainability)缺乏统一定义和工程化指南的问题，通过分析整合现有定义，提出统一的"解释"和"可解释系统"定义，并构建包含9项核心需求的结构化需求分类法(R0-R9)，最终将"解释的正确性与优良性"纳入解释定义，为可解释系统标准化与认证奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 随着自主系统和软件密集型系统的复杂度与承担的责任日益增长，其不透明性导致利益相关者难以理解系统行为，可能引发不公平等负面影响。欧盟AI法案和IEEE 7001-2021透明度标准均已认识到可解释性标准化的需求，但目前学界与工业界仍缺乏可普遍接受的定义和工程指南，阻碍了可解释系统的开发、认证与审计。
AI.method: 1) 对Köhl、Bersani、Chazette、Schwammberger等学者提出的解释与可解释系统定义进行对比分析，综合得出统一定义(命题1、2、2.1、3)；2) 从Leue及现有信息/解释分类法中提炼出9项抽象需求(R0元需求 + R1-R9子需求)，并基于abilities-based理解概念分析其相互依赖关系，构建需求分类法图；3) 通过智能咖啡机和交通管理两个案例研究验证需求分类法的充分性；4) 据此将"解释正确性"与"可测量理解"反向整合进解释定义(命题1.1)。
AI.result: 1) 提出统一的解释定义：解释E是"在情境C中带有可解释目标θ，使目标群体G的代表R理解被解释项X的一段信息I"，并区分解释系统S_E与被解释系统S_X、解释情境C_E与被解释情境C_X；2) 提出9项需求：可解释性(R0)、可产生性(R1)、可理解性(R2)、呈现(R3)、内容(R4)、正确性(R5)、优良性(R6)、时机(R7)、范围(R8)、可建模性(R9)，并揭示其非层次化逻辑依赖关系；3) 通过交通管理案例(自动驾驶乘客Alice路线变更、紧急驾驶员Bob路口通行)验证了所有9项需求的必要性，特别凸显正确性与优良性的关键作用；4) 将定义修订为"可证明正确且可测量促进理解的信息"。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的统一术语和需求分类法可作为制定可解释系统正式标准的起点，需求分类法的逻辑连接为未来研究提供抽象指导框架；将解释优良性与正确性纳入定义的主张(虽非必要性但属期望性)推动了定义从形式完备向语义正确的演进；未来工作应开展系统性文献综述、引入哲学与社会学视角，并进一步细化可解释性需求，以推动标准化、认证与审计体系的建立。

title: DCAS: Decoupling CLI Agent Scaffolding to Internalize Planning across Scaffolds
summary: CLI-based software-engineering agents have matured rapidly, yet the open ecosystem has converged on a single training environment: trajectory datasets used to fine-tune open models are collected almost exclusively under OpenHands. Models fine-tuned on this data score well under OpenHands but degrade substantially when deployed under any non-training scaffold. Untrained base models do not show this divergence, indicating the gap is fine-tuning-induced and tied to the conventions of the training scaffold. We argue that a load-bearing scaffold-specific behavior is planning structure, in two senses this paper distinguishes: explicit planning, a pre-execution plan produced as a first-class artifact, and implicit planning, the structural conventions that shape execution throughout the agent loop. Under this hypothesis, closing the gap requires moving planning from a fixed scaffold artifact to a learned model capability. We introduce Decoupling CLI Agent Scaffolding (DCAS), a backend-substitution interception layer that routes API traffic between any CLI scaffold and any backend model without modifying the scaffold, enabling cross-scaffold evaluation and planning-aware trajectory collection. Using DCAS, a controlled plan-source intervention confirms planning quality is a high-leverage component, with gains exceeding the cross-scaffold drops we observe. A model fine-tuned on a small set of DCAS-collected planning-aware trajectories under a single scaffold gains consistently across non-training scaffolds, and the two senses of planning are empirically separable in training data.

AI.tldr: 论文针对CLI软件工程智能体开源生态过度依赖OpenHands单一训练环境的问题，指出模型在该环境微调后迁移至其他scaffold（脚手架）时性能显著下降的现象，并提出解耦方案DCAS来分离脚手架与后端模型，通过引入"规划结构"作为可学习能力来弥合跨scaffold性能差距。
AI.motivation: 开源生态在CLI软件工程智能体训练上几乎完全收敛于OpenHands单一环境，导致在该环境微调的模型在其他scaffold上部署时性能大幅退化；而未经微调的基模型不存在此差距，说明这是由微调引入的、与训练scaffold约定耦合的偏差。论文认为核心问题在于规划结构被固化在scaffold而非模型能力中。
AI.method: 1) 区分两种规划结构：显式规划（作为一等制品的预执行计划）与隐式规划（贯穿智能体循环的结构性约定）；2) 提出DCAS（Decoupling CLI Agent Scaffolding），一种后端替换拦截层，可在不修改scaffold的前提下路由任意CLI scaffold与任意后端模型之间的API流量；3) 通过DCAS实施受控的规划源干预实验，验证规划质量的影响力；4) 在单一scaffold下用DCAS收集的规划感知轨迹微调模型。
AI.result: 1) 规划质量是高杠杆组件，其增益超过了观察到的跨scaffold性能下降；2) 在单一scaffold下用少量DCAS收集的规划感知轨迹微调的模型，在多个非训练scaffold上均获得稳定提升；3) 显式规划与隐式规划在训练数据中具有经验可分性。
AI.conclusion: 要弥合scaffold间的性能差距，必须将规划从固定的scaffold制品转化为可学习的模型能力；DCAS作为解耦层为此提供了基础设施支持，使规划感知的轨迹采集和跨scaffold评估成为可能。

title: Predicting Agile Success: The Critical Few Factors
summary: While Agile projects are more successful than traditional software development project management approaches, their overall success rate remains relatively low, with a high percentage of projects still deemed challenged or failed. This low project success rate is attributed to projects not being rigorously evaluated against critical success factors (CSF) of Agile projects and contemporary project success criteria. To identify the CSF that contribute to Agile software development project success as perceived by Agile practitioners, this study used a positivist approach to investigate the CSF of Agile software development projects. PLS-SEM with SmartPLS was used to analyse the data and test the hypotheses to identify significant relationships between the constructs and project success criteria. This research found that a few critical factors significantly contribute to Agile project success. The study developed a novel model that can be used to evaluate and measure project success.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实证方法识别影响敏捷软件开发项目成功的关键成功因素（CSF），开发了一个用于评估和衡量敏捷项目成功的新模型。
AI.motivation: 敏捷项目相比传统软件开发方法更成功，但整体成功率仍然较低。许多项目被认定为"受挑战"或"失败"，主要原因是项目未能根据敏捷项目的关键成功因素（CSF）和当代项目成功标准进行严格评估。因此，有必要从敏捷从业者的视角识别真正影响敏捷项目成功的关键因素。
AI.method: 采用实证主义（positivist）研究方法，通过调查收集敏捷从业者的感知数据；使用 PLS-SEM（偏最小二乘结构方程模型）结合 SmartPLS 软件进行数据分析与假设检验，以识别各构念与项目成功标准之间的显著关系。
AI.result: 研究发现少数几个关键因素对敏捷项目成功具有显著贡献；研究构建了一个新颖的模型，可用于评估和衡量敏捷软件开发项目的成功。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为敏捷项目管理领域提供了基于实证证据的关键成功因素框架，提出的新模型能够帮助实践者更系统地评估敏捷项目成功，从而提高敏捷项目的整体成功率。

title: Automatic Translation of Unstructured Requirements into Linear Temporal Logic through Large Language Models
comment: Copyright 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. summary: Automatically translating unstructured natural language requirements into formal specifications remains a challenge in requirements engineering and formal methods, particularly for safety- and mission-critical systems whose verification depends on mathematically precise specifications. This paper evaluates whether contemporary off-the-shelf Large Language Models (LLMs) can help bridge this gap by generating Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) formulas directly from unstructured requirements. The study examines six modern LLMs using a few-shot prompting strategy on a heterogeneous benchmark of 15 structurally varied requirements. Five independent generations were collected for each requirement-model pair, yielding 450 candidate LTL formulas in total. Performance was assessed through manual semantic evaluation, pass@k for k in {1, 3, 5}, and a self-consistency measure capturing syntactic reproducibility across stochastic trials. The results indicate that current general-purpose LLMs can achieve practically significant performance on the unstructured NL-to-LTL task without task-specific fine-tuning. The study also considers understandability for non-experts by pairing generated formulas with model-produced natural language explanations and discussing the complementary use of timeline-based LTL visualization. The findings suggest that modern LLMs are becoming viable front-end assistants for semi-automated formalization workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了六款现代通用大语言模型（LLMs）在少样本提示（few-shot prompting）下，将非结构化自然语言需求直接转换为线性时序逻辑（LTL）公式的能力。结果表明，当前通用LLM无需任务特定微调即可在该任务上取得具有实际意义的性能，并有望成为半自动化形式化工作流中的前端助手。
AI.motivation: 在需求工程与形式化方法领域，将非结构化自然语言需求自动转化为形式化规约仍是一项挑战，尤其是对于安全关键（safety-critical）和任务关键（mission-critical）系统，其验证依赖于数学上精确的规约。论文试图探究现代现成LLMs能否弥合这一差距，作为非专家用户与形式化验证之间的桥梁。
AI.method: 研究采用少样本提示（few-shot prompting）策略，在结构多样化的15条异构需求基准上评估六款现代LLM；每对"需求-模型"组合独立生成5次，共计450条候选LTL公式。评估手段包括：(1) 人工语义评估；(2) pass@k指标（k∈{1,3,5}）；(3) 衡量跨随机试验语法可复现性的自洽性（self-consistency）度量。此外，还通过模型生成的自然语言解释以及基于时间线（timeline）的LTL可视化来评估非专家可理解性。
AI.result: 研究表明，当前通用目的LLM无需任务特定微调，即可在非结构化自然语言到LTL的任务上取得具有实际意义的性能（practically significant performance）。通过将生成的LTL公式与模型产出的自然语言解释配对，并结合时间线式LTL可视化，可提升非专家对结果的理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现，现代LLM正日益成为半自动化形式化工作流中可行的前端助手（front-end assistants），可用于辅助形式化规约的生成，但尚不能完全替代专业形式化方法工程师的工作。

title: Art in Humanity's Code
summary: Artist-led open-source libraries such as Processing or openFrameworks have had a major impact on artists and designers who use code as a creative medium. In this work, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of public code repositories that use these libraries. Our study dives into 1,613,571 code repositories collected from the Software Heritage archive.
