Combining quantitative and qualitative methods, we investigate the diversity of practices and practitioners in terms of code hosting, geographical distribution, characteristics of code-based creative works and the purposes of these works. Key findings include evidence of the worldwide presence of generative art and creative coding, as well as the adoption of these practices in both education and across creative industries. We illustrate these findings with concrete examples of repositories and contributor profiles around the globe, spanning the spectrum from university curricula to contemporary art. These results lay the groundwork for educators, researchers, and artists who investigate code and creative practices to foster sustained diversity in the construction of our digital world.

AI.tldr: 本文对使用艺术家主导的开源库(如Processing、p5.js、openFrameworks、SuperCollider等)进行生成式艺术和创意编程的公共代码仓库进行了首次大规模实证研究,基于Software Heritage归档中的1,613,571个代码仓库,从代码托管平台、地理分布、创作特征及目的四个维度展开了量化与定性分析。
AI.motivation: 艺术家使用代码作为创作媒介已有六十年历史,但此前缺乏对这一现象的大规模量化研究。已有工作要么提出支持生成式艺术的新技术,要么依赖访谈和案例研究,缺乏对开源艺术代码生态的全局性认识。作者旨在填补这一空白,揭示创意编码实践的多样性、全球分布以及代码保护面临的挑战。
AI.method: 从Software Heritage归档(2025-05-18版本)中通过文件名模式(如p5.js、ofApp.cpp、.pde、.scd等)挖掘包含艺术相关信号的代码仓库,经过去重和歧义消解后获得1,613,571个仓库。针对四个研究问题采用不同尺度的方法:(RQ1)对全集分析托管平台并通过HTTP请求判断在线状态;(RQ2)对10% GitHub仓库样本(154,832个)使用Geoapify API解析贡献者地理分布;(RQ3)对1% p5.js仓库的17,875个草图使用Qwen3-Coder LLM按三维框架(材料与过程、交互、感官结果)自动分类;(RQ4)人工归纳分析仓库最多的42个GitHub账户(17,156个仓库),通过归纳编码归纳其目的。
AI.result: (1) 99.3%仓库托管在GitHub上,但80,175个(约5.5%)已无法在线访问,印证Software Heritage对艺术代码保护的重要作用,部分消失的平台(如Gitorious、Google Code)曾托管过大量Processing和SuperCollider代码;(2)贡献者分布于124个国家(14,427个可定位),巴西、印度、日本均有大量贡献者,非洲、中亚、印度洋等地区也有活跃的艺术家;(3)96.21%的p5.js草图涉及材料合成,49.63%使用随机数,34.99%引用外部资源,大多数作品是time-based和交互性的;(4)前42名贡献者的仓库主要服务于三类目的:计算机科学教育(以Processing/p5.js教学编程)、艺术教育(创意编码课程)和艺术创作本身。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证实了生成式艺术和创意编码在全球范围内的广泛存在,揭示了GitHub之外多元代码托管生态(尤其是5.5%已消失的仓库)对软件艺术保护的紧迫需求,p5.js等库的多功能性支撑了从随机静图到交互式视听作品的丰富实践,创意编码在教育(编程和艺术双重领域)和专业艺术创作中均扮演重要角色。论文成果为软件工程研究者、艺术教育者和代码保护工作者提供了实证基础,并呼吁未来研究关注艺术作品的依赖建模、迁移与长期可执行性保护。数据集与复现包已公开(Zenodo与GitHub)。

title: MS-MLB: An Open Machine Learning Benchmark for Blood-Based MS Classification
summary: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is diagnosed through clinical assessment, magnetic resonance imaging, laboratory evidence when appropriate, and exclusion of better explanations. Blood RNA expression data may contain disease associated immune signal, but a blood RNA classifier cannot be treated as a replacement for clinical diagnosis. This paper presents MS-MLB (Multiple Sclerosis Machine Learning Benchmark), a reproducible open benchmark for machine learning based MS research classification from whole blood RNA expression data. MS-MLB uses the public GSE17048 cohort, converts it into an MS versus healthy control task, and evaluates multiple algorithms under a shared, leakage controlled pipeline that a researcher can rerun without reconfiguring the evaluation. The evaluation includes nested cross-validation, an untouched stratified holdout set, bootstrap confidence intervals, ROC and precision recall analysis, calibration measurement, and an exploratory MS Research Score. In the final benchmark summary, Gradient Boosting ranked first by MS Research Score on the holdout set, with an MS Research Score of 93.83, AUC-ROC of 0.989, sensitivity of 0.950, specificity of 0.778, $F_{1}$ score of 0.927, and Brier score of 0.050. Prior studies have applied machine learning to MS blood transcriptomic data, including PBMC stage classification and whole blood diagnostic signature modeling. The contribution here is different and narrower. To our knowledge, MS-MLB is the first open benchmark focused on MS versus healthy control classification from GSE17048 whole blood RNA expression data with a documented external model submission pathway built into the framework. The score is intended for research comparison only and has not been clinically validated. The benchmark is accessible here: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MS-MLB（Multiple Sclerosis Machine Learning Benchmark），一个基于公开全血 RNA 表达数据集 GSE17048（99 例 MS 患者与 45 名健康对照）的可复现、开放机器学习基准框架。该基准在统一、防泄漏的流水线中比较 8 种算法（逻辑回归、SVM、随机森林、梯度提升、KNN、朴素贝叶斯、神经网络、Stacking 集成），并提供外部模型提交接口。在分层留出集上，梯度提升以 93.83 的 MS Research Score 排名第一（AUC-ROC=0.989，灵敏度=0.950，特异度=0.778，F₁=0.927，Brier=0.050）。论文的核心贡献在于构建首个针对该任务的开放可重用基准框架，而非提出新的诊断模型。
AI.motivation: MS 诊断依赖临床评估、MRI 及鉴别诊断，血液 RNA 虽含免疫信号但不能替代临床诊断。高维小样本基因表达数据易因特征选择与超参调优不当造成评估偏差（数据泄漏、模型选择过拟合），且既往 MS 转录组 ML 研究多报告单次模型结果，缺乏可复现的标准化对比框架，限制了算法间的公平比较与外部验证。
AI.method: （1）数据：GSE17048 全血 mRNA 表达数据（144 例），将 PPMS、RRMS、SPMS 合并为 MS 正类，HC 为负类；（2）流水线：将中位数填补、方差过滤（top 1000）、标准化、SelectKBest 监督特征选择（≤200）、SMOTE（k=3）与分类器封装于 imbalanced-learn Pipeline，所有步骤仅在当前训练折内拟合以防泄漏；（3）评估：嵌套交叉验证（外层 5 折 + 内层 3 折）+ 未触及分层留出集（29 例）+ 2000 次 Bootstrap 置信区间；（4）模型：8 种基线算法 + 超参网格搜索（以 AUC-ROC 为目标）+ Stacking 集成；（5）指标：准确率、平衡准确率、灵敏度、特异度、F₁、MCC、AUC-ROC、PR-AUC、Brier；（6）复合评分：MS Research Score = 100×(0.25·AUC-ROC + 0.15·PR-AUC + 0.25·sensitivity + 0.15·specificity + 0.10·F₁ + 0.10·(1−Brier))；（7）外部模型接口：支持 EXTERNAL_MODELS 字典或 joblib/pickle 预训练模型提交。
AI.result: （1）嵌套交叉验证：SVM 以 77.62 居首，神经网络 76.17，逻辑回归 75.82，KNN 最低（61.89），表明模型排名对数据划分敏感；（2）留出集表现：梯度提升综合排名第一（Score=93.83，AUC=0.989 [95%CI: 0.947–1.000]，Sens=0.950，Spec=0.778，F₁=0.927，Brier=0.050），神经网络（91.24）、随机森林（90.47）、逻辑回归（90.26）、Stacking（89.51）依次居后；（3）误差权衡差异显著：随机森林灵敏度达 1.000 但特异度仅 0.667，KNN 特异度为 1.000 但灵敏度仅 0.550；（4）梯度提升兼具高判别力与最佳校准（Brier 最低）。
AI.conclusion: 论文明确提出"首个针对 GSE17048 全血 RNA MS vs. HC 分类的开放可重用基准框架"这一窄而精确的贡献定位，区别于既往 PBMC 阶段分类或诊断特征建模工作。基准证实该任务存在可学习信号，但严格限定于研究用途——MS Research Score 为探索性复合指标，未经临床验证；29 例留出集规模小，存在批次效应、年龄/性别/用药等混杂因素风险。未来工作方向包括：外部独立验证、跨平台基因映射、特征稳定性分析、通路富集、完整校准模块、评分权重敏感性测试、依赖锁定及外部模型治理（模型卡制度）。

title: When Do Corrective Features Help? An Agent for Corrective Feature Discovery on Black-Box Forecasters
summary: Frozen pretrained forecasters often fail in structured, recurring ways that are costly to repair through fine-tuning. We study corrective feature discovery: mining interpretable features of a frozen forecaster's residual to drive a lightweight post-hoc corrector. Prior automated feature engineering models the data-generating process; corrective features instead model the model-failure process. We present CRAFTER (Corrective Residual Agent with Feature-based Temporal Exploration and Reasoning), which keeps the backbone frozen and mines its residual with two complementary generators: a compositional search over the raw input channels, and a large language model (LLM) that proposes named feature combinations, binary flags, and short executable code. A single validation-grounded gate accepts or rejects every candidate regardless of its origin, and a validation-selected corrector applies the accepted features or leaves the forecast unchanged. This source-agnostic pipeline also allows prior feature-engineering systems to be evaluated under identical conditions, making CRAFTER an instrument for attributing forecast improvements to the feature source alone. Across six public datasets and six frozen backbones, CRAFTER surpasses every dedicated feature-engineering system at every feature budget, roughly doubling the improvement achieved by the corrector alone and reducing the error of the weakest backbones by up to 27%. These gains are robust across different LLM backends and persist even when applied on top of fine-tuned backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CRAFTER，一种针对冻结黑箱预测器残差进行可解释特征挖掘的后置校正代理；它通过组合搜索与 LLM 双生成器配合单一源无关验证门控，在不微调骨干的前提下，于 6 数据集×6 骨干的 36 格实验中超越所有专用特征工程系统，并对最弱骨干误差削减高达 27%。
AI.motivation: 大规模预测中预训练骨干常以冻结方式部署，但存在促销错过、状态切换滞后、事件尖峰低估等结构性错误，微调代价过高；传统自动特征工程建模数据生成过程而非模型失败过程，且残差特征挖掘的来源依赖性、骨干适用性、预算效应等问题尚未被系统刻画。
AI.method: CRAFTER 是一个源无关的残差校正框架：（1）保持骨干冻结，对残差而非真值进行特征挖掘；（2）两类互补生成器——组合搜索（基于 UCB1 MCTS，在原始通道上组合 15 种变换×8 种算子，按机制家族分组）与 LLM 推理（Planner/Specifier/Base Proposer/Reflection 四角色，提出 combo/flag/code 三类命名特征）；（3）单一源无关验证门控（Spearman 相关阈值 τ=0.05 + 共线性 + 预算）；（4）验证选择的 None/加性/乘性 GBDT 校正器集；（5）耦合模式 CRAFTER† 让 LLM 命名的新基列进入通道池供后续搜索组合；（6）结构化特征语法支持去重和审计。
AI.result: 在 6×6=36 格实验中 CRAFTER 在每个特征预算下均超越 TSFresh、CAAFE、LLM-FE；最弱骨干误差最高削减 27%，单独校正器提升约翻倍；核心条件是残差余量（headroom）而非骨干身份——骨干越弱、可挖掘结构越多则提升越大，饱和单元（m5）几乎无提升；LLM 命名特征是关键差异化项（组合搜索单独贡献≈0，LLM 加入后−0.037 wMAPE，74% 入选特征来自 LLM）；增益在 GPT-5.2 与 DeepSeek-3.4-pro 间鲁棒、在冻结与微调骨干间一致、跨时序窗口可迁移（median +0.2% vs self）；协变量应路由至校正器而非骨干（Toto 中性、Moirai-2 反而退化）。
AI.conclusion: 本文将特征发现的目标从"数据生成过程"重新定义为"模型失败过程"；CRAFTER 定位为部署期校正层而非骨干替代品；校正是否有效由残差余量而非骨干身份或预算决定，LLM 命名特征是弱骨干×语义协变量场景下的决定性来源；未来工作是构建跨窗口的特征记忆模块，摊销搜索成本并适应骨干错误的演变。

title: PPDL: LLM-Based Flows as Probabilistic Programs
summary: Building reliable applications that leverage large language models (LLMs) remains a significant challenge. While LLMs offer impressive capabilities across diverse tasks, their outputs often lack accuracy and provide no clear measure of confidence. This uncertainty compounds in flows of multiple calls to LLMs and other tools, making it difficult for developers and end-users to trust the results. This paper introduces a probabilistic language for programming LLM-based flows. It enables developers to quantify and propagate uncertainty throughout the application's flow, and experiment with different inference scaling techniques without adding a single line of code beyond the flow's logic. We present an experimental study to demonstrate this capability, and a case study building a theorem proving agent for the Rocq theorem prover.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于编程基于大语言模型（LLM）应用的概率编程语言，旨在量化和传播不确定性，使开发者无需修改流程逻辑即可尝试不同的推理扩展技术。
AI.motivation: LLM 虽然能力强大，但其输出缺乏准确性且没有明确的置信度度量。在由多个 LLM 调用和其他工具组成的复合流程中，这种不确定性会被放大，使得开发者和终端用户难以信任结果。因此，亟需一种机制来在基于 LLM 的应用流程中显式地建模和传播不确定性。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种概率编程语言，专门用于编程 LLM-based 流程（flows）。该语言允许开发者量化每个 LLM 调用的不确定性，并将其沿应用流程传播。同时，它支持在不额外编写代码的情况下，仅通过修改流程逻辑之外的配置来试验不同的推理扩展（inference scaling）技术。
AI.result: 论文展示了一项实验研究，验证了该概率语言在量化和传播不确定性方面的有效性；并通过一个为 Rocq 定理证明器构建定理证明智能体的案例研究，展示了该语言在实际复杂场景下的应用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该概率编程语言为构建可靠的 LLM 应用提供了一种系统性方案，通过将不确定性传播和推理扩展技术集成到编程抽象中，降低了开发可信 LLM 应用的难度，并为复杂任务（如自动定理证明）的实现提供了有力工具。

title: Decoupling Perception from Description: Computation-Grounded Representation Alignment between Multivariate Time Series and Language
comment: 46 pages, 9 figures, including supplementary material. Submitted to AAAI 2027. Xinran Feng and Yi Xie contributed equally
summary: Training multimodal models to align time series with language runs into a self-supervision trap. The usual recipe asks an LLM to read a series and write a description, so label quality is capped by the perceptual skill the model is supposed to learn. The data can never teach more than the labeler already knows. A second gap makes this worse: most datasets use a single variable, but the patterns that matter (cross-channel correlation, lead-lag structure, co-occurring anomalies) appear only with several variables, right where the labeling LLM's limits are most exposed. These two problems create a trilemma: existing methods are reliable, realistic, or scalable, but none achieves all three. We resolve this by decoupling perception from description. Deterministic code computes a set of statistics from real, open-source multivariate series; the LLM verbalizes those precomputed facts. Perception, which LLMs do poorly, is handled by computation, while the LLM handles expression. This produces CGTime, our 4B-parameter computation-grounded time-series-language model. CGTime outperforms far larger general-purpose models on multivariate understanding tasks: it attains the best multivariate fact score on our held-out benchmark (0.283 vs. 0.173 for GPT-4o-mini and 0.203 for GPT-5.4-nano), a gap that survives Holm-corrected paired significance tests against every baseline. It also states verifiable numerical facts in generated captions more accurately and covers a broader range of statistical properties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CGTime，一种 4B 参数的"计算驱动"多变量时序-语言模型。其核心思想是将"感知"与"表达"解耦：由确定性代码从开源多变量时序数据中预先计算统计特征，再由 LLM 仅负责将这些事实语言化，从而突破传统自监督式"LLM 既看又写"标签生成范式中感知能力的上限瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 时序-语言对齐训练普遍采用"LLM 阅读序列并生成描述"的自监督范式，存在两大问题：(1) 标签质量受限于标签模型本身的感知能力，数据无法教给模型超越其已有知识的内容；(2) 现有数据集多为单变量，但跨通道相关、领先-滞后结构、共现异常等关键模式只有在多变量下才会出现，而恰在这些地方 LLM 的感知能力最为薄弱。两者共同导致"可靠性/真实性/可扩展性"三者不可兼得的困境。
AI.method: 提出"感知-描述解耦"框架：(1) 感知阶段——使用确定性代码（非 LLM）对真实开源多变量时序数据计算一组预定义的统计量（涵盖跨通道相关、时滞结构、异常共现等）；(2) 表达阶段——LLM 仅将这些已计算好的数值事实语言化为自然语言描述。基于此构建 CGTime（4B 参数），并构建保留评估基准以衡量多变量事实陈述的准确性。
AI.result: 在自建的多变量事实评估基准上，CGTime 取得最佳多变量事实得分 0.283，显著优于 GPT-4o-mini（0.173）和 GPT-5.4-nano（0.203），且经 Holm 校正配对显著性检验后该优势在所有基线上均成立。此外，CGTime 生成的描述中可验证数值事实的准确率更高，且覆盖的统计属性范围更广。
AI.conclusion: 通过将"感知"交给确定性计算、"描述"交给 LLM，CGTime 打破了传统时序-语言对齐中"可靠、真实、可扩展"三者不可兼得的三角困境，在多变量时序理解任务上以小模型规模（4B）击败远更大的通用基线，验证了计算驱动范式在多变量时序对齐数据生成中的有效性。

title: Disentangling 3D Modeling from Spatial Reasoning
summary: In this work, we explore an alternative paradigm for spatial reasoning by explicitly disentangling 3D perception from reasoning, rather than jointly acquiring implicit 3D perception and reasoning through large-scale training. Our key observation is that modern perception models excel at estimating continuous 3D geometry, whereas large language models (LLMs) are particularly effective at compositional and symbolic reasoning. Motivated by these complementary strengths, we propose the Disentangled Spatial Reasoner (DiSR), a simple yet effective framework that reconstructs the physical world into structured 3D evidence using off-the-shelf expert perception models and fine-tunes an LLM with LoRA to perform reasoning solely over this explicit geometric evidence. Without large-scale 3D VQA training or complex tool-use policies, DiSR achieves competitive performance on popular spatial reasoning benchmarks. Beyond its strong performance, DiSR offers improved interpretability, modularity, and computational efficiency, demonstrating that explicit separation of perception and reasoning is a scalable and effective alternative paradigm to end-to-end modeling for spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DiSR（Disentangled Spatial Reasoner，解耦空间推理器），将 3D 感知与空间推理显式分离：通过现成的专家感知模型将物理场景重建为结构化的 3D 证据（位置、尺寸、朝向），再使用 LoRA 微调的 LLM 仅基于这些显式几何证据进行推理。该方法在 3DSRBench 和 SPAR-Bench 上达到新的 SOTA，训练成本仅需单卡 RTX 4080S 59 小时，远低于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理方法存在两类问题：(1) 在大规模 3D VQA 数据上端到端联合优化隐式 3D 感知与推理，需要海量数据和算力，且 3D 知识隐式嵌入潜空间、难以解释；(2) 智能体式工具调用方法需要学习复杂工具使用策略。作者观察到现代感知模型擅长连续 3D 几何估计，而 LLM 擅长组合与符号推理，二者能力互补，因此提出将二者显式解耦，让每个组件专注于其擅长的能力。
AI.method: DiSR 框架由两阶段组成：(1) 结构化 3D 证据构建——使用 Qwen3-VL-8B 进行问题解析与目标定位（生成 object slot 与 bounding box），然后调用冻结的 SAM 2.1 HQ 提取目标掩码、Metric3D v2 估计度量深度、WildCamera/PerspectiveFields 恢复相机内参与重力对齐朝向、OrientAnything 估计物体朝向，将所有目标反投影到统一重力对齐坐标系，得到包含中心位置 c_i、3D 范围 d_i、尺寸描述 σ_i/ρ_i、前向/左侧轴 f_i/l_i 的结构化证据；(2) 基于结构化证据的推理——将证据序列化为文本描述 E_T，使用 QLoRA（rank=128, 4-bit NF4 量化）微调 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的 LLM 部分，仅基于 (E_T, Q) 生成答案，无需图像输入。训练数据 0.33M，分两阶段监督问题解析与推理任务。
AI.result: (1) 3DSRBench 上以 67.62% 总体准确率达到 SOTA，较此前最佳的 HiSpatial-3B 提升 3.77%，多物体推理子任务提升约 12.1%；(2) SPAR-Bench 上以 46.33% 取得 SOTA，度量估计任务大幅领先（49.37% vs HiSpatial 的 29.10%）；(3) CV-Bench-3D 上取得 92.25%，与 Qwen3-VL-8B 相当，分析表明该基准存在 2D 捷径与图像低分辨率问题；(4) 训练效率极高，仅需 0.33M 样本、单卡 RTX 4080S 共 58.75 GPU 小时，远少于 HiSpatial 的 2B 样本、32×48 H100 小时；(5) 通用视觉推理基准（MMBench、GQA、POPE、SEED、RealWorldQA）性能与基模型持平，未出现灾难性遗忘；(6) 对象定位能力（IoU@0.5 81.84%）优于 SpatialReasoner 与 HiSpatial；(7) 消融实验证明：使用 GT 3D 证据时准确率接近 100%，验证了推理模块的有效性，主要瓶颈在物体定位与小目标的 3D 重建；(8) 跨 backbone 实验（Qwen2.5-VL-7B）验证了框架的模块化与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: DiSR 证明了将 3D 感知与空间推理显式解耦是一种可扩展且高效的空间智能范式。通过结构化的中间几何证据，该方法在显著降低训练成本与参数量的同时达到了 SOTA 性能，并带来了可解释性（推理过程可追溯到证据）、可诊断性（错误可归因于 grounding、3D 重建或推理三个组件）和模块化（可独立替换感知模型或 LLM backbone）的附加优势。这一范式为摆脱端到端大规模 3D 监督训练提供了新的方向。

title: Beyond Full-Model Rollback: AuroSFT for Adapter-State Multi-Task Fine-Tuning
summary: Multi-task supervised fine-tuning (SFT) often casts a heterogeneous data mixture as a single optimization problem, even though different tasks may reach their best generalization at different times. msft exposes this mismatch through task-wise roll-out, exclusion, and rollback, but its original formulation materializes the scheduler state as full-model checkpoints, making stage transitions costly to store, restore, and deploy. This paper introduces AuroSFT, a parameter-efficient framework that recasts the carried state of overfitting-aware multi-task SFT as a compact, mergeable adapter state. AuroSFT freezes the pretrained backbone, trains only injected adapters, rolls back adapter checkpoints at task-wise peaks, and continues on the remaining active mixture. At the layer level, each adapter applies an AuroRA-inspired adaptive nonlinear layer to a low-rank weight factor rather than to the sample representation. The resulting update remains linear in the input, rank-bounded, and exactly mergeable into the frozen projection. Under the retained-backbone comparison protocol, AuroSFT achieves 61.36% average accuracy, compared with 59.85% for the corresponding msft reference row, and obtains higher accuracy on all five backbones. Our code is available at the anonymous repository: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AuroSFT 框架，将多任务 SFT 中的过拟合感知调度（task-wise roll-out、exclusion、rollback）与参数高效的低秩适配器相结合，使用紧凑、可合并的非线性低秩适配器状态替代 mSFT 中的全模型回滚检查点，在五个轻量级骨干网络上将平均准确率从 mSFT 的 59.85% 提升至 61.36%，且适配器张量大小仅为全模型的 0.484%。
AI.motivation: 多任务监督微调（SFT）将异构任务混合视为单一优化问题，但不同任务可能在不同时刻达到最佳泛化。mSFT 虽通过任务级 roll-out、exclusion 和 rollback 解决了时序失配问题，但其调度状态以全模型检查点的形式物化，导致阶段转换的存储、恢复和部署成本高昂。因此，核心问题变为：在过拟合感知调度器中，应该在阶段间传递什么状态？本文主张用紧凑、可合并的适配器状态替代全模型检查点。
AI.method: AuroSFT 继承 mSFT 的迭代式 roll-out、峰值检测、任务排除和回滚调度逻辑，但将携带的状态从全模型替换为非线性权重变换的低秩适配器。具体而言：(1) 冻结预训练骨干网络 W₀，仅训练注入到 q/k/v/o/gate/up/down 投影中的低秩适配器（rank r=8, α=16）；(2) 在适配器内部，引入 AuroRA 启发的自适应非线性层（ANL）作用于低秩权重因子 A 而非样本表示，即 Ā = σ(A⊤)⊤，其中 σ 融合 tanh 通路与可学习 B-spline 通路；(3) 更新公式 ΔW = (α/r)BĀ，对输入保持线性、秩有界，且可精确合并回冻结投影（部署时将 W₀ 替换为 W₀+ΔW）；(4) 调度器仅在阶段转换时回滚紧凑的适配器状态 {A, B, ANL}，而非整个骨干网络。形式化上，AuroSFT 将多任务异构过拟合重构为"任务过拟合下的适配器状态迁移"问题，峰值检测和回滚指定训练状态何时迁移，而适配器参数化指定迁移什么对象。
AI.result: 在五个轻量级骨干网络（OLMo2-1B、Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B）和十个基准（CommonsenseQA、OpenBookQA、AQUA-RAT、GSM8K、SciQ、ARC-Easy、HellaSwag、WinoGrande、BoolQ、MedMCQA）的 5-shot 贪心平均准确率上，AuroSFT 达到 61.36%，相比 mSFT 参考行的 59.85% 提升 1.51 个百分点，且在所有五个骨干网络上均领先（OLMo2-1B: 48.40% vs 46.30%；Qwen2.5-0.5B: 41.75% vs 37.40%；1.5B: 65.85% vs 65.00%；3B: 73.30% vs 73.10%；7B: 77.50% vs 77.45%）。Qwen2.5-3B 上的消融实验显示：移除 Weight ANL 降至 72.40%（−0.90），移除 rollback 降至 72.70%（−0.60），SRO 与 Soft SRO 变体也均低于完整方法（72.50%、71.80%）。在 N∈{5,10,15} 任务组的尺度压力测试中，AuroSFT 相对固定混合 SFT 的增益（+11.9、+0.7、+0.6）均超过复现的 mSFT（+11.2、+0.4、+0.4）和 IES。MedMCQA 细粒度分解中，AuroSFT 在 11 个医疗子类别中相对 SFT 平均提升 +1.25（vs mSFT 的 +0.80），且在 8 个类别上严格更优。在效率方面，Qwen2.5-3B 上适配器张量状态仅为对应全模型张量状态的 0.484%。
AI.conclusion: AuroSFT 验证了"动态数据调度器所携带的状态本身是一个设计对象"这一核心论点：通过将过拟合感知调度与非线性权重变换低秩适配器耦合，实现了仅回滚适配器检查点的阶段迁移，同时保持输入线性、秩有界和可合并性。文章明确指出其新颖性不在于发现异构过拟合（属于 mSFT），也不在于直接采用输入级 AuroRA，而在于将阶段迁移状态从全模型替换为紧凑、可合并的合并后非线性低秩权重参数化。局限性方面，证据范围集中在五个轻量级骨干网络和 Qwen2.5-3B 诊断上，效率声明限于回滚存储和可合并部署，更强的因果证据仍需多种子实验和性能分析。

title: Beyond Rotations: AuroOFT for Expressive Quantized Orthogonal Fine-Tuning
summary: Quantized orthogonal fine-tuning (qoft) enables parameter-efficient adaptation of low-bit language models by learning structured activation rotations before frozen quantized weights. However, its task-specific updates remain constrained to linear orthogonal transformations, limiting input-dependent nonlinear corrections. We introduce AuroOFT, which keeps qoft as a stable quantization-compatible branch while attaching a zero-start gated low-rank nonlinear residual to each adapted linear layer. AuroOFT maps activations into an RMS-normalized compact latent space and uses adaptive nonlinear bases with bounded or token-dependent gating. The zero-initialized up projection makes AuroOFT functionally identical to qoft at initialization, while orthogonality remains a branch-level stability property rather than a property of the combined nonlinear layer. Under matched data, optimization, decoding, and parser protocols, AuroOFT improves Macro-6 over matched qoft by 1.30-2.70% on the 1.5B/3B Qwen2.5 settings, exceeds QLoRA by 6.52-10.62%, and saves 32.3-44.7% trainable parameters relative to QLoRA in representative scales. The small exam-style multiple-choice math set is treated only as a protocol-sensitivity diagnostic. Our code is available at the anonymous repository: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AuroOFT，一种针对低比特量化语言模型的参数高效微调方法。它在量化正交微调（QOFT）的稳定骨干之上，并行附加一条零初始化启动的门控低秩非线性残差分支，使模型在保持 QOFT 量化兼容性的同时获得输入依赖的非线性修正能力。
AI.motivation: QOFT 的任务更新被限制为线性正交变换（输入端的 Cayley-Neumann 旋转），难以表达数学推理中所需的输入依赖性局部非线性修正（如符号步骤、选项消除、数值比较等）。作者将此限制命名为"正交表达力瓶颈"，目标是在不破坏 QOFT 量化稳定性的前提下，为每一层引入受控的非线性修正能力。
AI.method: AuroOFT 将每个适配层分解为两条并行路径：上支路保留 QOFT（输入端旋转 + 冻结 NF4 权重）；下支路为非线性残差（降投影 → RMSNorm → 自适应非线性层 ANL → 零初始化上投影 → 门控 → α/r 缩放）。上投影零初始化保证初始时与 QOFT 功能完全等价。ANL 提供三种变体：(1) Lite（双 tanh + 可学习逐维残差尺度）；(2) SplineNorm（FP32 RMSNorm + tanh 边界化 + B 样条基）；(3) Enhanced Dual-ANL（tanh 分支与 SwiGLU 分支通过 softmax 权重混合）。门控支持标量、有界标量和 token 依赖三种形式。QOFT 与非线性分支使用独立参数组与学习率，支持选择性注入（Q/V 或 Q/K/V + MLP up/down）。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B（it 与 base）共 6 个设置上，使用 OpenR1-Math 数据、NF4 量化、OFT 块大小 32、5 阶 Cayley-Neumann、固定数据/优化器/解码/解析器协议的匹配评估下：AuroOFT 在 1.5B/3B 设置上较匹配 QOFT 在 Macro-6（AMC23/AQUA/CMATH/GaoKao/Minerva/OlympiadBench 六项平均）上提升 1.30–2.70 分；较 QLoRA 提升 6.52–10.62 分，同时在代表规模上节省 32.3%–44.7% 可训练参数（1.5B-it 省 8.26M，3B-it 省 7.99M，7B-it 省 17.77M）。消融显示 Lite < SplineNorm < Enhanced-r2 < Enhanced-r4，dual ANL + 有界/token 门控表现最佳。7B 规模结果混合，AQUA 与 SAT Math 对协议敏感。
AI.conclusion: AuroOFT 将正交性视为稳定骨干而非全局约束，将非线性视为零启动的受控残差修正。它在初始化时与 QOFT 功能等价，QOFT 函数族被包含于 AuroOFT 中，但整体映射因非线性残差不可与冻结量化权重合并而不再保持正交，需付出推理开销。在 1.5B/3B 设置下取得对 QOFT 的结构增益与对 QLoRA 的参数效率优势；SAT Math 等小样本/对协议敏感的基准仅用作诊断，不构成独立结构声明。

title: Evaluating Machine Learning Models for Post-Wildfire Debris-Flow Prediction
summary: Prediction of post-wildfire debris flows is critical for mitigating hazards to communities, infrastructure, and resources during intense rainfall in recently burned areas. However, identifying reliable machine learning models is complicated by overlapping debris-flow and non-debris-flow events in feature space, the need for model interpretability, and limited training data. This paper addresses these challenges through a systematic evaluation of machine learning models in terms of predictive performance, feature importance, and synthetic data augmentation. Using basin-scale observations of post-wildfire debris-flow events across the western United States, we compare 15 models, including the Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Network (TabPFN). Repeated stratified cross-validation shows that TabPFN achieves the highest unaugmented performance with a threat score of 0.637, closely followed by the best tree-based models. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) are used to identify the features driving predictions, revealing that short-duration rainfall intensity and storm accumulation consistently rank highest, while burn severity and terrain features contribute less. We further evaluate synthetic data augmentation using TabPFN-generated samples to address the scarcity of debris-flow observations. Synthetic augmentation improves the performance of all models except CNN, with the largest mean threat score increase of +0.041 among the deep learning models. By combining rigorous model benchmarking, interpretable feature analysis, and synthetic data augmentation, this work provides a comprehensive framework for improving post-wildfire debris-flow prediction.

AI.tldr: This study presents a systematic evaluation of 15 machine learning models across five families (logistic, distance/kernel-based, deep-learning, tree-based, and tabular foundation models) for post-wildfire debris-flow prediction using the USGS western US dataset (1,550 observations, 34 fires). The evaluation combines model benchmarking via repeated stratified cross-validation, SHAP feature importance analysis, and TabPFN-based synthetic data augmentation, finding that TabPFN and the top tree-based models cluster tightly at a threat score of ~0.62–0.64, far exceeding the operational Staley17 baseline (0.152), with rainfall intensity features consistently identified as the most important predictors.
AI.motivation: Post-wildfire debris flows pose severe hazards to communities and infrastructure during intense rainfall in burned areas, making accurate prediction critical for operational warning systems. However, the prediction task is hindered by three key challenges: (1) selecting the best model is difficult because debris-flow and non-event basins overlap heavily in feature space (rainfall, burn severity, terrain), with no clean threshold separating classes; (2) identifying which features high-performing models rely on is non-trivial yet essential for trust, generalization assessment, and avoiding spurious patterns; (3) training data is small (1,550 observations) and class-imbalanced (21.5% positive rate), constraining model learning. The paper motivates a rigorous multi-model evaluation framework addressing these gaps, particularly noting that prior studies compared few models with single train-test splits, rarely applied interpretation methods, and did not test new foundation models like TabPFN for this hazard prediction task.
AI.method: The methodology follows a rigorous experimental pipeline: (1) Data: USGS post-wildfire debris-flow dataset with 1,550 basin-storm observations, 10 features (6 rainfall, 4 basin/terrain), and binary response. (2) Cross-validation: Repeated stratified 5-fold CV (10 repeats = 50 outer folds) with identical splits across all models, plus inner 80/20 split for hyperparameter tuning via Bayesian optimization (100 trials, threat-score-optimized). (3) Preprocessing: Fold-fitted imputation using physical relationships (log-log regression for intensity-duration, monotonic constraints, median fill), with per-model-appropriate feature scaling. (4) 15 models evaluated across 5 families—Logistic (Staley17, LogisticRegression), Distance/Kernel (KNN, SVC), Deep-learning (MLP, CNN, LSTM, Transformer, Mamba), Tree-based (RandomForest, ExtraTrees, XGBoost, CatBoost, xRFM), and TabPFN (tabular foundation model with in-context learning). (5) SHAP analysis using permutation SHAP for TabPFN and TreeSHAP for tree-based models, evaluated through global rankings, fold stability, basin-level spatial maps, and alignment with physical expectations. (6) Synthetic data augmentation using TabPFN's unsupervised class-conditional autoregressive generator, with fidelity assessed via KS statistic, Wasserstein-1, and energy distance. Metrics: threat score (primary), F1, recall, precision, accuracy, AUC, with paired comparisons and Wilcoxon tests for statistical support.
AI.result: Key results: (1) Model comparison—TabPFN achieved the highest unaugmented threat score (0.637), narrowly followed by ExtraTrees (0.636), CatBoost (0.622), XGBoost (0.621), and Random Forest (0.620), forming a tightly clustered top tier with differences smaller than fold-to-fold variability (σ≈0.05). The operational Staley17 baseline scored only 0.152. Deep-learning models clustered at 0.43–0.46 with high recall but low precision. (2) Feature importance—SHAP analysis revealed rainfall features (PeakI15, StormAccum, PeakI30) consistently ranked highest across all four explained models, with high fold-stability, while burn severity (dNBR, PropHM23) and terrain features ranked lower. The four explained models agreed on physically expected positive SHAP directions for rainfall, burn severity, and soil erodibility. Basin-level maps showed spatial SHAP fields tracking feature fields for Grand Prix–Old fire (Spearman ρ=0.67–0.92), with weaker correspondence for Station fire on certain features. Soil erodibility (KF) showed the largest cross-model divergence (rank 3–4 for XGBoost/CatBoost vs. rank 10 for Random Forest). (3) Synthetic augmentation—Improved performance for 14 of 15 models except CNN, with the largest gain for Staley17 (+0.133 threat score, +0.241 recall) and notable gains for deep learning models (LSTM +0.076, MLP +0.078). Top-tier models improved by at most +0.022, suggesting they already approached the dataset's predictive ceiling. Synthetic data fidelity was high (KS D=0.024–0.154, energy distance 0.013–0.020). TabPFN gained only +0.004, indicating it did not disproportionately benefit from data matching its own distribution.
AI.conclusion: The study concludes that TabPFN and the leading tree-based models form a practical top tier for post-wildfire debris-flow prediction, achieving roughly fourfold improvement over the Staley17 operational baseline (threat score ~0.63 vs. 0.15). TabPFN offers a key practical advantage by requiring no dataset-specific hyperparameter tuning while matching tuned models' performance. The feature importance analysis demonstrates cross-model convergence on rainfall intensity and accumulation as the dominant predictive signals, supporting the physical interpretability of modern model predictions. Synthetic data augmentation is not a universal improvement but benefits most restricted models (Staley17) and certain deep-learning architectures, with marginal gains for top-tier models already near the dataset's information ceiling. The authors recommend that future work extend evaluation to multi-region datasets with strict spatial holdouts, longer post-wildfire temporal windows, and cost-sensitive threshold optimization reflecting asymmetric consequences of missed events versus false alarms. They emphasize that findings are most applicable to datasets with similar spatial/temporal scope, given the southern California concentration (61%) and first-two-year post-wildfire window of the training data.

title: Rectifying Geometric Misalignment: Online Source-Free Adaptation for Class-Imbalanced EEG
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) based Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) often require unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) to generalize across subjects and sessions. While Riemannian alignment methods like the Riemannian Centering Transformation (RCT) are effective for handling covariate shifts, they implicitly assume balanced class priors. However, in realistic online BCI scenarios, the label distributions vary dynamically (label shift), causing standard alignment techniques to geometrically misalign the target data distributions. In this work, we propose OSPDIM (Online SPD manifold information maximization), a source-free online UDA framework designed to address label shifts on the Riemannian manifold. OSPDIM introduces a manifold-constrained bias parameter into the tangent space mapping, which is optimized via information maximization to correct the geometric skew caused by imbalanced data streams. Unlike offline methods relying on global batch statistics, OSPDIM estimates and corrects geometric bias on-the-fly. Simulations on 2D SPD matrices visually demonstrate that OSPDIM successfully rectifies the misalignment where standard centering fails. Extensive experiments on multiple motor imagery datasets show that OSPDIM significantly outperforms standard Riemannian baselines, particularly in challenging online adaptation scenarios with severe class imbalance, offering a robust solution for practical, plug-and-play BCI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OSPDIM（Online SPD Manifold Information Maximization），一种面向在线、无源（source-free）场景的黎曼流形域自适应框架，通过在切空间映射中引入受流形约束的偏置参数 Φ_t 并利用信息最大化损失在线优化，修正由类别不平衡（label shift）造成的黎曼对齐几何错位问题。
AI.motivation: 1) EEG-BCI 普遍存在跨被试/跨会话的非平稳分布漂移，需要无监督域自适应（UDA），但当前流行的黎曼对齐方法（如 RCT）隐含类别先验平衡的假设；2) 实际在线 BCI 应用中，用户意图非均匀采样（疲劳、注意力波动等），导致目标域出现类别分布漂移（label shift），此时对齐边际分布的 Fréchet 均值会对多数类过度修正，造成类别聚类几何错位；3) 现有离线 SFUDA 方法依赖全局批次统计，无法满足在线流式数据的内存与计算约束。
AI.method: 1) 问题建模：假设源-目标域同时存在协变量漂移（covariate shift）与标签漂移（label shift），目标数据以流式/小批形式到达；2) 流形约束偏置参数：将 Φ_t ∈ S_D^+ 引入 SPD 切空间映射 m_φ(C_i) = upper ∘ log(Φ_t^{1/2} (C̄_t^{-1/2} C_i C̄_t^{-1/2}) Φ_t^{1/2})，外层乘法实现 SPD 流形上的几何平移；3) 在线更新协议：维护容量 N=32 的 FIFO 滑窗缓冲 ℬ_t，通过 Adam 计算欧氏梯度，并以 SPD 流形投影（retraction）将参数映射回 S_D^+，每样本执行 K=5 次迭代更新；4) 信息最大化损失 ℒ_IM = ℒ_CEM + ℒ_MEM（条件熵最小化 + 边际熵最大化），无需目标标签即可驱动 Φ_t 主动恢复类别平衡的质心；5) 源模型（TSMNet 特征提取器 f_θ 与分类器 g_ψ）在测试时保持冻结。
AI.result: 1) 2×2 SPD 流形仿真：在少数/多数类比例 0.1 的严重不平衡下，标准 RCT 将多数类质心拉离源域对应类别（黑色间隙），而 OSPDIM 通过 IM 优化使源-目标对应类别质心近乎重合；2) 运动想象数据集实验（BNCI2014001 9 被试、BNCI2015001 12 被试），不平衡比 ρ ∈ {0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4} 下的留一被试交叉验证：OSPDIM 在两个数据集所有不平衡比下均稳定取得相对于 EEGConformer 基线的正向平衡准确率增益，BNCI2014001 上较 Online RCT 提升 >15%；3) 消融实验：学习率 η≈0.005 时性能最佳（≈66.3%），η 过小更新迟缓、η 过大在缓冲噪声下不稳定，揭示在线 BCI 中响应性与稳定性的权衡；4) 与离线 SPDIM 上界相比仍存在差距，但显著弥补了 Online RCT 失败与离线参考之间的鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: OSPDIM 通过解耦几何中心化与分布对齐，在严格在线、无源条件下有效纠正由标签漂移引起的黎曼几何错位，为实际即插即用（plug-and-play）BCI 系统提供了鲁棒解决方案；其流形约束偏置 + 信息最大化的设计可推广至其他存在动态类别不平衡的流式域自适应场景。未来工作包括将该几何偏置校正机制集成至端到端深度学习架构中，以从原始 EEG 信号层面进一步增强表征学习。

title: QEvict: Recoverable Quantized KV Eviction for Attention-Drift-Robust Long-Context Decoding
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures. The first four authors contributed equally
summary: Autoregressive large language model inference is increasingly constrained by the memory footprint of the Key-Value (KV) cache. A dominant line of work reduces this footprint by evicting tokens that appear unimportant under attention-derived scores. However, such policies make an implicit irreversible decision: once a token is evicted, it cannot become useful again. We show that this assumption is brittle during decoding. Token and window importance drift as generated queries evolve, causing standard eviction policies to permanently discard states that later receive substantial attention under the full-cache model. To characterize this behaviour, we introduce Future Missed Mass and Global LIR, two diagnostics that measure future attention assigned to discarded states and the reactivation of historically inactive regions. We propose QEvict, a three-tier KV-cache management scheme that replaces binary retain-or-delete eviction with recoverable eviction. QEvict maintains high-confidence windows in full precision, stores intermediate windows in a quantized recoverable tier, and deletes only the lowest-confidence windows. During decoding, cumulative attention scores update window importance and when a quantized window becomes important again, it is dequantized and promoted to the full-precision. Under a fixed memory budget, this design preserves broader historical context while retaining exact full precision for the most important regions. Across long-context understanding, retrieval, and reasoning benchmarks, QEvict consistently improves over representative eviction and quantization baselines, reducing missed attention and improving information retention

AI.tldr: QEvict 提出了一种三层级 KV 缓存管理方案，通过可恢复的量化中间层取代传统的二元保留/驱逐决策，将历史窗口动态路由到全精度、可恢复 INT2 量化或驱逐状态，在固定内存预算下显著改善长上下文 LLM 解码的质量-内存权衡。
AI.motivation: 自回归 LLM 推理受 KV 缓存内存占用限制，现有压缩方法（驱逐或量化）存在根本缺陷：（1）驱逐方法将缓存管理视为不可逆的二元决策，而解码过程中 token/窗口重要性会随生成查询动态漂移（attention drift），导致后续重要状态被永久丢弃；（2）token 级独立决策会破坏局部连贯的上下文信息；（3）量化方法虽保留更广历史覆盖，但缺乏在执行精度与缓存驻留之间的动态管理机制。
AI.method: QEvict 采用三层级字节约束缓存层级架构：（1）保护性 sink token 与最近区域保留为全精度；（2）历史 KV 被划分为连续窗口（默认 Ω=8），按累积注意力分数排序；（3）路由策略将排名最高的 K_f 个窗口分配到全精度层，次高的 K_q 个分配到可恢复 INT2 量化层，其余驱逐。关键设计包括：连续窗口作为路由单元以保持局部连贯性；写一次量化账本（persistent quantization ledger）防止跨迁移的误差累积；非对称低比特量化（key 按通道、value 按 token）；累积注意力评分动态更新窗口重要性，支持量化→全精度的提升（promotion）路径。论文还引入三个诊断指标：Future Missed Mass（FMM，衡量丢弃状态被未来注意力命中的比例）、Global LIR（衡量历史非活跃窗口重新激活率）和 Selection Churn（衡量路由决策的稳定性）。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 三个模型上，针对 LongBench（12 任务）、RULER（13 任务，32K 上下文）和 GSM8K 三个基准进行全面评估。在 20% KV 预算下，LongBench 上 QEvict 在 Llama 取得 46.4、Mistral 取得 37.8 的宏平均分，超过最强驱逐基线（44.0/37.4）；在 5% 极严格预算下优势扩大至 9.7 和 4.7 分。RULER 上以 87.6 分超过 Layer-DefensiveKV 1.2 分、超最强量化基线 8.6 分，仅距 Full-KV 参考 2.4 分。GSM8K 推理任务上同样在多种内存预算下保持领先。消融研究验证 Ω=8、q=0.70（INT2 占比）、INT2 精度为最优配置。端到端效率方面，eager SDPA 后端下 TTFT 仅增 0.5%、TPOT 降 9.3%、吞吐提升 9.8%；FlashAttention-2 下峰值 GPU 内存降低 29.7%（29.54→20.78 GB）。
AI.conclusion: QEvict 证明了将驱逐从一次性不可逆决策转变为全精度→可恢复量化→驱逐的动态分层过程的可行性。连续窗口路由有效抑制了 token 级选择波动，可恢复量化层在固定字节预算下扩展了历史覆盖范围。该框架兼容多种重要性排序函数，模块化程度高。在长上下文理解、检索与推理任务上均持续优于代表性驱逐与量化基线，为长上下文 LLM 推理提供了实用的缓存压缩替代方案。未来工作将聚焦于融合低比特注意力内核、消除显式注意力分数物化开销，并探索自适应窗口边界。

title: Quantum-Structured World Models (QSWMs) for Predictive Latent Dynamics
summary: World models learn latent states that summarize interaction histories, evolve over time, and support prediction, simulation, or planning. Most existing world models represent these states using classical vectors, probability distributions, recurrent hidden states, or transformer activations. In this paper, we introduce Quantum-Structured World Models (QSWMs), a quantum-inspired framework for predictive world modeling with structured latent states, latent transition operators, and measurement-inspired decoding maps. We study whether mathematical structures inspired by quantum theory, such as complex-valued representations and density-matrix-like latents, provide useful inductive biases for world modeling. We establish three foundational properties: classical inclusion, predictive sufficiency, and structured compactness. We then instantiate complex-valued and density-matrix-like QSWM variants and evaluate them on elementary cellular automata against strong classical baselines. Results show promising local predictive potential for complex-valued QSWMs, while also revealing limitations in long-horizon rollout, density-matrix variants

AI.tldr: 本文提出量子结构世界模型（QSWMs），一个将量子理论启发的数学结构（如复数表示和密度矩阵式潜变量）引入预测型世界建模的表示级框架。作者建立了三个基础性质（经典包含性、预测充分性、结构紧凑性），并在初等元胞自动机上验证了ComplexQSWM和DensityQSWM两种实例化变体。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型普遍使用经典向量、概率分布、循环隐藏状态或Transformer激活来表示潜状态，这些表示主要将潜信息编码为特征或概率，未能显式建模量子启发的结构（如复振幅、密度算子、潜在替代方案之间的相干性关系）。作者希望探索量子理论启发的数学结构是否能作为预测型世界建模的有用归纳偏置。
AI.method: 1. 提出QSWM形式化定义：将交互历史编码为量子结构潜状态ρ_t、通过潜转移算子T演化、用测量启发的解码映射M提取预测。2. 建立三个定理：经典包含性（对角密度算子可恢复经典概率潜世界模型）、预测充分性（最优潜状态保留预测未来所需信息）、结构紧凑性（张量网络结构的预测分布可用O(nχ²)参数表示）。3. 实例化两个量子启发变体：ComplexQSWM（实部+虚部复数潜状态，L2归一化，复数线性转移）和DensityQSWM（秩1正半定密度矩阵，迹归一化，通过AθρAθ⊤演化）。4. 在Rule 30/90/110初等元胞自动机上对比容量匹配、双倍潜变量、归一化等强经典基线，评估单步BCE、Acc@1/3/5/10、递归展开、潜状态探测和OOD泛化性能。
AI.result: ComplexQSWM取得最强单步预测性能（BCE=0.4890，Acc@1=0.7364），在所有规则上显著优于参数匹配、双倍潜变量和归一化经典基线，并在潜维度扩展（d=16/32/64/128）和初始密度分布偏移实验（OOD测试）中保持鲁棒性。然而在长时域递归展开中优势减弱，密度矩阵变体整体表现较弱，线性探测准确率低于经典基线（0.6824 vs 0.7988），表明其预测增益并非来自更易线性解码的潜状态，而是源自结构化的潜动力学。
AI.conclusion: QSWM为研究量子结构潜表示在世界模型中的作用提供了原则性和可测试的框架。ComplexQSWM展现出超越参数数量、潜维度和归一化等混淆因素的有用局部预测归纳偏置，支持量子结构表示作为预测型世界建模的潜在表征基础。不足在于长时域展开性能有限、密度矩阵变体效果较弱、潜状态可解释性不足。未来工作可拓展至混合量子-经典QSWM、量子原生QSWM，以及符号环境、物理仿真、量子物理系统和规划控制等更广泛的评估场景。

title: Spectral Distillation: From Nonlinear Dynamics to Linear State-Space Models
summary: Can nonlinear dynamical systems be learned through a compact linear state-space representation, without directly solving a non-convex system-identification problem? We give a provable pipeline for doing so. Starting from observations of an unknown nonlinear dynamical system, we first learn an implicit spectral predictor using Observation Spectral Filtering (OSF), a convex method that competes with the best linear observer for the system. We then apply spectral-to-LDS distillation to convert this predictor into an explicit recurrent linear dynamical system. Our main theorem shows that the average prediction error of the distilled LDS decomposes into an exponentially-small distillation term and the OSF learning term governed by the Luenberger complexity of the best observer. The guarantee is dimension-free: it depends on observer complexity rather than on the latent dimension needed to represent the nonlinear system. To our knowledge, this yields the first end-to-end provable method for extracting a best-in-hindsight LDS representation of nonlinear dynamics through convex learning followed by provable distillation. Experiments on linear LDS benchmarks and MuJoCo behavior cloning show that the train-then-distill pipeline produces compact LDS predictors that match or outperform directly trained baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"先训练再蒸馏"的管道，将非线性动力系统观测转换为紧凑的线性状态空间模型（LDS）。通过观测谱滤波（OSF）的凸优化学习隐式谱预测器，再通过谱到LDS蒸馏转换为显式递归线性系统，并给出维度无关的预测误差保证。
AI.motivation: 非线性动力系统的辨识本质是非凸问题，不稳定且脆弱。直接从数据中拟合状态空间模型或者其最佳线性近似都存在根本性困难。如何在不求解非凸辨识问题的情况下，从非线性系统的观测中提取一个忠实表示原系统行为的紧凑线性动力系统，是本文要解决的核心问题。
AI.method: 提出两阶段管道：(1) 谱学习阶段——使用观测谱滤波（OSF），一种基于固定时序特征空间的凸方法，与系统的最佳线性观测器竞争，获得由Luenberger复杂度控制的预测误差界；(2) 蒸馏阶段——应用SpectraLDS将谱卷积预测器转换为有限维递归LDS，通过有限个几何响应模式近似谱滤波器。完整算法以隐式OSF预测器配合AR项作为输入，输出具有O(h·(d_in+d_out))存储与计算量的标准LDS。主定理证明平均预测误差分解为指数衰减的蒸馏项和由Q*控制的OSF学习项。
AI.result: 在长记忆线性LDS基准（d=16, d_state=64, ρ(A)=0.999）上，STU→SpectraLDS在Adam下优于直接训练的Diagonal LDS和General LDS，配合ONS优化器时误差可降低三个数量级；在六个MuJoCo行为克隆任务中，蒸馏后的LDS在四个环境（Walker2d、Hopper、HalfCheetah、Humanoid）上获得最高奖励，并以参数匹配的优势击败直接训练的Diagonal LDS基线。蒸馏前后测试MSE的相对差异低于1.5%。
AI.conclusion: 凸谱参数化与蒸馏的组合提供了一个原则性的路径，从非线性观测中学习紧凑且可解释的线性状态空间模型。其优势源于谱参数化的凸性而非更丰富的模型类别。理论上的开放方向包括对λ_max(F)的更紧致界、以及将一步预测误差界扩展到闭环滚动误差界。

title: IFlowNets: Extending Generative Samplers to Learn Strategies in Incomplete Information Games
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Dynamics at the Frontiers of Optimization, Sampling, and Games
summary: While many algorithms blend reinforcement learning (RL) with counterfactual regret (CFR) methods to leverage tradeoffs in computational speed and performance, there are fewer investigations into generative sampling frameworks in game theoretic applications in incomplete information games. We extend a generative flow network framework, Adversarial Flow Networks (AFlowNets), to incomplete information games, called Information Flow Networks (IFNs). We prove that previously established constraints for generative flow networks in complete information games are inadmissible for obtaining valid densities (corresponding to player strategies) and a valid training objective. We show that our proposed generalization, IFlowNets, alleviates this issue and strictly generalizes AFlowNets. In preliminary results for three standard game environments, IFlowNets perform comparably to or better than Outcome Sampling Monte Carlo Counterfactual Regret (OSMCCFR) and standard RL-based methods in performance and speed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"信息流网络"（IFlowNets）的新型生成式流网络框架，用于解决不完全信息博弈问题。该框架扩展了现有的对抗流网络（AFlowNets），通过证明并克服原有约束在不完全信息博弈中无法获得有效策略密度的问题，在三个标准博弈环境中达到了与现有方法（OSMCCFR和基于RL的方法）相当或更好的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注将强化学习（RL）与虚拟遗憾最小化（CFR）方法相结合以平衡计算速度和性能，但在不完全信息博弈中对生成式采样框架的探索不足。此外，现有的对抗流网络（AFlowNets）在不完全信息博弈中存在理论局限性，即原有约束无法获得有效的玩家策略密度。
AI.method:
1. 理论分析：证明AFlowNets中既定约束在不完全信息博弈中不可采纳（无法获得有效密度和有效训练目标）
2. 提出IFlowNets（Information Flow Networks）：作为AFlowNets的严格泛化，适配不完全信息博弈场景
3. 采用生成式流网络（GFlowNet）框架进行策略采样
4. 在三个标准博弈环境中进行实验对比
AI.result:
在三个标准博弈环境的初步实验结果表明：
- 性能方面：IFlowNets的表现与或优于Outcome Sampling Monte Carlo Counterfactual Regret (OSMCCFR)和标准基于RL的方法
- 速度方面：IFlowNets也展现出有竞争力的计算效率
AI.conclusion: IFlowNets成功地将生成式流网络框架推广到不完全信息博弈场景，严格泛化了AFlowNets，解决了原有框架在不完全信息博弈中策略密度无效的问题，为博弈论应用中的生成式采样提供了一种新的有效方法。

title: EvoHarness-RL: Learning Self-Evolving Runtime Harness for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents increasingly rely on external execution support to maintain state, track progress, invoke tools, verify outcomes, and reuse experience across interactions. However, effective harness use raises two coupled challenges: state formation from noisy interaction traces and runtime control over external-state access. Existing agents usually handle both through prompts, heuristics, or domain-specific conventions, leaving the external workspace and its usage policy manually engineered. To address this, we study the problem of harness policy learning, where agents learn harness policies offline and deploy them to construct and update external harness state online during runtime task execution. We introduce EvoHarness-RL, which exposes Belief, Progress, and Experience (BPE) as policy-facing harness state. Supervised harness fine-tuning teaches the base agent the harness action space and how to construct useful external state, while cost-aware GRPO explores coordination policies to selectively read, update, and consolidate that state during long-horizon interaction. Instantiated on ALFWorld with a Qwen3-8B LLM, EvoHarness-RL reaches 96.9% success and reveals two key dynamics: harness annealing, where training internalizes recurring harness-use patterns into the model policy and shifts the agent from frequent harness calls toward selective external-state access, and harness evolution, where progress updates and experience consolidation refine the harness into a compact, task-adaptive state substrate. These results suggest that long-horizon agents benefit from trainable policies for constructing and coordinating with external harness workspaces, beyond simply adding stronger tools or larger memories.

AI.tldr: EvoHarness-RL提出了一种可训练的智能体-外部harness协调层，通过统一的BPE（Belief、Progress、Experience）状态抽象和四个harness元动作（track、commit、recall、note），结合SFT与成本感知GRPO两阶段训练，使长时程LLM智能体能够学习如何自主构建、访问和整合外部工作空间状态，在ALFWorld上以Qwen3-8B达到96.9%成功率。
AI.motivation: 长时程LLM智能体依赖外部执行支持（记忆、工具、状态追踪器、验证器等），但现有方法通常通过提示词、启发式或领域约定来管理harness使用，存在两个耦合挑战：(1) 从噪声交互轨迹中形成有用外部状态；(2) 运行时对外部状态访问的代价控制。现有harness使用策略多为人工工程化，智能体未被训练来决定何时形成、访问、更新和整合外部支持作为其决策过程的一部分。
AI.method: 方法包含四个核心组件：(1) **统一BPE抽象**：将异构harness组件抽象为Belief（环境状态估计）、Progress（子目标执行状态）、Experience（跨episode知识）三种策略可见状态；(2) **harness元动作协议**：定义四个紧凑动作——track（读取belief）、commit（写入progress）、recall（检索experience）、note（记录新洞察）；(3) **环境适配器**：作为通用BPE接口与领域特定实现之间的桥梁，在ALFWorld中将belief实现为基于规则的世界状态追踪器，progress为有界子目标列表，experience为跨episode技能库（采用LFU淘汰）；(4) **两阶段训练管道**：先用SFT在专家示范上bootstrappingharness使用语义，再用成本感知GRPO优化奖励函数 R(τ) = R_succ + λ_eff·R_eff + λ_div(u)·R_div - λ_spam·R_spam - λ_inv·R_inv，其中多样性奖励权重采用余弦退火。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld 140任务seen split上，EvoHarness-RL（Qwen3-8B）达到96.9%平均成功率（Pick 100、Look 92.9、Clean 95.5、Heat 100、Cool 92.6、Pick2 100），相较ReAct基线提升+49.0绝对值，超越SkillOS（80.2%）和SkillRL（89.9%）；unseen split达86.6%。BPE组件消融显示移除任一组件都会显著降低性能（移除Experience降至48.6%）。前缘模型上也验证通用性：Claude Opus 4.5 + EvoHarness-Base提升至98.5%，GPT-4.1提升+22.1，GPT-5提升+25.7。分析揭示两个动态：(1) **harness退火**：GRPO训练将频繁的harness调用（约每episode多次）逐步内部化至约1次/ep，且不同动作衰减速率不同（recall最持久，commit/note快速衰减）；(2) **harness演化**：技能库经历快速扩张后通过合并、淘汰形成紧凑的任务自适应状态基底。
AI.conclusion: EvoHarness-RL将harness使用从人工提示约定转变为可学习的运行时策略决策，通过BPE统一抽象和成本感知GRPO训练，证明长时程智能体受益于针对外部工作空间构建与协调的可训练策略，而不仅仅是更强的工具或更大的记忆。训练奖励持续高于标准GRPO，表明harness调用减少并非策略崩溃，而是选择性成本感知的协调学习。该方法在prompt-time、SFT和GRPO三个层次均证明有效，具有模型规模无关的通用性。

title: Hybrid Probabilistic Zonotopes for Identifiable and Refinable Predictive Uncertainty
summary: Probabilistic prediction heads in neural networks typically output either a Gaussian mixture or a single conformal region. Neither separates the distinct sources of uncertainty often present in real prediction tasks: a discrete choice among modes, bounded systematic drift within the chosen mode, and irreducible stochastic noise. We introduce the Hybrid Probabilistic Zonotope (HProbZ), an output head that represents these three sources as binary, bounded, and stochastic generators of a zonotope, and admits a closed-form likelihood by convolution. Sharing the bounded generator across prediction steps couples future predictions algebraically, so observing one step refines the predictive distribution at every remaining step in a single forward pass. We establish that the three generators are identifiable from the likelihood up to permutation, and that an HProbZ density is representationally distinct from any finite Gaussian mixture. The same shared structure provides analytic per-mode risk and distribution-free multi-modal conformal sets at inference time. Empirical analysis on representative prediction benchmarks supports the effectiveness of the design relative to same-encoder mixture baselines, while offering structural properties that mixture or convex-conformal predictors do not jointly provide.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"混合概率Zonotope (HProbZ)"的新型神经网络预测头，用于轨迹预测等任务中同时建模三类不确定性来源：(1) 离散模式选择（二元生成器）、(2) 有界系统性漂移（有界生成器）、(3) 不可约随机噪声（高斯生成器）。HProbZ通过闭式卷积似然进行训练，并具备理论可识别性、单次前向传播下的观测驱动不确定性收缩、解析的逐模式风险评估以及免分布的多模态保形预测集等结构性质。
AI.motivation: 现有的概率预测头（如高斯混合网络MDN或单凸集保形预测）无法将模式选择、有界漂移和随机噪声这三类不确定性源分离开。MDN只能重新加权模式而不能收紧模式内协方差；保形方法在多模态目标上会膨胀为单一凸集；共享潜变量CVAE虽然能收缩但将三者混合为单一高斯。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出一种能同时提供可识别分解、观测驱动收缩、解析风险和多模态保形覆盖的结构化输出头。
AI.method: 核心方法HProbZ定义为中心c加上三类生成器的zonotope：二元生成器G_b（控制离散模式）、有界生成器G_d（共享于所有未来时间步，控制连续漂移）、高斯生成器G_s（控制随机噪声）。关键设计在于有界生成器G_d在所有预测步间共享，使得观测到任意一步都能通过代数约束同时收紧所有剩余步的不确定性。训练使用闭式Uniform-Gaussian卷积似然，避免高斯近似导致的不可识别性。理论证明包括：定理2（HProbZ密度不属于任何有限高斯混合）、定理3（三类生成器在似然下可识别）、定理7（约束HProbZ在观测下以O(1/k)速率收缩有界方差）、定理6（分布无关的多模态保形覆盖保证）。实验在ETH/UCY、nuScenes、Argoverse 2三个基准上进行匹配编码器的对比。
AI.result: 实验结果：(1) 在ETH/UCY上，Social HProbZ达到minADE/minFDE为0.197/0.332，匹配LED和EqMotion；(2) 在nuScenes上达到minADE@10为1.29±0.07（14种子），接近map-aware的MID(1.44)；(3) 在Argoverse 2上minADE在所有K值下均优于MDN-K2约7%；(4) 观测驱动收缩：ETH/UCY揭示8步后预测标准差收缩23.6%，FDE改善16.5%，而MDN FDE恶化9.6%；(5) 闭环避碰测试：在nuScenes上N=39,829个场景中轨迹级碰撞减少30%（MDN反向时单步表现更优）；(6) 多模态保形集：体积比标准CP和MDN-CP小3.9/13.9个数量级（在ETH/UCY/Argoverse 2平均）。
AI.conclusion: HProbZ是一种结构化输出头，能将模式、有界漂移和随机不确定性分别保持为可识别状态。其同时具备四种先前方法无法联合提供的结构性质：可识别分解、观测驱动O(1/k)收缩、解析逐模式风险、分布无关多模态保形覆盖。局限性包括：跨数据集迁移基本为负（全混合零样本AUC接近机会水平），闭环排序取决于度量指标（轨迹级正向但单步反向），SOTA结果依赖于方法特定的初始化（对称破缺），原始NLL劣于MDN（紧支集误设惩罚）。这些结构优势为下游安全关键规划提供了比高斯混合更可靠的概率基础。

title: KV-Skill: Forging Expertise in the Model's Native Language
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables. Zhaowei Han and Xiang Zhang contributed equally to this work. Code: this https URL
summary: Task knowledge is commonly stored either as text in the prompt or as an update to model weights. Text is modular but must be interpreted on every use, while weight adaptation makes the resulting capability difficult to load, remove, or share independently. We introduce KV-Skill, a design space of external factorized operators that a frozen language model reads through a lightweight interface. KV-Skill supports two complementary paths. Registration converts an authored text skill into a text-derived operator and trains a shared per-backbone interface. Reward learning develops a compact latent operator directly from task outcomes, with or without an authored skill. Neither path adds positions to the prompt. Across ten benchmarks and four backbones from three model families, converting text to a KV-Skill consistently makes the same procedural knowledge more effective. On Qwen3.5-4B LiveMath, registration reaches 77.2 accuracy, compared with 23.4 for the source text skill, 52.0 for SkillOpt, and 64.5 for SoftSkill. Under matched reward training and parameter budgets, KV-Skill gives the best result in seven of eight matched settings against soft prefixes, prefix tuning, and LoRA. A post-hoc rank analysis further shows that text-derived operators retain nearly all of their benefit with one task-aligned direction per injection layer, while matched random directions fail. Finally, one shared interface retains three independently loadable KV-Skills without measurable forgetting. These results show that task knowledge can be acquired from text or experience, compressed into an external operator, and deployed separately from the backbone. Code is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: KV-Skill 提出了一种外部因子化关联算子设计空间，将任务知识存储在模型残差流之外的算子中，通过轻量级接口被冻结的语言模型读取。系统支持两种互补路径：注册（Registration）将文本技能转换为文本衍生算子并训练共享接口；奖励学习（Reward Learning）从任务反馈直接发现紧凑的潜在算子，二者均不增加提示位置。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在任务知识存储上存在困境：文本技能模块化好但每次使用都需解读，权重适配（LoRA等）有效但难以独立加载、移除或共享，连续提示（前缀调优）仍占用注意力状态并在模仿训练下学习。论文旨在解决模态性与有效性之间的鸿沟：能否让任务知识以模型原生形式存在、按需加载、并直接从经验中发展？
AI.method: 核心方法是将 KV-Skill 定义为因子化关联算子 M_s = W_s U_s^T，通过单独残差分支在注入层被读取，而非占用注意力 KV 缓存。读取方式为 Read(M_s, q) = (1/√m_s) W_s (U_s^T q)，其中 U_s 列作为键、W_s 列作为值，通过轻量级接口（投影 A、B 和门控 g_ℓ、γ_ℓ）连接冻结骨干。两种构造方式：（1）文本衍生——通过一次预填获取各层残差状态，设置 U_s = W_s = H̄_s，从文本技能编译出层特异性算子，然后注册训练共享接口（结合 KL 散度匹配教师与 CE 监督）使其学会读取；（2）奖励学习——联合优化紧凑因子对（共享于所有深度、32 slot、256 维）和任务接口，使用组内归一化奖励的 REINFORCE 式优化，可从随机或文本初始化启动。
AI.result: 在 10 个基准、4 个骨干（Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、GLM-4.7-Flash、gpt-oss-20b）上：（1）注册显著提升文本技能效果，Qwen3.5-4B LiveMath 从 23.4 提升到 77.2，超过 SkillOpt（52.0）和 SoftSkill（64.5）；（2）匹配奖励训练与参数预算下，KV-Skill 在 8 个设置中 7 个最优，超过软前缀、前缀 KV 和 LoRA；（3）秩分析显示注册的文本衍生算子可压缩至每注入层一个任务对齐方向（保留 90-100% 增益），随机方向仅保留至多 22%；（4）查询依赖的条件操控比固定方向提升 25.0 点；（5）一个共享接口可保留三个独立可加载的 KV-Skill 且无可测量遗忘。资源方面：KV-Skill 不增加提示位置，预填开销 1-2%，解码开销 6.5%，秩一算子仅约 20 KiB。
AI.conclusion: KV-Skill 证明了任务知识可以存在于提示和骨干之外，且能以多种形式实现。注册将书面流程编译为更有效的条件操控，奖励学习发现多槽潜在算子，二者共享同一关联读取机制。机制上，注册将文本蒸馏为紧凑的任务对齐条件操控（一个方向+查询依赖强度），能力始终驻留于加载的算子 M_s 而非接口中。KV-Skill 定义了外部任务知识的设计空间：知识源（文本或经验）、表示（层特异或共享）和部署（加载/替换/移除）可被分离，从而实现可重用、可压缩、可独立管理的外部能力库。

title: Align-RAG: Alignment Is All You Need for TSFM In-Context Learning
summary: Retrieval-augmented forecasting promises to adapt frozen Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) to new domains without fine-tuning, but recent methods typically rely on learned fusion modules, i.e., trained adapters that merge retrieved examples into the backbone's forecast, based on the assumption that frozen backbones cannot dynamically incorporate retrieved context on their own. We show this assumption is unnecessary. We introduce Align-RAG, a training-free method that applies a closed-form per-pair amplitude rescaling and integer-lag phase shift to retrieved past-future windows before they enter a frozen backbone's context. With no learned parameters, Align-RAG outperforms the state-of-the-art trained retrieval adapter on a frozen Chronos-Bolt on all seven datasets of the standard benchmark (avg -3.75% MSE), showing that the gains previously attributed to learned fusion are recoverable without any training. Align-RAG further improves zero-shot MSE on four additional frozen TSFMs with various architectures by 2.5% to 13.7% per backbone with no per-backbone tuning. To probe why alignment helps, we compare the frozen backbone's prediction shift under aligned demonstrations to the closed-form ridge prediction shift on the same pairs. We find that aligned demonstrations induce prediction shifts that track a closed-form ridge predictor on the same pairs, with a future-shuffle control ruling out a futures-averaging account. Together, these results indicate that frozen TSFMs already support dynamic in-context use of retrievals, and that closed-form alignment should be the default baseline for retrieval-augmented forecasting before any fusion module is trained. Code available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: Align-RAG提出了一种无需训练的检索增强时间序列预测方法，通过对检索到的过去-未来窗口进行振幅重缩放和整数滞后相移对齐，在冻结的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）上下文中使用。在标准七数据集基准上，该方法在冻结的Chronos-Bolt上优于当前最优的训练型检索适配器TS-RAG（平均MSE降低3.75%），并在另外四个冻结TSFM上也取得了2.5%-13.7%的零样本MSE改进。研究还发现，对齐后的演示文稿能使模型的预测偏移追踪闭式岭回归预测器，通过未来洗牌控制实验排除了"对未来取平均"的解释。
AI.motivation: 现有的检索增强时间序列预测方法（如TS-RAG、TimeRAF、RATD、RAFT等）普遍依赖学习的融合模块（如训练好的适配器、注意力块、预测头等）来将检索样本合并到骨干网络的预测中，其核心假设是冻结的预训练时间序列基础模型缺乏动态整合外部上下文的能力。作者质疑这一假设的必要性，旨在证明：仅通过对检索样本进行闭式对齐，无需任何训练即可恢复甚至超越学习融合带来的增益。
AI.method: Align-RAG包含以下核心步骤：(1) 振幅对齐：对每个检索到的过去窗口拟合一个Wiener风格的收缩仿射映射（公式1），使其一阶和二阶矩与查询匹配，同时施加收缩正则化（M=5）以防止低方差邻居放大噪声；(2) 相位对齐：通过互相关最大化找到整数滞后τ*（公式2，|τ|≤S/4），并对过去和未来应用相同的滞后以保持配对一致性；(3) 辅助机制：使用MMR多样化（λ=0.3, K=10）、分层令牌预算布局（2个256步详细演示+8个32步密集演示）、距离加权未来混合（β=0.15）以及无演示的二次前向传播共识（α=0.60）。算法完全无需学习参数，所有超参数在所有数据集和骨干网络上固定不变。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 在冻结的Chronos-Bolt上，Align-RAG在TS-RAG标准七数据集基准（ETTh1/ETTh2/ETTm1/ETTm2/Weather/Exchange/Electricity，S=512, H=64）的MSE上7/7获胜，MAE上6/7获胜，平均MSE降低3.75%，5/6小数据集的配对移动块自举置信区间严格大于零；(2) 跨骨干网络泛化：在Chronos-2、TimesFM-2.0、Moirai、Toto上零样本MSE改进2.5%-13.7%，Moirai平均改进最大（-13.73%，ETTm1达-29.95%）；(3) 2×2消融实验表明对齐贡献约20+百分点MSE，而检索排序仅贡献不到1个百分点；(4) 机制分析：隐式岭回归签名ρ_GD从未对齐的0.30提升到对齐后的0.45，未来洗牌控制实验在ETTm1上将-4.2%的增益翻转为+12.2%的损失，符合"模型对(past, future)对进行回归而非对未来取平均"的解释；(5) 多视域（H=64/96/192）和跨数据集检索实验均保留增益。
AI.conclusion: Align-RAG的实证和机制结论：(1) 实证上，检索样本的对齐（而非检索排序质量或学习的融合模块）是检索增强时间序列预测在冻结TSFM上带来改进的主要来源，学习型融合模块的收益很大程度上是对缺乏对齐的补偿；(2) 机制上，冻结预训练的TSFM在经过对齐的过去-未来对上表现出与隐式岭回归一致的行为结构，与合成回归训练的Transformer的上下文学习文献预测一致。结论建议：在训练任何融合模块之前，闭式对齐应作为检索增强预测的默认基线方法。

title: Reasoning Errors Have a Region and a Direction in the Residual-Stream Trajectory of LLMs
summary: As language models are increasingly used for tasks that require verifiable reasoning, reliably distinguishing sound reasoning from flawed reasoning has become an important practical problem. Recent trajectory-based methods seek this signal in layerwise residual-stream displacements, which capture how representations change while attenuating some stable, token-specific information. However, displacement omits the state from which an update originates, whereas restoring the full state risks reintroducing shortcut-prone information. We identify this trade-off and propose a three-stream detector that combines motion with two restricted views of location. A coarse region reader based on vector quantization and a fine direction reader over normalized multi-layer states. This design restores enough state context to interpret the motion without returning to full-state probing. On reasoning benchmarks unseen during training, our method improves selection accuracy by up to 12% over the displacement-only state of the art and 21% over single-layer probing baselines. Although trained only on reasoning benchmarks, it also reads factual completion and fact verification, ahead of every detector we compare against, which places the signal on correctness rather than on a kind of reasoning. Ablations further show that motion, region, and direction provide complementary signals. These results suggest that reasoning validity is better read from state-conditioned motion than from either static states or decontextualized trajectories alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种三流检测器，用于区分LLM推理中的正确与错误答案。该检测器结合了运动流（读层间位移）、区域流（向量量化的粗粒度位置）和方向流（归一化多层状态的方向），在未训练的推理基准上比仅用位移的SOTA方法提升12%，比单层探针提升21%，并且仅在推理数据上训练就能零样本迁移到事实性错误检测任务。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被用于需要可验证推理的任务，如何可靠地区分正确推理与错误推理成为重要问题。现有轨迹方法（层间残差流位移）虽能压制某些标签相关信号，但丢失了推理状态信息；而恢复完整状态又会重新引入表面信息捷径。本文识别这种状态恢复的权衡（state-restoration trade-off），提出最小充分状态恢复原则。
AI.method: 三流检测器框架：(1) 运动流——读层间位移的双向LSTM（来自先前提出的"Truth as a Trajectory"工作）；(2) 区域流——基于向量量化码本（128条目）的粗粒度状态恢复，用直通估计训练，承诺损失防码本崩溃；(3) 方向流——读m=6个中间至后段层的归一化状态方向，通过共享投影W和MLP聚合（最终token与均值）。三流嵌入拼接后送入MLP头部输出有效性分数。在训练时只冻结LLM，检测器从头训练，用二元对比损失（pairwise objective）。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-14B（密集）、Qwen3-30B-A3B（MoE）三个模型上验证；训练于单一推理捐赠数据集（ARC-C/ARC-E/OBQA/CSQA/SIQA/HSwag），在8个推理基准和4个事实性基准上零样本迁移。推理迁移：比仅位移方法高7-12点，比单层探针高10-21点；跨模型收益8-14点。事实性零样本迁移：超过所有对比检测器，比纯位移方法高9-19点。三个流互补：方向流对推理更强，区域流对事实性有独立贡献，每流独有正确项。方向流增加参数仅0.31M（占运动LSTM的6.7%），且比原始状态暴露的文本信息更少。控制实验排除增益来自容量、归一化或措辞泄露。
AI.conclusion: 残差流位移记录计算的"运动"却丢了它的"位置"。本文通过以两种分辨率（离散区域+逐层方向）补充位置信息，并在答案处共同读取三个流，恢复足够的状态上下文来解读运动而无需回到完整状态探针。正确性是状态条件运动的函数，而非静态状态或脱离语境的轨迹所能判读。该结论在密集模型与MoE模型上均成立，且区域码构成了推理与事实性错误共享的坐标词汇。

title: Potential Matching Optimal Transport: Continuous Normalizing Flows for Exact $p$-Wasserstein Dynamics
summary: We introduce Potential Matching Optimal Transport (PMOT), a potential-flow framework for general $p$-cost optimal transport with $c_p(x,y)=\|x-y\|^p$. PMOT parameterizes the CNF velocity field with a scalar potential in the generalized Benamou--Brenier form for the chosen exponent $p$. It trains the potential gradient with a self-induced matching loss along straight bridges determined by the model's own endpoints, while allowing flexible terminal distribution matching. Our main result establishes zero-loss exactness: under the stated regularity, exact terminal matching, and uniqueness assumptions, any zero-loss solution satisfies the generalized Benamou--Brenier optimality system and recovers the corresponding $p$-optimal transport map and dynamics. On synthetic benchmarks, PMOT learns $p$-specific maps that agree with the corresponding $p$-matched OT references. It also remains competitive as a likelihood-based density model on high-dimensional tabular data, and an MMD-based color transformation experiment demonstrates flexible sample-based terminal matching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Potential Matching Optimal Transport (PMOT)，一个面向一般 p 成本最优传输的连续正规化流框架。PMOT 使用标量势函数参数化 CNF 速度场（遵循广义 Benamou–Brenier 形式），通过模型自身端点所确定的直线桥上的自诱导势匹配损失进行训练，无需外部 OT 耦合。核心理论结果是零损失精确性定理：在给定正则性和唯一性条件下，任意零损失解必然满足广义 Benamou–Brenier 最优性系统，并恢复对应的 p 最优传输映射和动力学。
AI.motivation: 现有 OT-Flow 等势流 CNF 方法天然局限于二次成本（W₂ 几何），而许多实际 OT 问题需要一般的 ‖x−y‖^p 成本，不同的 p 会产生不同的最优耦合和轨迹（非对称传输问题尤为明显）。论文的动机是构建一个既能保持 CNF 似然评估能力，又能与一般 p 成本 OT 几何对齐的势流框架，避免依赖外部 OT 耦合或内部 OT 优化。
AI.method: 1. **势参数化**：标量势 Φ:[0,1]×ℝ^d→ℝ，按 Benamou–Brenier 最优性关系定义诱导速度 v_Φ = −‖∇Φ‖^{q−2}∇Φ（q=p/(p−1) 为共轭指数）。当 p=2 时退化为熟悉的 v = −∇Φ。2. **势匹配损失**：沿模型自身端点 F_Φ(x) 确定的直线桥 (1−t)x+tF_Φ(x)，强制势梯度满足 ∇Φ(t, S_t(x)) = −‖F_Φ(x)−x‖^{p−2}(F_Φ(x)−x)（即令诱导速度等于常速桥速度）。3. **终端匹配**：可使用 KL/NLL（似然训练）或 MMD（基于样本匹配）作为终端分布损失 D(ρ¹_Φ, μ₁)。4. **总体目标**：J_PMOT = λ_PM·L_PM + λ_term·L_term。5. **训练细节**：使用 OT-Flow 的标量 ResNet 势架构，固定步长 RK4 求解 ODE，端点保留在计算图中以支持反传。6. **零损失精确性定理**：在 L² 绝对连续 μ₀、零损失正则性、C² 内部正则性以及 ρ_t^Φ 在 (0,1) 上满支撑条件下，任意全局极小化子 v_Φ = v⋆ dt⊗ρ_t^Φ 几乎处处成立，F_Φ μ₀-几乎处处等于唯一 p-最优 Monge 映射。证明利用 Jensen 不等式、严格凸性、Fenchel 不等式、c_p 循环单调性以及 Hamilton–Jacobi 方程构造势差恒等式。7. **附录反例**：证明内部满支撑条件不可省略（即使 μ₁ 满支撑也不够），通过构造零损失但非最优的速度场进行说明。
AI.result: **合成基准（8-Gaussians、Pinwheel，p∈{1.5,2,3}）**：PMOT 端点与 p 匹配 Sinkhorn 重心参考一致，成本比在 0.978–1.034 范围内；p-swap 评估显示对角线（训练指数与参考指数一致）平均 MSE 显著低于非对角线（比率 1.41±0.05）。**似然权重敏感性（8-Gaussians、POWER）**：PMOT 以温和的 (1,1) 或 (1,5) 权重获得更优的 Hist JS、L1、MMD 与 NLL，而 OT-Flow 需大幅提升似然权重才能接近同等表现。**高维表格密度估计（MiniBooNE、POWER、HEPMASS）**：PMOT 在三个数据集上均取得更低 NLL，生成 MMD 与 OT-Flow 相当。**MMD 图像色彩变换**：在 256×256 ImageNet 图像上展示灵活的基于样本的端点匹配。
AI.conclusion: PMOT 将势流 CNF 扩展到一般 p 成本 OT 框架，通过自诱导势匹配损失（无需外部 OT 对或内部 OT 优化）训练，结合 KL/NLL 或 MMD 端点目标实现灵活训练。零损失精确性定理在正则性、终端匹配与满支撑假设下保证恢复唯一 p-最优 Monge 映射及 Benamou–Brenier 速度场。实验验证了 p 特定几何对齐、似然建模竞争力以及基于样本的端点匹配能力。作为确定性 CNF，PMOT 表示 Monge 类映射；有限样本训练、数值积分与优化引入的实际近似误差是其固有限制。附录反例表明内部满支撑条件在理论上不可省略。

title: When Does Consensus Mean Correctness? Measuring the Agreement-Accuracy Coupling with Semantics-Preserving Re-Rendering
summary: A model's agreement across perturbed inputs is used both as a label-free reliability signal and as a self-training target, on the premise that agreement tracks correctness. That coupling is rarely measured directly: natural-image perturbations preserve meaning only by assumption, and no exact answer key localizes errors. Scientific figures remove both obstacles, a figure is drawn from data by a program, so redrawing it yields images that are semantically equivalent by construction and share a programmatically exact answer. We build RENDEQ, a generator of such render-equivalence sets, and measure the coupling on three open-weight VLMs, checking every finding across three independent instantiations. Re-rendering beats resampling on both accuracy and reliability. Agreement beats an evidence-carrying baseline, mean token log-probability, on two of three models and ties on the third, reversing an intermediate, buggy replication traced to a rendering-pipeline failure. The dispersion behind this is concentrated in one style factor, the plotting library, more than double the next-largest factor and an order of magnitude above the noise floor. Fine-tuning on the model's own cross-render consensus inverts: accuracy falls in every one of five replication runs, the opposite sign to published results on natural images. Agreement certifies correctness only above a threshold set by how diffuse a model's errors are, and an objective that rewards agreement destroys exactly that diffuseness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RENDEQ生成器，用于创建语义等价的科学图表渲染集合，并基于此直接测量VLM的"一致性-正确性耦合"。研究发现：重渲染优于重采样；一致性在多数模型上优于均值token对数概率；一致性-正确性耦合主要受绘图库这一风格因素影响；在模型自身跨渲染一致性共识上微调会降低准确性，与自然图像上的已有结论相反；一致性仅在错误分散度低于阈值时才认证正确性，而奖励一致性的目标会破坏这种分散度。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将模型在不同扰动输入下的一致性同时用作无标签可靠性信号和自训练目标，其前提假设是一致性可追踪正确性，但这一耦合关系很少被直接测量。原因是自然图像扰动保持语义等价性仅是假设，且缺乏精确定位的答案键。科学图通过程序从数据绘制，能够同时消除这两个障碍。
AI.method: 构建RENDEQ（render-equivalence sets）生成器，通过重新渲染科学图生成语义等价的图像集合（共享程序化精确答案）。在三个开源权重的视觉语言模型（VLM）上测量一致性-正确性耦合，并通过三个独立实例化检验每个发现。比较重渲染与重采样、一致性与均值token对数概率（evidence-carrying基线）、以及在模型自身跨渲染共识上微调的效果。
AI.result: 1. 重渲染在准确性和可靠性上均优于重采样。2. 一致性在两个模型上优于均值token对数概率基线，第三个模型上持平；这一结论反转了一个因渲染管线失败导致的错误中间复现结果。3. 一致性耦合的分散性集中在一个风格因素——绘图库，贡献超过次大因素两倍，高出噪声底限一个数量级。4. 在模型自身跨渲染共识上微调，在五次复现运行中准确性均下降，与自然图像上的已发表结果符号相反。5. 一致性仅在模型错误分散度低于某阈值时才认证正确性；奖励一致性的优化目标恰好破坏了这种分散度。
AI.conclusion: 一致性与正确性的耦合并非普遍成立，而是受到渲染风格（尤其是绘图库选择）以及模型错误分散度的强烈调节。基于一致性的自训练目标在科学图场景下会系统性地损害准确性，揭示了自然图像研究中"agreement-as-correctness"假设的脆弱性。RENDEQ为直接测量该耦合提供了受控测试平台。

title: Consistency Has a Computable Blind Spot: A Commutation Theory of Label-Free Reliability for Vision-Language Figure Reading
summary: Label-free reliability for vision-language models rests on invariance: perturb the input and a faithful reader's answer should not change. This has a known blind spot, a systematic misreading survives the perturbation and gets certified wrong, which we show is computable, not just real: an error is invisible to an edit exactly when the two commute, so the errors a suite cannot reach form its joint centralizer, a set that shrinks as edits are added and can be written down rather than guessed at. We act on the complementary relation, equivariance: edit a figure's data and the correct answer must change by a computable amount. Two matched edits are provably complete for affine reading errors; no suite of swap edits is complete for label permutations, and cyclic relabeling closes most of that gap. We instantiate the theory as the Equivariance-Consistency Score, a label-free, training-free detector, and release REND-EQUIV, pairing matched invariance and equivariance sets over identical data. The predicted ordering holds across three models and a hand-labeled population immune to the one circularity in how it is selected; a second invariance-family method confirms the blind spot belongs to the relation, not to any implementation; and cyclic relabeling delivers its predicted gain on a matched real sample. The same characterization explains a reported inversion of this ordering in the classifier metamorphic-testing literature: detectability is a joint property of the relation and the fault class, never of the relation alone.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视觉-语言模型中基于不变性(invariance)的无标签可靠性测试的系统性盲区,从代数角度提出理论框架:无法被检测的错误恰好与编辑操作可交换(commute),从而构成编辑集的联合中心化子(joint centralizer)。基于此,作者提出用等变性(equivariance)替代不变性,并发布Equivariance-Consistency Score检测器及REND-EQUIV数据集,在三个模型上验证了所预测的错误排序关系,并解释了分类器变形测试文献中报告的排序反转现象。
AI.motivation: 无标签可靠性评估依赖不变性原则——扰动输入后正确答案不应改变。然而该方法存在系统盲区:某些系统性误读会在扰动下存活并被错误地"认证为正确"。现有方法无法刻画该盲区的计算本质,也无法解释为什么不同测试套件的检测能力存在差异。
AI.method: 1) 建立代数框架:将扰动视为编辑算子,证明错误对编辑不可见当且仅当两者可交换,因此测试套件的盲区即为其编辑集的联合中心化子。2) 转而利用等变性(对数据的编辑应使答案按可计算量改变),证明两个匹配编辑对仿射型阅读错误构成完备集;单纯交换编辑对标签置换不完备,循环重标注可弥补大部分缺口。3) 实例化为Equivariance-Consistency Score(无标签、无训练的检测器),并发布REND-EQUIV数据集(配对的恒等与等变性编辑集,数据相同)。4) 通过三类模型验证、第二种恒等族方法交叉验证、以及匹配真实样本的循环重标注增益实验进行实证检验。
AI.result: 1) 理论预测的错误排序关系在三个VLM模型和一个手标注总体上均成立(规避了选择过程中的循环性)。2) 另一族基于恒等性的方法确认该盲区属于关系层面而非具体实现层面。3) 循环重标注在匹配的真实样本上产生了其理论预测的增益。4) 同一表征解释了分类器变形测试文献中报告的排序反转:可检测性是关系与错误类的联合属性,不能仅由关系决定。
AI.conclusion: 本文将无标签可靠性的盲区形式化为编辑集的可交换结构,提出以等变性为核心的无训练检测器,并通过REND-EQUIV数据集验证了其普适性与可解释性。该工作将变形测试的检测能力从"工具体系"层面提升到"代数关系"层面,为VLM可靠性评估提供了原则性指导:测试设计需明确其编辑集与目标错误类的联合完备性。

title: SEAM: Global consistency beyond local accuracy in scientific machine learning
summary: Scientific machine learning commonly validates models at the level of a subdomain, a benchmark split, or an explanation for one prediction. Yet such local checks cannot establish whether the resulting explanations can be assembled into one globally admissible explanation. We introduce Scientific Explanation-Admissibility Machines (SEAM), a generator-agnostic framework that makes this local-to-global consistency question computable across regions, sensors, regimes, and model components. The finite explanation-sheaf instantiation SEAM-$\Omega$ represents each region by a structured explanation with state, closure, and observation channels together with optional contract metadata; compares neighboring explanations on their overlaps; and converts disagreement into a channel-resolved obstruction. This obstruction locates inconsistency and tests competing declared accounts by restricting each repair to the revisions that one account permits. Exact feasibility refutes or retains an account; when exact repair is unavailable, residual-aware regularized records provide a separately labeled empirical attribution. The framework also separates inconsistency from non-identifiability and monitors learned generators under distribution shift. We establish theorems for minimum-cost intervention and conservation-contract detectability, together with companion results for identifiability and closure recoverability. Across nineteen experiments involving synthetic partial differential equation systems and out-of-distribution Fourier neural operator (FNO) monitoring, SEAM detects incompatible explanations even when local predictions are accurate, and attributes failures to specific channels and overlaps. SEAM adds a global explanation-consistency audit to existing solvers and learning models, testing whether their local explanations form a coherent scientific account.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SEAM（科学解释可接受性机器）框架，用于解决科学机器学习中局部准确性无法保证全局一致性的问题。框架的核心实例SEAM-Ω基于有限解释层，使用状态/闭合/观测通道的结构化解释表示，通过余边界算子将邻域间的不一致性转化为通道可分解的障碍物ω，并通过对受约束干预预算（投影子空间）的可行性检验来证伪或保留科学假设。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习普遍以子区域、基准数据集划分或单一预测解释的方式进行局部验证，但局部准确性无法保证来自不同区域的解释能够被组装成一个全局可接受的科学解释。当多个独立训练的局部模型各自通过局部残差测试，却在共享边界上产生不一致时，问题尤为突出。这种局部-全局一致性差距在独立构建的区域模型（M1）、季节性非平稳性（M2）、传感器-物理冲突（M3）以及学习算子的分布偏移（M4）四种机制下普遍存在，亟需一种可计算、可审计的一致性诊断与假设检验工具。
AI.method: SEAM定义五阶段流程：生成（局部解释）、限制（重叠映射）、障碍（计算ω=Ds）、诊断（通道分解）和干预（预算可行性测试），并附以可识别性分析和流式监控扩展。SEAM-Ω采用有限解释层F，在覆盖的1-骨架上构建向量空间stalk和块对角线性限制映射，由闭域假设（A0）保证障碍ω按通道（state/closure/obs/meta）分解。干预问题定义为在投影子空间P下的最小代价二次规划，定理1给出闭式解和反单调性；定理2在基线抵消、单侧零贡献、正秩和行空间对齐四个条件下，给出守恒合同检测的下界σ_min⁺·ε_repair；定理7.3给出闭合通道限制下的最小范数修正。可识别性通过盲可接受子空间B=ker D∩ker O量化观测无法分辨的可接受方向。
AI.result: 在19个实验中，SEAM-Ω成功检测出局部准确但全局不可接受的解释，包括：区域振幅失配（‖ω‖≈0.71，状态通道主导）、家庭用电跨框架审计（三种模型均通过R²>0.999却在冬季-春季过渡处产生≈9.4的障碍）、Burgers方程隐藏源恢复（峰值位置误差0.2%，源宽位移1.7%，闭合通道贡献99.9992%）、数据-物理冲突归因（传感器腐蚀条件下传感器诊断为优18.4倍，闭合腐蚀条件下闭合诊断为优12.6倍）、盲闭合可识别性（‖OB_B‖<10⁻¹⁴）、PDE模型形式判别（选取平流方程，相对间隙96%）、FNO分布偏移监控（‖ω‖与L²预测误差的Pearson相关系数r=0.995±0.003，远优于集成方差的r=0.71）。守恒合同可检测性定理2在25个参数配置中以100%通过率验证。
AI.conclusion: SEAM将全局科学解释一致性从局部准确性中解放出来，提供可审计、可证明的通道分解障碍诊断和基于干预预算的假设检验框架。当ω=0时，给出邻域一致性的确定性认证；当ω≠0时，框架将违约转化为可审计的诊断和干预记录，识别不可接受的方向和当前观测无法分辨的可接受方向。定理体系为最小代价干预、守恒合同检测、可识别性维数和闭合可恢复性提供了有限维保证。该框架补充现有的求解器和学习模型，为科学机器学习增添了全局解释一致性审计能力。

title: CircuitSteer: Geometrically Aligned Multi-Layer Steering via Sparse Autoencoder Circuits
summary: Controlling the behavior of large language models (LLMs) remains a critical challenge for AI alignment. Existing steering methods, such as Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA), typically rely on fixed single-layer interventions derived from aggregate activation differences. These methods impose a single intervention across semantically diverse inputs and often fail to sustain consistent behavioral changes across layers, limiting the effectiveness of the steering. In this work, we introduce CircuitSteer, a novel framework that leverages Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to identify and manipulate coherent semantic circuits distributed across multiple layers. By constructing a feature flow circuit based on feature co-activation and the geometric alignment of decoder directions, we isolate the specific multi-layer subcircuits responsible for a target behavior. We then synthesize dense steering vectors from these sparse features and apply multi-point interventions to guide the model's internal semantic trajectory. We evaluate CircuitSteer using contrastive examples across a diverse set of tasks, including toxicity, emotion-intensity, sycophancy, and refusal, spanning two model families. Across all models and datasets, CircuitSteer is the only method to consistently produce fluency-preserving interventions; competing methods either sacrifice text quality or lack coverage, failing entirely on complex behaviors like sycophancy and refusal. These results demonstrate that multi-layer circuit steering, enabled by enforcing geometric alignment among selected features, yields strictly more robust and effective behavioral control than static single-point interventions. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CircuitSteer——一种基于稀疏自编码器(SAE)的免训练多层行为引导框架。通过构建跨层"特征流电路"（结合特征共激活与解码器方向几何对齐两个准则），筛选出目标行为专属的多层子电路，并将稀疏特征合成为稠密引导向量，在多个层同步施加干预。该方法在 Gemma-2-2B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen3.5-27B 三种模型与毒性、情绪、谄媚、拒绝四类行为任务上，是唯一在所有模型-数据集组合下都能保持流畅性的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时引导方法（如 CAA）依赖单层固定干预向量，存在两大根本局限：（1）将语义多样的输入强行套用同一干预，粒度粗且不稳定；（2）高层语义概念在模型中跨层渐进演化，单层干预无法捕获完整计算结构。直接扩展到多层则面临两个新挑战：跨层特征的几何方向不一致会导致破坏性干扰；残差流的顺序传播使得早期干预的扰动在后续层被累积放大，引发流畅性崩溃。
AI.method: 1. **特征流电路构建**：将所有 SAE 特征表示为节点 (l,i)，在相邻层之间依据 (a) 特征共激活阈值 τ_act 与 (b) 解码器方向余弦相似度阈值 τ_sim 联合判定建立有向边。2. **对比特异性评分**：利用目标/对比提示对的边频率差 S = P(·|D+) − P(·|D−)，筛选 τ_diff 以上的边，得到行为专属子电路 C_target。3. **稠密引导向量合成**：在每层将子电路中涉及特征的解码器方向取平均，得到 v_l（式 6）。4. **多点干预**：在推理时对所有 v_l 非空的层施加 h'_l = h_l + λ·v_l，使用单一全局系数 λ 控制强度。整个流程无需梯度训练，仅使用 SAELens 提供的开源 SAE。
AI.result: **主结果**：在 4 个数据集 × 2 个模型共 8 种配置下，CircuitSteer 是唯一全部存在有效工作点的方法；其他方法至少在一种配置下因流畅性崩溃或效果过低而失败。在 Gemma 上 Jigsaw(Δ=0.072) 与 Sycophancy(Δ=0.057，唯一有效方法) 第一；Llama 上 RTP(Δ=0.128) 第一。**消融**：移除几何对齐(NoGeo/反向对齐)使复杂行为如 Sycophancy 在 Gemma 上完全失效；随机 SAE 也无法产生有效干预；单层变体效果下降。**缩放**：在 Qwen3.5-27B + TopK SAE 上超参数直接迁移，行为缩减随 λ 单调变化且困惑度接近 1.0。**拒绝行为**：在 Llama-3.1-8B 的 AdvBench 上，将拒绝率从 89% 降至 0%（λ=−3），而单层 CAA 几乎无变化。**能力保留**：MMLU 准确率仅下降 0.03，GSM8K 下降 0.02；良性输入上困惑度上升远小于 CAA。**阈值鲁棒性**：在 5–6 倍参数范围内 Δ 波动小于单提示噪声。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将推理时行为引导从"单层残差流干预"推进到"跨层特征电路调控"。几何对齐作为多层引导的必要前提，有效消除了破坏性干扰与残差流传播引发的过引导问题，使稳定、可调、可解释的行为控制成为可能。实验证明该方法在不同模型家族、SAE 类别（JumPReLU/ReLU/TopK）和行为类型上均具有鲁棒性，为 LLM 安全对齐与机制可解释性研究提供了透明、可扩展的路径。同时，对拒绝行为的成功干预也暴露了当前 RLHF 对齐的结构脆弱性，凸显了构建对特征级因果干预具有韧性的对齐方法的迫切需求。

title: Equipment-centric workpiece localization in near real-time using deep learning-based vision and event-driven finite state machines
comment: 21 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Published in The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology
summary: Continuous workpiece localization is essential for traceability and process coordination in hot forging, but direct tracking is unreliable because of extreme temperatures, surface degradation, and irregular routing. This study presents an equipment-centric framework that infers workpiece locations from handling equipment observed by multiple static 2D cameras. The framework estimates floorplan-space 3D equipment coordinates and recognizes grasp and release activities. Event-driven finite state machines validate these activities as discrete handling events and continuously update workpiece states and locations. A keypoint-guided attention mechanism integrated into a 3D convolutional neural network improves activity recognition by focusing on functionally relevant equipment regions. Evaluation in an operational hot forging factory achieved 100\% event detection accuracy within a 33-second tolerance window, a mean localization error of 317.8 mm, and a mean system latency of 21 seconds. The framework connects vision-based perception with interpretable event-driven reasoning and supports visualization of workpiece transfers and quantitative analysis of equipment operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以设备为中心的连续工件定位框架，通过多静态2D摄像头观察搬运设备，结合3D卷积神经网络和事件驱动有限状态机，实现热锻车间工件的实时追踪与可视化。
AI.motivation: 在热锻生产环境中，由于高温、表面退化和路径不规则，直接追踪工件（如通过RFID或贴附传感器）不可靠。工件溯源和过程协调需要连续的工件位置信息，但传统方法在此极端工业环境下失效。因此需要一种间接的、基于视觉感知的工件定位方法。
AI.method: 该框架采用设备中心化的方法，分为四个关键模块：1）从多静态2D摄像头图像中估计搬运设备在平面图空间的3D坐标；2）基于关键点引导的注意力机制3D卷积神经网络（CNN）识别抓取（grasp）和释放（release）活动；3）事件驱动有限状态机（FSM）验证这些活动为离散搬运事件；4）持续更新工件状态和位置，将视觉感知与可解释的事件驱动推理相结合。
AI.result: 在实际运行的热锻工厂中评估：事件检测准确率达到100%（在33秒容差窗口内）；平均定位误差为317.8毫米；平均系统延迟为21秒。该框架支持工件转移可视化及设备操作的定量分析。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功连接了基于视觉的感知与可解释的事件驱动推理，为极端工业环境（热锻）下的工件连续追踪提供了一种实用且可靠的解决方案，在精度、实时性和可解释性之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Accelerating nanodrug development in continuous flow systems using informed prediction models based on low-cost surrogate nanoparticles
summary: The development of nanotherapeutics often involves extensive empirical optimization due to the sensitivity of nanoparticle properties, such as size and polydispersity index (PDI), to minor changes in process parameters. Factors like formulation concentration, flow rates, and mixing ratios can significantly influence clinical efficacy and therapeutic outcomes. The absence of predictive mathematical frameworks has made iterative experimental screening necessary, increasing both costs and development time. This study introduces and validates a predictive modeling approach based on shape constraints, aiming to enhance the estimation of nanoparticle characteristics across various process conditions. Using controlled microfluidic methods, liposomes and lipid nanoparticles were systematically prepared under varying lipid concentrations, flow rates, and aqueous-to-organic mixing ratios. The shape-constrained model, informed by both experimental data and expert knowledge, was subsequently validated for a pharmaceutical application using minimal empirical data. Results reveal that shape-constrained modeling facilitates accurate prediction of nanoparticle size and dispersity, reducing the need for extensive experimental workflows. This framework supports rational and efficient process development for manufacturing nanomedicine systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于形状约束（shape-constrained）的预测建模方法，用于在纳米的脂质体和脂质纳米颗粒制备过程中预测粒径和多分散指数（PDI），减少经验性实验筛选的工作量。
AI.motivation: 纳米治疗剂的研发过程中，颗粒的尺寸和PDI等性质对工艺参数（如脂质浓度、流速、混合比例）极为敏感，但目前缺乏预测性的数学框架，只能依赖大量迭代式实验筛选，导致成本高昂、开发周期延长。因此亟需一种能够基于有限实验数据准确预测纳米颗粒特性的理性化方法。
AI.method: 采用受控微流控方法，在不同的脂质浓度、流速和水相-有机相混合比例条件下系统制备脂质体和脂质纳米颗粒（LNPs）；基于实验数据与专家先验知识构建形状约束预测模型，并使用最少的实验数据对模型在药物制剂应用中的表现进行验证。
AI.result: 形状约束模型能够准确预测纳米颗粒的尺寸和分散性（PDI），显著减少对大规模实验工作流程的依赖；该框架可有效支持纳米的工艺开发与制造。
AI.conclusion: 基于形状约束的预测建模为纳米的理性、高效工艺开发提供了一种可靠框架，有望降低开发成本、缩短研发周期，并推动纳米的产业化进程。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Closed-Loop Control of Laser Powder Bed Fusion with an In-Loop Ontology
comment: 23 pages, 8 figures, submitted to journal(Journal of Intelligent Manufacturing) and under review
summary: A geometry-conditioned, neuro-symbolic closed-loop architecture is proposed for laser powder bed fusion, in which a standards-aligned ontology operates inside the control loop and couples symbolic reasoning with statistical learning to set the targets of a constraint-aware predictive controller. The ontology links the process objectives and constraints to the signals a controller can observe, and a description-logic reasoner converts them into the references and bounds enforced on each scan. The demonstrated case is overhang dross, a quality limit on the melt pool depth, which governs quality yet cannot be measured during the build, is mapped through a geometry- and power-dependent depth-to-width ratio onto a bound on the observable width, with the ratio and its calibrated uncertainty supplied by a Gaussian process. The reasoner classifies each upcoming feature and selects the active constraints-adding a lack-of-fusion floor at overhangs, a monotone guard beyond the calibrated range, and an energy-density cap where a process window is declared while running only on changes of geometric context and otherwise leaving a single small quadratic program on the per-scan path. In an Eagar-Tsai surrogate calibrated to the NIST AM-Bench benchmark for IN625, the architecture eliminates the dross produced by a geometry-blind controller, holds dross at zero with only a small residual lack-of-fusion under dual scoring, degrades gracefully under deliberate plant mismatch, and retargets to new alloys and constraints by editing ontology data rather than code. The results establish architectural feasibility, experimental calibration of the ratio is the principal next step.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）的几何条件神经符号闭环控制架构：标准对齐的本体在控制环内将符号推理与统计学习耦合，为约束感知预测控制器设定目标；通过几何与功率相关的深宽比（由高斯过程提供校准不确定性）将不可在线测量的熔池深度映射为可观测宽度的边界；描述逻辑推理机对即将到来的几何特征分类并选择主动约束（悬垂处的未熔合下限、超出校准范围的单调防护、过程窗口内的能量密度上限），每个扫描路径上仅求解一个小型二次规划。在 NIST AM-Bench IN625 基准上校准的 Eagar–Tsai 代理模型上验证，该架构消除了几何盲控制器产生的悬垂毛刺，在双重评分下将毛刺保持为零且仅有少量未熔合残余，并在人为过程失配下优雅退化，通过编辑本体数据而非代码即可重定向新合金与新约束。
AI.motivation: 激光粉末床熔融中的关键质量极限（如悬垂毛刺受熔池深度限制）无法在成形过程中在线测量，导致几何盲控制器产生缺陷；现有数据驱动控制缺乏可解释性与标准对齐性，且难以在新合金/新约束间快速重定向，需要一种将过程知识与学习耦合、仅依赖可观测信号的闭环控制范式。
AI.method: 1) 在控制环内部署标准对齐的本体，将过程目标与约束链接到控制器可观测信号；2) 描述逻辑（DL）推理机将本体中的目标与约束转化为每个扫描上的参考值与边界；3) 以几何与功率相关的熔池深宽比（D/W）及其高斯过程校准不确定性，将不可测的深度极限映射为可观测宽度的上界；4) 推理机对即将到来的几何特征分类，按需激活三类主动约束——悬垂处的未熔合（LOF）下限、超出已校准 D/W 范围的单调防护、已声明过程窗口内的能量密度上限；5) 在每个扫描路径上仅保留一个小型二次规划（QP）求解；6) 使用基于 NIST AM-Bench IN625 数据校准的 Eagar–Tsai 热代理模型进行仿真验证，并测试了双评分与人为过程失配场景。
